+ Drive delivery using Agile / SAFe / hybrid methodologies, ensuring predictable, high‑quality outcomes in a fast‑paced trading environment.

* 12\+ years of project management in technology, including large\-scale implementations or upgrades.

* Strong command of project management techniques (Agile and Waterfall; RAID management).

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* PMP, PRINCE2 or similar certification.

* Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities.

**Contact** 
 : daniel.sherwood@forsythbarnes.com
 



  





 We are seeking an AI PMO Manager to design and shape enterprise AI and automation use cases across finance and wider business functions. The role focuses on identifying high\-value opportunities, defining solution approaches, and guiding build vs buy decisions to maximise ROI. It combines strong technical literacy with business transformation experience, acting as an architect for AI\-enabled change rather than a delivery coder or large\-scale programme owner.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Identify and prioritise AI, GenAI, ML, and automation opportunities across the enterprise
* Translate business problems into structured, high\-ROI use cases and delivery roadmaps
* Define solution approaches across AI agents, ML, GenAI, RPA, and supporting infrastructure
* Evaluate build vs buy options and advise on architecture and deployment models (cloud, hybrid, on\-prem)
* Assess full solution economics including model usage, token costs, infrastructure, and run costs
* Lead and shape proofs of concept and pilots, including success criteria and evaluation frameworks
* Support development of AI governance, risk, and adoption standards
* Partner with senior stakeholders across business, technology, and finance to present options and recommendations



  





 Candidate Profile
 


* Background in transformation, PMO, consulting, or programme delivery within complex organisations
* Strong understanding of AI, automation, ML, GenAI, and enterprise architecture concepts
* Able to assess technical solutions and infrastructure trade\-offs without being a hands\-on developer
* Strong commercial mindset with experience building ROI cases and evaluating technology costs
* Comfortable operating across business and technical stakeholders at senior level
* Analytical, structured, and execution\-focused with strong problem\-solving ability



  





  





 If this role would be of interest, apply today!

data.jd_text:
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global PMO Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role exists to help build and embed a fit\-for\-purpose PMO capability for the Emerging Markets (EM) business, enabling disciplined execution of innovation and portfolio priorities at pace and with quality.
   

  

 As Flora Food Group continues to scale consumer\-led innovation across regions, the Emerging Markets business requires stronger orchestration across Marketing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. The PMO Manager will act as a foundational builder of this capability: setting up robust ways of working, driving executional discipline, and ensuring projects land on time, in full, and with clear accountability.
   

  

 This role is critical to reducing execution risk, improving speed\-to\-market, and freeing up functional leaders to focus on content and decision\-making rather than coordination.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will help establish an Emerging Markets PMO operating/ framework model aligned to global P\&P / PMO standards, while tailored to local business realities.
   

  

 You will bring consistency, transparency and rigor to how innovation and portfolio initiatives are planned, governed and delivered, and act as the single point of truth for execution status, risks and delivery confidence across the EM innovation and portfolio agenda.
   

  

 You will act as the executional backbone for end\-to\-end project \& activity management, by owning the planning and orchestration of priority innovation and portfolio initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional teams’ ownership and accountability to deliver against clear timelines, milestones and decision gates.
   

  

 You will improve delivery confidence, resource visibility and decision quality across the EM portfolio by ensuring high\-quality data, discipline and follow\-through in portfolio \& project management systems. You will act as a role model for execution discipline, pragmatic problem\-solving and collaborative leadership; and you will help to build the EM PMO capability over time, including a small team, templates/tools, playbooks and best practices, as the EM hub scales.
   

  

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**
 You will be
 **accountable for execution and orchestration** 
 , not for project content ownership. Project leadership and strategic direction will remain with the Marketing / Business leads; this role ensures the work lands.
   

  

 You are biased toward action, clarity and simplification — not to add bureaucracy.
   

  

**What Does It Take To Be Successful**
 You combine strong project management fundamentals with the confidence to operate in complex, cross\-functional FMCG environments. You are comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and you bring calm, clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.
   

  

* 5–10\+ years’ experience in project, program or PMO roles within FMCG / CPG or similarly complex environments
* Experience acting as owner of PMO data quality, reporting cadence and execution dashboards in enterprise environments
* Strong systems thinker with the ability to design simple, scalable ways of working, with proven experience setting up or scaling PMO / project management structures
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end innovation, transformation or portfolio initiatives.
* Strong understanding of stage\-gate models, innovation lifecycles and launch readiness
* Confident facilitator and communicator with experience in influencing senior and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Excellent planning, prioritization, execution discipline, high accountability mindset comfortable holding others to commitments and follow\-through for continuous improvement
* Values transparency, pragmatic, solution\-oriented, resilient under pressure and energised by building capability and enabling others to succeed
* Preferred, but not required: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / SAFe certification.


**What’s next?**
**Flora Food Group** 
 is committed to culinary essentials for better food. We believe fewer, better ideas — executed with excellence — are what drive sustainable growth.
   

  

 This is a career\-defining opportunity to work with our high\-impact brands in a high\-energy, high\-accountability environment. If you recognise yourself in this profile, apply and be part of this exciting journey. Apply now at www.florafoodgroup.com.We prefer to receive your application before
 **25th June 2026** 
 .
   

  

 We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.
   

  

*Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.*
*No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.*

data.jd_text:
**Application Deadline:** 
 30 June 2026
 



**Department:** 
 Central Services, People
 



**Location:** 
 Dubai
   

  




**Description**
**A Career with Trivandi**
 Working for Trivandi means the opportunity to work on the world’s most iconic projects in a supportive, people\-first environment with colleagues who are passionate, collaborative and love what they do.
   

  

 Our culture is grounded in trust and fulfilment, with a shared passion for achieving excellence, whilst having fun. We’re dedicated to ensuring that every team member’s voice is heard and valued, enabling Trivandi to be shaped and grown by the people within it.
   

  

 Ultimately, Trivandi is a place where you’ll be excited to come to work at the start of each week.
   

  

 Together, we keep our shared values at the heart of everything we do:
   

  

**Passion** 
 : We love what we do and care passionately about achieving great outcomes with our partners.
   

  

**Trust \& Quality:** 
 We are trusted to consistently deliver to the highest international standards and professional ethics.
   

  

**OneTeam** 
 : We are a close\-knit team and know that our best work is done together. We care for each other, always putting people first, enabling us to deliver our best work.
   

  

**Always Evolving** 
 : We don't stand still. We strive to make each project better than the last, daring to challenge what's gone before, in our quest for innovation and improvement.
   

  

**About Trivandi**
 Trivandi provides advisory, design and delivery services across sport, events, live entertainment and venues.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 from the success of the London 2012 Games, we have grown to over 100 specialists across four global offices in London, Dubai, Riyadh and Brisbane, delivering over 300 projects in 29 countries.
   

  

 Our unique “One Team” approach brings together the right expertise at the right time, synchronising strategy, design, project management, and operations to simplify complexity and deliver actionable solutions that drive meaningful impact.
   

  

 We passionately share our knowledge to empower local teams, unlocking the full potential of each unique experience to inspire positive change and create lasting legacies.
   

  

 That’s what we mean by creating experiences, better.
   

  

  

**About the Role**
 We are looking for a motivated People Administrator \& PRO to join our People team to support the day\-to\-day People operations and government relations activities for the business in Dubai and KSA, with a strong focus on DMCC processes and compliance.
   

  

 The role is responsible for coordinating employee lifecycle administration, including visa and immigration activities, maintaining employee records, supporting payroll inputs, and acting as the key liaison with DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
   

  

 This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to employee support and compliance management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be highly energetic, professional and able to demonstrate integrity and discretion in all tasks. As this role involves handling sensitive personal and company data, you must be able to manage confidential information with the highest level of care and responsibility.
   

  

 To come on this journey with us, you’ll bring a great sense of humour, a positive and collaborative mindset, and the confidence to navigate a fast\-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. You should be naturally resourceful, solutions\-driven, and comfortable taking initiative. Most importantly, you’ll enjoy a challenge and be excited by the opportunity to support and elevate the People function across all regions as we continue to grow.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 At Trivandi all our roles are broad and flexible, but here’s a flavour of where you’ll focus your time:
   

  

**HR Administration** 
* Support day\-to\-day People administration activities across the employee lifecycle including onboarding, employment changes and offboarding.
* Prepare letters, certificates and other HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases ensuring all information is up to date and compliant.
* Coordinate onboarding processes for new employees including document collection, inductions and system access requests.
* Track probation periods, visa expiry dates, passport renewals and other key employee milestones.
* Support payroll administration by preparing monthly payroll inputs including leave, allowances, deductions and employee changes.
* Maintain annual leave and attendance records.
* Respond to employee queries relating to HR policies, benefits, visas and company procedures.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems.
* Assist with recruitment coordination including interview scheduling, candidate communication and onboarding administration.
* Ensure all HR practices are compliant with UAE labour law and company policies.


**PRO \& Government Relations Responsibilities** 
* Act as the main point of contact for DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
* Manage and process employment visas, labour cards, Emirates IDs, medicals and residency permits.
* Coordinate visa applications, renewals, cancellations and status changes for employees
* Maintain accurate tracking of all visa and immigration activities and ensure renewals are completed in advance of expiry dates.
* Ensure compliance with all DMCC regulations and UAE immigration requirements.
* Coordinate document attestation and notarisation processes where required.
* Support WPS and labour\-related administrative requirements.
* Keep up to date with changes to UAE labour law, immigration regulations and DMCC requirements and communicate impacts to the business.
* Support the KSA People team with KSA Business Visa applications and renewals, monitoring expiry dates and turnaround times. Ensure all documentation is complete and correct before employees visit the visa processing centre.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Personal Skills and Experience**
 The key knowledge, experience, and qualifications we are looking for include:
 * 1–2 years of experience in Human Resources or People operations in Dubai, ideally within a professional services or fast\-paced environment.
* Strong administration skills developed within a professional setting.
* Experience with HRMS platforms or other relevant HR information system.
* Proficient in the use of IT and Microsoft programmes and iOS applications.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Desirable \- DMCC systems knowledge
* Desirable – KSA business visa and Iqama knowledge
* Strongly desirable \- Arabic speaker


**About You**
 The key competencies and behaviours we are looking for include:
 * Excellent team working skills with an open, friendly, and supportive style.
* Ability to effectively, accurately, and concisely present and communicate in both written and verbal forms and be empathetic across different audiences and cultural sensitivities.
* Proven attention to detail
* Able to handle shifting demands.
* Responsive and helpful
* Self\-motivated and resourceful
* Loyal, displaying the highest levels of integrity and commitment.
* Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic company


**Benefits**
 If you are successful in this application we will invest in you, support, and train you to be successful, opening up a world of opportunities.
   

  

 Trivandi is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our team. We aim to be truly representative of all sections of society, creating an environment where everyone feels respected and able to give of their best. We therefore warmly welcome applications from anyone who meets the criteria we’ve described.

**Designation: Director, Strategy \& Transformation / Director CEO Office \& Transformation** 




**Location: Dubai, UAE** 




  





**About SUMWON STUDIOS** 




**SUMWON STUDIOS** 
 is a global brand house building, scaling and reimagining culturally relevant fashion, lifestyle and consumer brands. Our portfolio includes
 **MISSGUIDED, SUMWON, BALR, Baby Phat, Playboy, AiiRZ, KiZN** 
 and
 **KSTM.** 




  





 In just a few years, we have grown from start\-up to one of the fastest\-scaling brand platforms in the
 
 industry. Combining creativity, data, technology and an agile supply chain, we build brands designed to win in today's digital\-first world.
 



  





 We operate at the intersection of culture, commerce and innovation. Whether launching new brands, acquiring established ones, or unlocking growth opportunities across our portfolio, we move quickly, think globally and challenge conventional ways of working.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is not a traditional Chief of Staff role.
 



  





 The primary purpose of this position is to act as a force multiplier for the CEO and leadership team, increasing the speed, quality and effectiveness of decision making and execution across the organisation.
 



  





 You will work across every function of the business, helping shape strategy while ensuring critical initiatives are delivered. You will lead transformation programmes, drive organisational effectiveness, champion AI and automation adoption, and take ownership of high\-impact strategic projects.
 



 The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with relentless execution. We are less interested in career consultants and more interested in operators who have helped build, scale and transform businesses from the inside.
 



  





 This role is designed for someone with the ambition and capability to become a future GM, COO or CEO.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 CEO Office \& Strategic Execution
 


* Partner directly with the CEO on the company's most important priorities.
* Translate strategy into clear action plans, accountability and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution of strategic initiatives across all functions.
* Monitor business performance and identify opportunities, risks and bottlenecks.
* Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the CEO.
* Independently lead major initiatives with minimal direction.



 AI, Technology \& Business Transformation
 


* Lead the identification, prioritisation and implementation of AI, automation and technology initiatives across the business.
* Partner with functional leaders to redesign processes and operating models using technology.
* Drive measurable improvements in productivity, speed, quality and cost efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to create competitive advantage.
* Establish a culture of innovation, experimentation and continuous improvement.



 Organisational Effectiveness
 


* Drive company\-wide OKRs, governance and accountability frameworks.
* Improve decision\-making processes and organisational operating rhythms.
* Help ensure the business scales effectively as teams, brands and markets grow.
* Support leadership teams in defining structures, responsibilities and ways of working.
* Remove complexity and improve cross\-functional collaboration.



 Strategic Projects \& Corporate Development
 


* Lead high\-priority projects on behalf of the CEO.
* Support acquisitions, partnerships, market expansion and new business initiatives.
* Coordinate due diligence, integration planning and execution activities.
* Develop business cases, strategic recommendations and implementation plans.



 Internal \& Corporate Communications
 


* Support company\-wide communication of strategic priorities and transformation programmes.
* Help align teams around business objectives and organisational change.
* Support investor, board, media and external stakeholder communications where required.
* Prepare executive presentations, board materials and strategic updates.



 Talent \& Leadership Support
 


* Support organisational and leadership development initiatives.
* Help identify capability gaps and opportunities to strengthen the organisation.
* Work alongside senior leaders to improve team effectiveness and performance.
* Contribute to succession planning and future leadership development.



  





**What you’ll bring** 



* 5\+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, private equity, venture capital, technology, e\-commerce, consumer or high\-growth businesses.
* Strong preference for candidates who have experience both advising businesses and operating within them.
* Demonstrated success leading complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Strong commercial judgement and business acumen.
* Experience driving transformation, technology or AI initiatives is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment.
* Comfortable operating in fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environments.
* Highly organised with exceptional execution capabilities.



  





**What we'll bring** 



* 25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 days after your first year
* 30% employee discount across SUMWON STUDIOS brands
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Company social events
* The opportunity to work with a high\-performing team building brands at global scale



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 This is an opportunity to join a business in growth mode. You'll have the chance to make a visible impact, take ownership, move quickly and help shape the future of a multi\-brand platform operating across global markets.

* Experience managing projects under contractual frameworks, including contractor management, claims, variations, and commercial processes.
* Strong understanding of construction methodologies, project controls, planning, cost management, and risk mitigation.

* Excellent client\-facing skills with experience dealing directly with developers, consultants, contractors, and government authorities.
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision\-making abilities.



  





 This is an excellent opportunity for an established Project Director to play a key role in delivering some of Dubai’s current high\-profile developments.

**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Director of Project Execution** 
 who will
 **report directly to the Executive Management** 
 and oversee multiple airport BHS and MHS projects. You will provide guidance and leadership to the Project Execution and Site Management teams, foster collaboration across internal functions and external stakeholders, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on\-time, on\-budget, contract compliant, and to the required quality through to handover.
   

  

**What are my responsibilities?**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of airport BHS/MHS programs, ensuring safe, on\-budget, contract\-compliant execution.
* Serve as senior client and stakeholder lead, aligning airport authorities/operators, consultants/PMCs, contractors, and internal teams.
* Own the full lifecycle from engineering coordination through installation, integration, testing, commissioning, ORAT, and handover to Service.
* Drive strong project governance (steerco, reviews, workshops), ensuring clear decisions, actions, and follow\-up.
* Manage portfolio performance across multi\-site/multi\-country matrix teams; control KPIs, risk, change, and escalations, including recovery/turnaround.
* Ensure effective site execution in live airport environments, including M\&E installation, upgrades, brownfield works, and system interface management.
* Ensure completeness and quality of technical/contract documentation and reporting across the project lifecycle.
* Lead successful handovers to Life\-Cycle Services, ensuring continuity, training, spares, warranty transition, and sign\-off.
* Support Sales \& Bid activities to develop opportunities and ensure executable delivery strategies and resourcing inputs.
* Build and lead high\-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and continuous improvement.


**What do I need to qualify for the role?**
* 10\+ years delivering complex engineering/automation/site projects; strong ownership of cost, schedule, quality, and safety.
* Proven leadership in multi\-stakeholder environments with strong client\-facing and executive communication capability.
* Strong experience in airport BHS or MHS systems including site execution and commissioning; ORAT exposure is a plus.
* Solid understanding of automation integration environments (mechanical/electrical, PLC/SCADA/controls, interfaces).
* Strong commercial and contractual discipline: change control, risk/opportunity management, claims awareness.
* Proficient in project tools (e.g., MS Project/Primavera, MS Office; Jira/Confluence is a plus).
* Willingness to travel and operate in dynamic airport environments.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.


 Leadership Role: Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

* Experience: 5\+ years in Project/Program Management, with 3\+ years specifically in Fintech, Payments, or Orchestration, 1\+ years in Leading 2\+ members team.
* Technical Literacy: Strong understanding of API\-based architectures, Webhooks, and Payment Flow Logic.
* Tools: Expert\-level mastery of Jira/Confluence and specialized PMO software.
* Location Awareness: Familiarity with the fintech ecosystem. And willngness to get into a new locations and learn.

* Agile Governance: Partner with Engineering and Product leads to ensure sprint capacity matches commercial priorities.

* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify "at\-risk" projects and provide the COO with remediation options (Trade\-offs, Resource shifts).

* Regular team\-building events and company activities that strengthen collaboration across teams.
* Employee Recognition Program celebrating our "Employee of the Month" with special perks.

**Head of Transformation (Project Lifecycle Management)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Head of Transformation to lead a large\-scale enterprise transformation programme across a complex project and real estate portfolio. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving end\-to\-end business transformation across project delivery, commercial operations, governance, financial management, handover, and operational readiness.
 



  





 The successful candidate will own the transformation vision, business case, value realisation, and adoption strategy, ensuring measurable business outcomes through the implementation of standardised processes, governance frameworks, and technology\-enabled ways of working.
 



 This role is focused on transforming how projects are delivered and managed across the organisation—not simply implementing systems or managing programme governance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and lead the transformation vision, strategy, and business case across the project lifecycle.
* Drive measurable business outcomes including improved governance, compliance, cost control, schedule performance, transparency, and operational efficiency.
* Lead the design and implementation of future\-state operating models and standardised ways of working.
* Champion organisational change and user adoption across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
* Partner with executive leadership to secure alignment, influence decision\-making, and resolve cross\-functional challenges.
* Develop and manage a multi\-year transformation roadmap, balancing business priorities, value delivery, and organisational readiness.
* Oversee delivery through programme, platform, integration, and change management teams.
* Ensure successful coordination between business and technology functions, including enterprise platforms and integrated systems.
* Build and lead high\-performing transformation, product, and change teams capable of sustaining long\-term organisational capability.
* Manage external partners and vendors to ensure delivery against agreed timelines, budgets, and business outcomes.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 12–18\+ years of experience leading large\-scale enterprise transformation programmes.
* Proven track record delivering measurable business value through organisational transformation and change initiatives.
* Experience leading multi\-year, cross\-functional transformation programmes at enterprise scale.
* Strong change management and adoption leadership, with demonstrated success driving behavioural and process change.
* Ability to influence C\-suite stakeholders and navigate complex organisational environments.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience balancing priorities, risks, and business outcomes.
* Experience in at least one of the following: real estate, construction, infrastructure, or capital project environments

data.jd_text:
**Job Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

 Whiteshield is a global policy advisory and AI economics firm known for our ability to respond to global challenges rapidly and incisively. We use the most advanced tools and technology and combine them with our team of leading international experts to engage decision\-makers in tackling society's most significant challenges. We are recognized for our rapid decision support, innovation, data science algorithms and deep policy expertise. We are specialists in "connecting the dots" between policy, business and technology.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and driven
 **Digital Delivery Manager** 
 to join Whiteshield to become an integral part of our delivery organization. This role will be instrumental in establishing governance frameworks and driving excellence across our complex digital and policy initiatives. This Digital Delivery Manager should have very strong experience in project and program management, ideally with deep expertise in Agile methodologies and digital product delivery to complement our technical and policy teams.
   

  

 This is a role with a lot of responsibility and the potential to make a true impact \- on our delivery capability, within the business, and on government across the globe. We look for entrepreneurial people that want to make their mark on the world, and we empower and reward our staff accordingly. There is a lot of room for creativity and big ideas that shift the status quo. We are constantly delivering large new features and complex initiatives.
   

  

 You will report to our Principals and Partners working across all of our cross\-functional delivery teams, closely collaborating with product managers, developers, UI/UX designers, data scientists, business analysts, and QA teams.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Entrepreneurial and ambitious, with your own perspective and ideas, and with an eagerness to contribute to the success of the organization's delivery excellence.
   

  

 Highly independent and self\-motivated, with strong leadership skills and a get\-things\-done attitude to deliver results.
   

  

 Passion for the public good and eagerness to make a societal impact with their work, ideally with a particular interest in economic development, workforce development, and education.
   

  

 Highly organized and eager to push the boundary on delivery excellence and really rethink traditional project management approaches.
   

  

 Eager to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment that challenges you to excel.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented with high standards for quality and governance.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**End\-to\-End Project Leadership:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution, and closure of complex digital and policy projects from inception through delivery.
   

  

**PMO Governance:** 
 Establish and enforce PMO governance, delivery standards, and reporting frameworks across all projects to ensure consistency and quality.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Coordinate and drive cross\-functional delivery teams including product, data science, data engineering, AI and BI development to achieve project objectives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Interface:** 
 Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical teams to ensure alignment and transparency.
   

  

**Product Delivery Oversight:** 
 Govern the design, development, validation, and deployment of digital products to ensure they meet quality standards and business requirements.
   

  

**Analytics \& Reporting:** 
 Ensure effective visualization and consumption of insights through Live Jira dashboards and related analytics platforms for real\-time project visibility.
   

  

**Toolset Management:** 
 Manage project delivery using Jira, Confluence and Azure\-based toolsets, ensuring transparency, traceability, and control across all initiatives.
   

  

**Risk \& Issue Management:** 
 Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies to keep projects on track.
   

  

**Scope \& Schedule Control:** 
 Monitor and control scope, schedule, and benefits realization across concurrent initiatives to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Quality Assurance:** 
 Ensure quality and consistency of deliverables through formal reviews and adherence to Whiteshield standards.
   

  

**Executive Reporting:** 
 Provide clear, concise, and regular status reporting to senior stakeholders and steering committees.
   

  

**Resource Optimization:** 
 Optimize resource planning, capacity management, and prioritization across multiple workstreams to maximize efficiency.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Multiple years of experience in project/program management and PMO leadership, preferably in a dynamic, high\-growth and highly innovative environment
* Proven successful experience in delivering complex digital products and technology initiatives from scratch
* Proficiency with relevant tooling (such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and analytics platforms)
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications (Scrum Master, SAFe, etc.)
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies with experience adapting frameworks to organizational needs
* Experience with data\-driven decision making and building dashboards/reporting frameworks for executive visibility
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to multitask and resilience to meet deadlines and manage stressful situations
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and experience with stakeholder management at all levels


**Benefits**
**Inclusive by Design**
 At Whiteshield, we champion equal opportunities \- not just in principle, but in practice. We believe the best ideas grow in spaces where every voice is respected, and every background adds value. Our inclusive culture empowers all team members to bring their whole selves to work, knowing their perspectives are welcomed and their contributions matter.
   

  

**Celebrate the Climb**
 We don't just notice high performance \- we reward it. Whether it's through career advancement or peer recognition, we celebrate those who push boundaries and raise the bar. Your growth is our priority.
   

  

**Flexible, Human\-Centered Work**
 We understand that ambition and wellbeing go hand in hand. That's why we offer flexible working models and a culture that values balance, autonomy, and trust. Whether you're recharging or reaching new heights, we want you to thrive \- both inside and outside the office.
   

  

**Impact with Purpose**
 At Whiteshield, your work drives real change. From shaping national labour strategies to advising global climate policy, we work on challenges that matter. For professionals who want their career to stand for something, this is your platform to make it count.
   

  

**Global Mindset**
 Join an international network of economists, data scientists, policy advisors, and strategists \- all collaborating across borders with a shared mission. Expect sharp minds, open conversations, and a genuine team spirit.

data.jd_text:
**Your new company** 




  





 We are working with a cutting\-edge, research\-driven FinTech company backed by a prominent family office. Specializing in advanced, AI\-powered investment and allocation strategies, they combine mathematical modeling, portfolio optimization, and risk analytics to build a sophisticated SaaS platform.
 



 As they scale their elite, Dubai\-based AI engineering hub, they are seeking a structured, hands\-on Head of Delivery to serve as the operational anchor of the team.
 



  





  





**Your new role** 




 As the Head of Delivery, you will act as the critical bridge between people, tech, and product. Sitting between senior management (the Group CFO and Director) and a highly talented technical team, you will be the operational backbone of the Dubai office.
 



 Your core responsibilities will include:
 


* **Owning Delivery:** 
 Chairing and leading recurring progress ("J\-curve") meetings, tracking technical commitments relentlessly, and following up through to execution.
* **Team Coordination:** 
 Coordinating a small, senior team of engineers and support staff, ensuring clear alignment between leadership and technical execution.
* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** 
 Leading the hiring lifecycle for top\-tier technical and AI talent—screening, interviewing, and making clear hire/no\-hire recommendations.
* **Strategy \& Product Documentation:** 
 Turning rough internal directions into clear, exceptionally well\-written documentation and positioning pieces for internal and external stakeholders.



  





  





**What you'll need to succeed** 




 You do not need to be an engineer yourself, but you must be a masterful, structured coordinator who is highly comfortable working alongside technical minds.
 



 To be successful, you will need:
 


* Proven experience in a delivery, operations, or program management role within a technology, software, or AI environment.
* Deep hands\-on experience and working knowledge of
 **Kanban and Scrum** 
 frameworks.
* Excellent technical literacy—the ability to understand engineering workflows, ask the right questions, and hold people to their commitments.
* A solid understanding of the
 **finance industry, financial markets, or private equity** 
 (highly advantageous).
* Strong recruitment instincts with a confident ability to assess and judge technical candidates.
* Impeccable written and spoken English, paired with a calm, diplomatic, and self\-directed personal style.
* A commitment to being based full\-time, on\-site in Dubai.



  





  





**What you'll get in return** 




  





 This is a unique opportunity to join a highly specialized, well\-backed entity at an exciting stage of product innovation. You will receive a highly competitive compensation package tailored to your experience. For the right international candidate looking to make a long\-term commitment to Dubai, comprehensive relocation support is available.
 



  





  





**What you'll need to do now** 




 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up\-to\-date copy of your CV, and a consultant will reach out to you should your profile look suitable, for a further discussion.

**Project Overview** 




 The Taweelah C Project is a landmark greenfield development in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, representing one of the region's most advanced and efficient combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) power plants. With an installed capacity of approximately 2\.6 GW, the project will play a critical role in supporting the UAE's growing electricity demand while delivering high efficiency and lower emissions through state\-of\-the\-art technology.
 



 The project brings together leading international partners with Al Jomaih Energy and Water Co. Ltd. (AEW) and Sembcorp Utilities Pte. Ltd. (Sembcorp) together with TAQA acting as the Project Company
 



 Taweelah C offers a unique opportunity to be part of a high\-profile infrastructure project that will set new benchmarks in performance, reliability, and sustainability in the region's power sector.
   





**Location:** 
 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is 30 to 40 Kms from Abu Dhabi city)
 



**Duration:** 
 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 To lead and oversee all construction activities for the Taweelah C Power Project. Ensuring the timely, on\-budget, and quality delivery of the asset, meeting contractual requirements, and design specifications for reliable and sustainable operation over the Power Purchase Agreement period.
 



 Implementing the HSSE program and supervision in the Project Company and Owner's team, fostering a culture of health, safety, security, and environment in alignment with Project Company and Stakeholder targets.
 



 Monitoring, coordinating, and reporting on multiple Contractors' activities at the site, challenging and negotiating with the EPC contractor when necessary to protect the Project Company's interests.
 



 Leading a highly skilled team and directing the Owner's Engineer to ensure seamless construction with highest levels of HSSE within the necessary quality, time and budget.
 



 Facilitating seamless communication and information exchanges among stakeholders, including project partners, local communities, and external parties.
   

  




**Requirements**

**Your Job Functions (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Oversee plant construction to ensure compliance with quality, schedule, and budget agreements.
* Manage HSSE implementation onsite and offsite, maintaining a strong HSSE culture.
* Coordinate activities of the Owner's Engineer, local contractors, local authorities and interface partners and Contractors.
* Monitor and enforce EPC Contractor's compliance with EPC Contract, Owner's requirements and International Standards
* Act as the primary link between the off\-taker, Owner's Engineer, EPC Contractor, third party, the Operator, \-\-etc to align battery limits and tie\-ins.
* Align technical and schedule interfaces between different contractors, ensuring contract conformity and project needs.
* Monitor Engineering \& Procurement, QA/QC and OE ensuring the EPC Contractor issuing the engineering packages and deliver procurement items ahead of construction needs.
* Organize and lead construction and progress management meetings with all stakeholders.
* Identify, assess, and escalate technical deviations, construction risks, and non\-conformities to the Project Company EMD, proposing effective mitigation and recovery measures.

**Job Description**
 The Sr. Manager Special Projects \& Performance role is part of the regional Chief operating office organizational structure. The candidate is expected to spend 50% of the time on the ground in our local markets to drive projects and work with teams on execution.
   

  

**Reporting Business Performance**
* Analyze Data: Dive into talabat’s performance metrics, identifying key trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement.

**Special Projects**
* Launching new products: Develop business use cases with innovative ideas and bring them to life by working on their implementation, ensuring they align with strategic goals and add value to the business.
* Leading country turnaround projects to identify key gaps in the markets and working alongside local markets on execution

* Leading AI efforts across all performance teams to identify new use cases to enhance productivity


**PnL Management**

**About Moove**
 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies.  This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.

The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.

**Description**
 Amazon works hard to delight customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, \& fluid. Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and when that box with the smile arrived you wondered how it got to you so fast?
   

  

 If so, the Amazon Now team is for you. We partner directly with product and software teams to develop the future of quick commerce.
   

  

 The Tech SME team acts as a catalyst for change by driving innovation at the operator level, prioritizing technology initiatives and supporting engineering design innovations. Tech SMEs strive to be experts in Amazon’s operation systems. They are accountable to delivering world class solutions through optimizing and reinventing the existing technology.
   

  

 The Tech SME is a functional expert on the software tools in given process areas and their application in the network. A successful manager in this organization has strong program management experience to define the process the team uses to deliver best in class tech to the field. This person looks for ways to automate human decision making by influencing Technology to build and update tools that reduce process complexity to deliver robust processes.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Subject Matter Expert (SME) supports, coordinates and facilitates implementation of new \& improved processes within the quick commerce operations. The SME works closely with the store operations, last mile delivery teams, and local \& global product teams. They will be the single point of contact for all tech related activities related with Supply Chain (SC), Under the roof (UTR) and On the road (OTR) and will be providing regular updates to senior leadership team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead technology programs and initiatives for darkstore operations, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems
* Drive Under the Roof (UTR) and On the Road (OTR) operations programs at the darkstore level, optimizing inbound, warehouse, and last\-mile delivery processes
* Build low\-cost automations using AI tools such as KIRO, Quick, and related operations to drive efficiency and reduce manual processes
* Prepare \& lead the tech roadmap for improvement of hybrid warehouse management system (HWMS) for inbound and outbound processes
* Prepare \& lead the tech roadmap for enhancement of delivery service, working closely with the 3P partners \& DSP teams
* Collaborate with worldwide (WW) product and tech teams of HWMS/PRIMS and Last Mile to launch products in Quick commerce (QC) business
* Work closely with the tech organization to document and drive upcoming changes, leveraging tools such as business requirement documents (BRDs) to ensure seamless integration with the existing system.
* Provide regular, concise updates to Tech SME leadership on the progress of the system's development and its potential impact.
* Develop the culture of continuous improvement and Kaizen across tech \& operations to optimize processes and reduce SLAs
* Support new store launches, including but not limited to configurations, Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), etc., coordinating with multiple global product \& tech teams and work with external stakeholders to continuously reduce the time to launch a store
* Provide trainings to operations on new systems and processes
* Maintain strong relationship with the IN, NA, MENA, ROW tech teams working for QC business


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

data.jd_text:
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end delivery of high\-end hospitality and residential development projects on behalf of the client. This role requires a proactive leader with a strong technical background in project and construction management, capable of managing design, procurement, construction, and handover phases while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and schedule adherence. The Senior Project Manager acts as the key interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that the client’s vision and brand standards are achieved.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Project Leadership \& Planning
 


* Lead project delivery activities in alignment with company objectives and brand values.
* Develop, manage, and monitor project programs, budgets, and risk registers.
* Coordinate feasibility studies, site due diligence, and design development.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management
 


* Support the development team manage multidisciplinary design teams (architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, etc.) to ensure timely and coordinated outputs.
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.
* Facilitate design workshops and value engineering exercises.



  





 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface
 


* Act as the principal client representative for all project\-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver regular project reports, presentations, and dashboards to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.



  





 Handover \& Closeout
 


* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, operation manuals, and as\-built drawings are delivered.
* Support transition to operations and post\-completion evaluations.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education \& Certifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management (Master’s degree preferred).
* Professional accreditation such as PMP, RICS, MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent is highly desirable.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in the UAE or GCC region.
* Proven track record of managing luxury hospitality and high\-end residential projects from inception to completion.
* Experience working within client or developer organizations preferred.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC\-based contracts, local permitting processes, and regional construction practices.



  





 Skills \& Attributes
 


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets and forecasts.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multicultural teams.

data.jd_text:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Responsible for directing Professional and Continuing Education (PaCE) activities, including strategic planning, development, and execution of PaCE programmes, business development, training catalog oversight, and stakeholder engagement, to ensure alignment with market demand, client expectations, and the University’s policies and procedures.
   

  

 The Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic \& Financial
   

  

* Lead the development and monitor the execution of the Department's strategy and align with ZU's strategic objectives, ensuring effective and efficient achievement of departmental operations.
* Oversee the Department’s performance through defined KPIs and targets, and continuously identify and recommend improvements to support the realisation of ZU's strategy.
* Direct the allocation of budget across the Department and ensure full adherence to approved plans and rectify any deviations in a timely manner.
* Provide the relevant organisational unit with consolidated budget input as required, ensuring that the Department’s requirements are appropriately addressed in the overall budget planning process.


 Operational
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of business development strategies to expand B2B and B2C professional training services in line with University’s objectives.
* Lead the establishment of strategic partnerships with industry, government, and community stakeholders to generate revenue, expand reach, and ensure programme sustainability.
* Lead the development of tailored proposals and promotional strategies to position PaCE as a leading provider.
* Direct the development, planning, and internal coordination of full\-scale and customised training programmes to ensure strategic alignment, resource optimisation, and successful delivery of the same.
* Lead the development and delivery of professional education programmes, including short courses, certifications, and hybrid learning models, to meet evolving market demands.
* Lead the engagement with external subject\-matter experts to maintain high\-quality content development and delivery across all training programmes.
* Lead the development and maintenance of a centralised training catalog and digital infrastructure, including LMS platforms, to ensure seamless access to current and upcoming training offerings.
* Direct institutional compliance by ensuring documentation, reporting, and quality assurance mechanisms across all PaCE training activities.
* Direct institutional initiatives that promote faculty and student participation in entrepreneurial training, venture creation, and business incubation programmes offered by the PaCE department.
* Perform ad\-hoc activities related to the job duties, as requested by the direct supervisor.


 People Management
   

  

* Review consolidated workforce planning reports, talent acquisition strategies, and budgets at the Department level to ensure adequate staffing for optimal operational smoothness, and submit to the appropriate authority for final approval.
* Set performance management objectives for all reportees and perform mid\-year and year\-end performance reviews.
* Identify talent for pivotal roles from a succession management standpoint to ensure business continuity.
* Provide guidance to reporting managers on people management matters.
* Manage organisational units within the Department and ensure effective leadership to adequately manage human capital.


 The Requirements
   

  

* Master's Degree with a minimum of 15 years of experience and at least 10 years in a managerial position.
* Certification in a relevant field is preferred.


 The Benefits
   

  

 The University’s benefits package is highly attractive, with competitive tax\-free salaries in the U.A.E., cash housing, annual vacation airline tickets for the employee and immediate family, educational subsidies for children, and healthcare for the employee and sponsored family members.
   

  

 To Apply
   

  

 In addition to completing the online application form, attach a cover letter, a current CV, and the names and contact details of three professional references.
   

  

 While we appreciate all applications, you will be contacted only if selected for an interview.
   

  

 For any further inquiries, please contact Recruitment@zu.ac.ae

* Mission: Deliver commercially successful, highly buildable, sustainable solutions exceeding clients’ expectations.
* Values: Accountability, Collaboration, Diversity, Entrepreneurship, Integrity, Innovation, Ownership, Respect, Sustainability.

 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Project Manager – Data Centers to lead the delivery of mission\-critical projects across the Middle East region. The role involves managing multidisciplinary design teams, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring successful project delivery from concept through commissioning.
 



  






 Responsibilities
 



* Lead the delivery of hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and mission\-critical data center projects from concept through construction support and commissioning.

* Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams and stakeholders.
* Strong commercial, contractual, and project management skills.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and client\-facing skills.



  






 Preferred Attributes
 



* Experience delivering hyperscale data center campuses.
* Strong understanding of Uptime Institute Tier Standards, TIA\-942, ASHRAE, and mission\-critical design principles.

* Experience delivering projects throughout the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider GCC region.

**Role: Senior Director, AI Commercial Business Partner \- International**

 Do you have an organizational mindset and \-can\-do attitude that enables you to deliver positive outcomes on high impact and complex AI projects? Are you looking to join a growing team that will design and deliver value\-driven change to an organization, do you relish the opportunity to drive wide scale commercial innovation across teams and lead the AI revolution in commercial for AstraZeneca.
   

  

**About AstraZeneca**
 At AstraZeneca, we are proud of our ground\-breaking pipeline and continue to look for new ways to bring the best medicines to patients. We are building and fostering high\-performing collaborative teams across the organization to help us deliver on our ambition. There’s no better time to join our global, growing enterprise as we lead the way for patients, healthcare and broader society.
   

  

**AI Commercial Team (AIC)**
 The AI Commercial team, is part of the newly founded Enterprise AI team (EAI), delivering AI strategy and coordinated commercial progress and programs, in close collaboration with our business teams, and in partnership with our enterprise teams. We lead cross\-functional and commercial\-wide initiatives to deliver transformative commercial value and ensure we are at our best in delivering lifesaving medicines to patients.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 AI Commercial Business Leaders are the embedded “translators” between business functions and the AI Commercial organization, responsible for the success of AI programs. The role is strategically positioned in therapy areas, markets, and functions with the objectives to drive translation, adoption, and lifecycle management of AI solutions in the business.
   

  

 Key deliverables include translating business needs into well\-scoped AI use cases and ensure each solution delivers measurable business impact. This requires you to be bilingual in business/science and technology, enabling you to connect domain priorities with AI delivery teams. You will be responsible for owning the full lifecycle of AI solutions \- from ideation through delivery, adoption, and decommissioning \- and are accountable for driving real, sustained value and reuse.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for building the bridge between business teams at a Region and Market level, and technical experts within the AIC and EAI function as well as key other Enterprise technology teams such as Commercial IT and Global Business Services. As part of this role, you will champion the key commercial AI programs in service of enhancing customer engagement, powered by actionable AI insights, delivered thought agentic platforms. In addition, you will partner on the delivery of AI capability building programs.
   

  

 To do this successfully, you will share geographic location with the respective Region team, have a seat at the Senior leader table for the Region, with connection further enhanced through dotted line reporting to the Region, while sitting on the AIC Leadership team reporting to VP AIC.
   

  

 The International region is the largest, most diverse and fastest growing region in AstraZeneca. It has over 28,000 employees across more than 75 markets, spanning many different cultures and languages. Areas it includes are: Middle East \& Africa, South America, Asia and Australasia.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Strategy and portfolio ownership of new AI Commercial programs for in partnership with the business teams.
* Single point of contact and responsible for engagement for AI Commercial capabilities programs for the Region, maintaining AI roadmaps aligned with business needs, developing business cases in partnership with the business, and promoting reuse principles.
* Translation of needs into AI use cases: Engaging with stakeholders to identify unmet needs and translating these into well\-defined AI use cases with clear metrics and requirements and a clear alignment with business strategy and AI30 focus areas.

data.jd_text:
The Center for Arabic Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Islamic civilization, or a closely related discipline, broadly defined.
   

  

 The successful candidate will also serve as Co\-Chair of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Chair in Arabic Language, AI, and Digital Heritage. The UNESCO Chair promotes interdisciplinary research, education, and international collaboration at the intersection of Arabic language studies, artificial intelligence, and digital heritage preservation. In this role, the candidate will provide academic leadership and build partnerships that advance the Chair’s research, education, and outreach and strengthen its regional and global impact.
   

  

 CASIC draws on AUS’s expertise across academic disciplines to promote innovative, multidisciplinary research on the cultural continuity and diversity of the Arab and Islamic worlds. CASIC aligns its research objectives with key priorities in Sharjah and the UAE, emphasizing the study of the Arabic language, heritage, history, and cultures of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Situated at the heart of the Arab and Islamic worlds and shaped by cultural influences from both East and West, CASIC offers a counterpoint to Western approaches to the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization.
   

  

 CASIC conducts in\-depth research on the region’s history, cultures, arts, contemporary dynamics, and diasporas. Its work will focus on cultural heritage, arts, and architecture; language, literature, and media studies; humanities, performing arts, and visual communication; economy, society, and the digital age. The center seeks to reorient the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization both regionally and globally. CASIC seeks a director with deep knowledge of the culture, history, and contemporary realities of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Proficiency in Islamicate languages is desirable. The director will shape the center’s long\-term strategy, set clear priorities, and foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. The center will build research programs that combine the scholarly traditions of Arab and Islamic civilizations with contemporary methods, applying them to the needs of modern UAE society, the Arab region, and the wider world.
   

  

 AUS offers several educational programs that align with and support CASIC's activities and goals. These programs provide strength in Arabic and Translation Studies; the History and Culture of the Arab World; Islamic Arts and Architecture; Philosophy; Middle Eastern Studies; the Politics and Economy of the Arab World; and Arab Media, Visual Communication, and Performing Arts. CASIC will serve as a central hub, uniting expertise from within AUS and engaging with local and international stakeholders to address cultural and societal issues. The center aims to foster partnerships highlighting Arab and Islamic contributions to global heritage. The center will collaborate closely with organizations such as the Sharjah Art Foundation, the Sharjah Museums Authority, the Sharjah Arabic Language Academy, and others.
   

  

 CASIC’s leadership will build the center into a globally recognized hub for the study of Arab and Islamic civilizations and strengthen AUS’s research profile. The center will prioritize disseminating knowledge, building strategic partnerships with local and international institutions and researchers, and fostering academic collaboration. Furthermore, CASIC will invest in talent development by supporting graduate student research, postdoctoral fellowships, and visiting scholars.
   

  

 Faculty Director candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant field at the time of appointment, demonstrate an excellent record of academic and research leadership, and, ideally, be prepared to relocate to the UAE by
 **December 2026\.**
 As an institution based on the American model of higher education and with English as the medium of instruction, AUS prioritizes candidates with significant experience in similar educational systems.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please fill the application Form
   

  

 The complete application will include the following documents, uploaded as separate files: a letter of application, a curriculum vitae, a list of three referees with contact information, a research statement, a teaching statement, a chapter\- or article\-length publication sample, and evidence of prior research leadership experience.
   

  

 Situated near Sharjah International Airport in the expansive University City area and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, AUS is in a dynamic, cosmopolitan area with abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences, and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 The American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on American models but thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Located in University City, Sharjah, AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to more than 5,800 students from approximately 90 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. AUS has been ranked among the top 10 Arab universities by the QS World University Rankings for the past 9 consecutive years.
   

  

 AUS is licensed, and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.
