data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction
   

  

* Work closely with Engg, Manufacturing systems manager, supply chain and purchasing on new product industrialisation in a timely manner


 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual
* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness


**Role Context**
 The Plant Director operates within a manufacturing environment serving utility, infrastructure, and industrial customers across the Middle East and export markets. The role leads a multi disciplinary operations organisation, overseeing manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance, and HSE, within a competitive, cost sensitive, and delivery driven market.
   

  

 Reporting to the Manufacturing Operations Director, the role works in close collaboration with regional Sales, Projects, Engineering, Procurement, and corporate functions to align plant capability with customer demand, strategic growth plans, and localisation requirements. The position interfaces regularly with local regulatory and governing bodies in Dubai to ensure compliance, certification, and operational continuity, while balancing operational excellence, people development, and long term business sustainability
   

  

**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree or above in management, electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering or related fields.
* Understand manufacturing business, people management, supply chain management, financial management, quality management, and innovation.
* Possess experience in middle or senior management minimum of 10\-15 years.


**Job\-Specific Skills**

* Process Loss Elimination Techniques
* Continuous improvement

* Strong working ethic in the delivery of satisfying the profitable requirements and expectations of internal and external customers.

 We have applied for a DIFC tokenised credit fund and run a live structuring pipeline across receivables, fund and real\-estate mandates in MENA, GCC and selected emerging markets. The structuring lead is a foundational role.
 



  





 AI\-driven playbooks are a core part of Zamanat's growth strategy. We are building a structuring function where AI tools compress time\-to\-launch, accelerate documentation, and turn one\-off deals into repeatable products. The right hire is hungry to learn, prototype and embed AI tooling into the structuring workflow.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Director, Structuring \& Originatio** 
 n to lead deal structuring across Zamanat's live and forward pipeline, originate new mandates, and build the structuring playbook that compresses our time\-to\-launch on every subsequent deal. The role is hands\-on today. It is also on a clear path to Senior Director or MD as deal pipeline, AUM and team scale. The right person executes deals personally now and grows into running a structuring desk over the next 18 to 36 months. This is not a pure origination seat and not a back\-office structuring seat. We need someone who can hold a term sheet, a Sharia structure, a regulator conversation, a sponsor relationship and a documentation pack in the same week.
 



  





  





**What You Will Do** 



* Lead end\-to\-end structuring on live mandates across receivables financing, private credit, fund tokenisation and asset\-backed structures
* Originate new mandates alongside the CEO and BD lead, primarily across MENA, GCC, South Asia and Sub\-Saharan Africa
* Codify Zamanat's structuring playbooks. The 12\-month KPI is three named playbooks in production use
* Build AI\-assisted structuring tooling and templates: use AI to fast\-track documentation, term\-sheet drafting, scenario modelling, Sharia structure checks, and deal pattern recognition across the playbook library
* Own commercial term\-sheet design, fee structures and economic alignment with sponsors and partners
* Run Sharia structuring decisions in close coordination with appointed Sharia advisors. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk, Ijara, Musharaka and hybrid structures as relevant
* Oversee post\-issuance servicing on SME and receivables programmes including servicing, reporting, performance monitoring and remediation triggers
* Work with regulatory counsel and partner licence\-holders on jurisdictional execution (ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA, and selected emerging\-market regulators)
* Manage the deal\-team relationship with fund administrators, custodians, tokenisation tech partners and Sharia advisors
* Build and lead the structuring team as pipeline conversion supports it.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 You ha
 **ve 10 to 14 ye** 
 ars of experience in structured finance, capital markets, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging. You have personally led deals through structuring, documentation and closing, not just sat on the desk while others closed them. You can run the playbook today and build the team that runs it tomorrow.
 



 You understand both the commercial logic of a deal and the structural mechanics that make it executable. You are comfortable with ambiguity, lean teams and shaping a function from scratch. You are hungry to learn and apply AI tooling to your work. You see AI as core leverage on structuring throughput, not a side experiment.
 



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10 to 14 years in structured finance, capital markets, sukuk, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging
* Demonstrable Sharia\-structured execution on live deals. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk or Ijara applied in production, not theoretical.
* Capital markets experience including debt capital markets, sukuk issuance, structured notes or asset\-backed transactions
* Receivables financing, factoring, supply\-chain finance or working\-capital programme experience.
* Strong commercial judgement on term sheets, fee structures and sponsor economics.
* Experience working across ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA or comparable GCC and MENA regulatory environments.
* Ability to manage external counsel, fund administrators, custodians and partner licence\-holders.
* Willingness to learn and embed AI tools in day\-to\-day structuring work. Comfortable using AI for documentation, scenario testing, term\-sheet drafting, structure comparison and pattern recognition across deal libraries.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Private markets experience including private credit funds, real\-estate funds, infrastructure or alternatives
* Tokenisation, digital assets or blockchain\-based issuance exposure
* Direct relationships with mid\-market issuers, sponsors, asset managers and private credit originators across MENA, GCC, South Asia or Sub\-Saharan Africa.
* Prior experience codifying structuring playbooks, templates or repeat\-issuance frameworks.
* Existing exposure to AI tools applied to financial work (deal review, documentation drafting, model build, research synthesis).
* Team build and leadership experience.
* Comfort operating without a large platform underneath, in an early\-stage operating company



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In the first 90 days, you will have taken ownership of the live structuring book, mapped the forward pipeline, locked priority deal sequencing, started the first playbook codification, and identified the first two or three AI tooling levers for the structuring workflow. In the first 12 months, success means closed mandates with locked fee economics, the first three named structuring playbooks in production, AI tooling embedded in at least two playbooks (with measurable time\-to\-launch compression), a working post\-issuance servicing model on receivables programmes, and a hiring case for the next structuring team member.
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation.
* Performance\-linked bonus tied to closed mandates, structuring fee revenue and playbook delivery.
* Equity or carry participation aligned to long\-term value creation
* Clear trajectory to Senior Director or MD as pipeline, AUM and team scale.
* Direct exposure to the CEO, partners, sponsors and Sharia governance.
* A foundational role in building a Sharia\-aligned tokenisation platform from the structuring layer up, with AI tooling embedded into the workflow from inception.

 As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. **About Us** 




 Keeta, the international subsidiary of global delivery leader Meituan, is driven by a clear mission: We help people eat better, live better. Building on our parent company's 16 years of technological and operational expertise mastered in China, we are leading a global transformation in food and consumer product delivery. Since our start in 2023, Keeta has focused on creating value for every part of the communities we serve. We provide a reliable experience for consumers, enhance technology and operations for restaurants, and create more earning opportunities and greater safety for courier partners. This commitment to shared progress drives our journey from Hong Kong, China, across the Middle East and into Brazil, with the world ahead.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



1. Build and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to support logistics operations — providing real\-time visibility across delivery performance, courier efficiency, and supply\-demand balance
2. .Lead deep\-dive analytics on key delivery metrics including ATA (Arrival Time Accuracy), order fulfilment rates, and last\-mile efficiency — translating insights into actionable recommendations for operations teams
3. .Develop quantitative models for capacity planning, workforce scheduling, and demand forecasting to support sustainable growth in the UAE market
4. .Own data storytelling for weekly and monthly business reviews — ensuring KPI visibility and driving alignment across cross\-functional stakeholders
5. .Partner with Product, Operations, and Finance teams to define metrics frameworks, evaluate new initiatives, and embed a data\-driven decision\-making culture
6. .Lead and develop a team of 4–5 data analysts — setting direction, building capability, and fostering a high\-performance analytics culture



  





**What We Need From You** 



* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics, with 2\+ years of team management experience.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one of Python or R — with hands\-on experience building pipelines, dashboards, and analytical models.
* Strong background in internet, technology, or on\-demand platform companies — experience in food delivery, logistics, or last\-mile operations is a strong plus.
* Proven ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Fluency in both English and Chinese (Mandarin) — this role operates across a bilingual team environment.
* Bachelor's degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.



  





**What Makes This Role Exciting** 




 This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of data science and last\-mile delivery operations — with direct impact on how Keeta serves millions of users across the UAE. You'll be reporting into the Head of Logistics and building the data foundation that powers one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East. With a newly formed team and a high\-growth market, this is a genuine opportunity to shape how data\-driven decisions are made at scale — from the ground up.
 



  





**Why Join Keeta** 



* **Global scale, local impact** 
 — Keeta is Meituan's international arm, backed by 16 years of technology and operational expertise, and one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East.
* **Real ownership from day one** 
 — You'll lead a team, shape data infrastructure, and directly influence how the business makes decisions at scale.
* **Work with top talent globally** 
 — Collaborate with teammates from over 40 countries in a fast\-moving, high\-performance environment.
* **Accelerate your career** 
 — We move fast, operate across multiple markets, and give ambitious people the space to grow beyond what a traditional role could offer.

At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.

* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.

**Job Description**
 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.
* Resolve complex technical, interface and systems integration issues across multidisciplinary rail projects.
* Support technical review of contractor submissions, authority submissions and design deliverables.
* Provide technical input during construction, testing and commissioning phases where required.
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**Quality, Safety \& Risk**
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**
* Mentor and develop engineers and discipline leads across the Middle East rail team.
* Collaborate effectively with global rail colleagues and contribute to cross\-region technical excellence.
* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.
* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned and regional best practice across the business.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Civil, Railway or Systems Engineering; a Master’s degree is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.
* Ability to operate confidently in a client\-facing technical leadership role.
* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working across both regional and international rail programmes, including high\-speed rail, metro and light rail.
* Established relationships with key regional rail clients, authorities or delivery partners would be advantageous.

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview**
 The Head of Category will lead the development, execution, and performance of Mumzworld’s category portfolio (maternity, feeding, gear, toys, clothing, etc.). This role holds full accountability for category strategy, P\&L, assortment curation, vendor and brand partnerships, pricing, inventory lifecycle management, and cross\-functional delivery across the UAE and KSA to drive sustainable growth, profitability, and an outstanding customer experience.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Strategy \& P\&L Management**
* Define and deliver a 12–24–36 month category roadmap aligned with Mumzworld’s vision, identifying growth segments and white spaces.
* Own full P\&L, driving revenue growth and market share while optimizing margins, COGS, promotions, markdowns, and returns.
* Present performance, risks, and strategic initiatives to Leadership and Board; ensure compliance with UAE/KSA regulations.


**Assortment \& Partnerships**
* Curate optimal assortment (brands, SKUs, exclusives), rationalize underperforming lines, and manage lifecycle.
* Source, negotiate, and onboard local and global brands; secure competitive terms, exclusives, and co\-marketing opportunities.
* Design pricing, promotions, and bundling strategies to optimize conversion, margin, and customer value.


**Supply Chain, Digital \& Ops**
* Partner with Demand Planning and Fulfillment to ensure optimal stock availability and inventory efficiency.
* Work with Product, UX, and Merchandising teams to optimize digital shelf experience for English and Arabic users.
* Use data insights (basket size, conversion, churn, returns, competitor trends) to refine strategy and execution.


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing category team across UAE and KSA, fostering a data\-driven culture.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Logistics, Finance, and Tech to deliver end\-to\-end category initiatives.


 What you"ll be doing
   

  

 As the Head of Categories, you will take full ownership of Mumzworld's product portfolio strategy and financial performance across the UAE and KSA markets. On a day\-to\-day basis, you will drive top\-line growth and optimize profit margins while leading a high\-performing regional team of category managers and merchandisers. You will act as the primary commercial engine—sourcing global brands, negotiating exclusive partnerships, and designing pricing structures that convert. Beyond the financials, you will collaborate closely with supply chain teams to ensure perfect inventory availability, and partner with the digital UX team to ensure our bilingual platform offers a seamlessly curated, discoverable shopping experience for millions of families.
   

  

**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Experience: Minimum 8–12 years in category management, merchandising, or retail, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role owning a multi\-million dollar P\&L.
* E\-Commerce Acumen: Proven track record in digital retail, marketplace, or omni\-channel environments. Deep familiarity with the UAE and KSA e\-commerce landscape is essential.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA is highly preferred.
* Analytical Skillset: Highly proficient in utilizing data, metrics, dashboards, and financial modeling to drive forecasting and trend analysis.
* Language: Professional fluency in English is required; an Arabic bilingual advantage is highly valued.


 Why Us
   

  

 Join Mumzworld to lead a high\-impact category function in a fast\-growing regional market leader and shape the future of family e\-commerce in the Middle East.

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to lead a busy Operations Control Centre that coordinates operational safety, efficiency and resilience across our network? At
 **SolitAir** 
 , we’re seeking an experienced and adaptable leader to establish and head the Integrated Operations Control Centre (IOCC). This role will set the strategy, build the team, and oversee integrated operational control functions that ensure safe, compliant and on\-time service delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**As Head Of IOCC, You Will**
* Establish and operationally manage the IOCC, including staffing, processes, tools and performance metrics to deliver 24/7 operational control.
* Lead cross\-functional coordination between flight operations, maintenance control, ground operations, cargo planning, safety, and regulatory liaison to resolve disruptions and maintain continuity.
* Drive problem solving for complex operational events by applying structured analysis, root cause identification, and timely corrective actions to minimise impact on safety and schedule.
* Develop flexible operating procedures and escalation frameworks to respond to dynamic operational conditions, including irregular operations, AOG events and severe weather.
* Implement and maintain integrated systems and dashboards that provide real\-time situational awareness and decision support for IOCC staff and senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, capturing lessons learned, training requirements and process enhancements to reduce recurrence of operational disruptions.
* Ensure all IOCC activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements and company policies, and coordinate timely reporting to regulators and stakeholders as required.
* Provide clear, effective communication in English across internal teams and external partners during normal and contingency operations.


****What We’re Looking For****
* Experience: Proven background in airline or aviation operational control roles, with significant experience leading operational teams and managing irregular operations.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical capability and structured problem solving skills, able to lead investigations, define root causes and implement robust corrective actions.
* Flexibility: Demonstrated adaptability to changing priorities and operational pressures; comfortable leading a 24/7 function with variable hours and rapid decision\-making demands. This means you are likely to work over weekends and/or evenings as operational demands require.
* English: Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear reports, brief senior leadership and communicate effectively across diverse teams.
* Leadership \& Communication: Strong people leadership skills, able to recruit, develop and motivate a high\-performing, inclusive team; confident at stakeholder engagement and crisis communication.
* Systems \& Data: Comfortable with operational control systems, real\-time dashboards and data\-driven decision making; experience with industry tools is desirable.
* Qualifications: Relevant degree or professional qualifications in aviation, operations management or related field preferred.


 At SolitAir, every role contributes to shaping the future of cargo aviation. data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Job Purpose
   

  

 Mashreq – Beyond Banking Team
   

  

 Beyond Banking is a core capability within Mashreq’s Ecosystems \& Platform Banking tribe, focused on building fintech‑integrated, non‑financial services and experiences that deepen customer engagement, loyalty, and lifetime value. Through partner‑powered journeys and marketplace\-led solutions—spanning travel, digital services, lifestyle and commerce—Beyond Banking transforms Mashreq from a transaction\- and yield‑led bank into a relationship‑led, lifestyle fintech platform and digital companion.
   

  

 Operating as a horizontal squad serving all customer segments (NEO, Gold, Private), Beyond Banking diversifies income streams through non‑interest revenues, drives platform economics, and accelerates Mashreq’s evolution into a scalable, ecosystem‑driven financial services platform.
   

  

 The Role – Product Owner, Beyond Banking, Mashreq
   

  

 The Product Owner – Beyond Banking is a senior product leadership role responsible for owning the delivery, evolution, and commercial success of Mashreq’s Beyond Banking propositions. Reporting directly to the Global Head of Beyond Banking, this role acts as the end\-to\-end owner of the Beyond Banking product backlog, particularly connectivity (eSIM) and travel solutions, translating Group\-level strategy into executable roadmaps and high\-quality customer\-facing solutions.
   

  

 The role exists to ensure that Mashreq’s Beyond Banking initiatives—spanning non\-financial services, ecosystem partnerships, and marketplace propositions—are delivered at scale, deeply integrated into Mashreq’s fintech platforms, and commercially impactful across customer segments (NEO, Gold, Private) and geographies.
   

  

 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, the Product Owner is accountable for maximizing customer value, driving partner\-led innovation, and ensuring disciplined agile delivery in a complex, multi\-stakeholder environment.
   

  

**Product Scope (In\-Scope)**
 The role is responsible for Mashreq’s Beyond Banking portfolio, encompassing multiple propositions aligned and integrated into the bank’s core banking and financial services products, technology and infrastructure, including but not limited to:
   

  

* Beyond Banking digital propositions tightly integrated into Mashreq’s fintech portfolio
* Global and regional digital services (e.g., international/ travel eSIM, other connectivity products, productivity and intelligence tools, streaming services).
* Travel propositions, including travel portals, OTA integrations, bundled travel packages, direct partnerships with travel providers and ancillary travel products.
* As Mashreq is expanding across new geographies, this role will also be responsible to expand Beyond Banking propositions and solutions in line with local customers’ needs.


 Dimensions
   

  

 Geographical scope: UAE, Egypt, Pakistan and other markets, as required
   

  

 Key Results Areas
   

  

* Own and drive the delivery of customer\-centric, scalable, and revenue\-generating Beyond Banking propositions, focusing on travel solutions, namely international eSIM and travel portal.
* Translate Beyond Banking strategy and vision into clear roadmaps, epics, user stories, and release plans.
* Maximize commercial outcomes through strong backlog prioritization aligned to customer impact, revenue, and strategic value.
* Ensure Beyond Banking propositions are deeply integrated into Mashreq’s digital channels and core fintech products.
* Lead day\-to\-day execution with technology and design squads, ensuring high quality, timely, and compliant delivery.
* Establish and track product OKRs and success metrics in line with Beyond Banking performance frameworks.
* Support partner onboarding, integration, and commercialization alongside strategic partnerships teams.


 Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships
   

  

**Team \& Squad Context**
* Acts as Product Owner for the Beyond Banking squad.
* Owns and prioritizes the product backlog across multiple initiatives.
* Works closely with engineers, designers, QA, data, risk, legal, and commercial stakeholders.
* Coordinates with dotted\-line market counterparts for localization and rollout.


**Operating Environment**
* Agile, platform\-centric, and innovation\-led
* High degree of autonomy within a matrixed, enterprise\-wide setup
* Strong emphasis on speed\-to\-market, scalability, and commercial discipline


**Key Working Relationships**
* Global Head of Beyond Banking (strategy, prioritization, performance alignment)
* Ecosystems \& Platform Banking leadership
* Technology, Architecture, and Engineering teams
* Strategic Partnerships and Commercial teams
* Customer Experience, Design, Data \& Analytics
* Risk, Compliance, Legal and Procurement
* Local market teams for proposition localization


 Problem Solving \& Delivery Ownership
   

  

* Translate ambiguous strategy into structured, executable product plans
* Balance competing priorities across customer experience, commercial returns, platform scalability, and risk
* Proactively identify delivery risks, dependency bottlenecks, and execution trade\-offs
* Continuously refine propositions based on customer insights, data, and market feedback
* Operate with a hands\-on mindset to unblock teams and maintain delivery momentum


 Decision Making Authority \& Responsibility
   

  

* Own prioritization of the Beyond Banking product backlog in alignment with strategic and commercial goals
* Make day\-to\-day product and delivery decisions within agreed governance and risk frameworks
* Influence partner selection, feature sequencing, and go\-to\-market readiness
* Escalate and resolve strategic trade\-offs in collaboration with the Global Head of Beyond Banking
* Ensure all delivered propositions comply with Mashreq policies, regulatory standards, and platform principles


**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**
* 10\+ years’ experience in digital product management, with at least 5 years in senior product owner / lead product roles
* Proven experience delivering platform\-based, ecosystem, or marketplace propositions (fintech or adjacent sectors)
* Strong understanding of digital banking, embedded finance, and non\-financial ecosystem models
* Demonstrated expertise in Agile / Scrum product ownership and backlog management
* Solid commercial acumen, with experience building business cases and measuring ROI
* Ability to operate effectively in complex, cross\-functional, multi\-market environments
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills
* Hands\-on, resilient, and execution\-focused mindset
* Experience working with external partners and third\-party integrations is essential


 Job Details
   

  

 Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full\-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: http://www.mashreq.com/rise Job Function: Product Management Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: Other

**About the Company:** 




 At Almosafer Travel \& Tourism Co, we’re not just part of the travel industry, we’re helping shape its future.
   

 As Saudi Arabia’s leading travel company, we serve millions across every segment of the travel and tourism ecosystem.
   

 Rooted in our name “Almosafer,” meaning the traveler, we strive to make every journey seamless, personal, and purposeful. Our diverse platforms and services are built to deliver enriching experiences that reflect the spirit of Saudi Arabia and the wider region.
   

 We’re united by a bold vision:
   

 To be the undisputed leader in travel services, fostering lasting connections and setting new benchmarks for excellence in the Kingdom and beyond.
   

 Our team across Saudi Arabia and the wider region blends deep cultural understanding with forward\-thinking innovation, shaping a new standard for travel in the region. 
 



**About the Role:** 




 The Product Manager is responsible for gathering and challenging business requirements and translating them into solutions with the guidance of our Head of Salesforce Product. The Product Manager has experience implementing Salesforce.com functionality and acts as a knowledgeable liaison between business stakeholders and developers.
 



 The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, implementation teams, integration/development teams, and quality assurance teams to ensure successful delivery and continuous enhancement of the Salesforce ecosystem.
 



**Responsibilities:** 



* Act as a consultant to the business with advanced knowledge of Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Salesforce Community
* Translate business requirements into user stories and well\-architected solutions that leverage Salesforce platforms and products
* Provide detailed level\-of\-effort estimates and articulate benefits and risks of proposed solutions
* Collaborate with and manage Salesforce Developers to define appropriate technical strategies and designs

data.jd_text:
Are you ready to lead a busy Operations Control Centre that coordinates operational safety, efficiency and resilience across our network? At
 **SolitAir** 
 , we’re seeking an experienced and adaptable leader to establish and head the Integrated Operations Control Centre (IOCC). This role will set the strategy, build the team, and oversee integrated operational control functions that ensure safe, compliant and on\-time service delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
 As Head of IOCC, you will:
   

  

* Establish and operationally manage the IOCC, including staffing, processes, tools and performance metrics to deliver 24/7 operational control.
* Lead cross\-functional coordination between flight operations, maintenance control, ground operations, cargo planning, safety, and regulatory liaison to resolve disruptions and maintain continuity.
* Drive problem solving for complex operational events by applying structured analysis, root cause identification, and timely corrective actions to minimise impact on safety and schedule.
* Develop flexible operating procedures and escalation frameworks to respond to dynamic operational conditions, including irregular operations, AOG events and severe weather.
* Implement and maintain integrated systems and dashboards that provide real\-time situational awareness and decision support for IOCC staff and senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, capturing lessons learned, training requirements and process enhancements to reduce recurrence of operational disruptions.
* Ensure all IOCC activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements and company policies, and coordinate timely reporting to regulators and stakeholders as required.
* Provide clear, effective communication in English across internal teams and external partners during normal and contingency operations.


****What We’re Looking For****
* Experience: Proven background in airline or aviation operational control roles, with significant experience leading operational teams and managing irregular operations.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical capability and structured problem solving skills, able to lead investigations, define root causes and implement robust corrective actions.
* Flexibility: Demonstrated adaptability to changing priorities and operational pressures; comfortable leading a 24/7 function with variable hours and rapid decision\-making demands. This means you are likely to work over weekends and/or evenings as operational demands require.
* English: Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear reports, brief senior leadership and communicate effectively across diverse teams.
* Leadership \& Communication: Strong people leadership skills, able to recruit, develop and motivate a high\-performing, inclusive team; confident at stakeholder engagement and crisis communication.
* Systems \& Data: Comfortable with operational control systems, real\-time dashboards and data\-driven decision making; experience with industry tools is desirable.
* Qualifications: Relevant degree or professional qualifications in aviation, operations management or related field preferred.


 At SolitAir, every role contributes to shaping the future of cargo aviation. We welcome applicants who bring practical experience, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to operational excellence. This is a gender neutral role and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for all candidates.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* An inclusive workplace with opportunities for professional growth and development.
* The chance to build and lead a new, and growing, high\-impact operational function at the heart of our business.
* A role that offers visibility and cross functional problem solving \- at SolitAir you'll be able to see the difference you make to the success of our business


 If you are an experienced operational leader with strong problem solving skills, flexibility and excellent English communication, we encourage you to apply and help shape SolitAir’s operational future.

The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. ****Job Requirements****

* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.

Desert River Event Rentals is one of the UAE's leading event rental companies, supplying premium furniture, lighting and décor to exhibitions, conferences, corporate events, hospitality venues and brand experiences across the region.
 



 Our reputation is built on reliability, attention to detail and exceptional service. Behind every successful event is a strong operations team, and we are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to lead, develop and continuously improve ours.
 



 This role reports directly to the Head of Event Rentals and plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth delivery of projects across warehouse operations, logistics, transportation and on\-site event execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Operational Leadership** 



* Lead, coach and develop the operations team across warehouse, logistics and event delivery
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, professionalism and continuous improvement
* Set clear expectations, monitor performance and support team development
* Recruit, train and onboard operational team members as the business grows



  





**Event Delivery \& Logistics** 



* Plan and oversee the successful delivery, installation and collection of rental equipment across multiple projects and venues
* Coordinate staff schedules, vehicle allocation and operational resources to ensure efficient execution
* Manage on\-site operations and provide leadership during installations, event periods and dismantles
* Act as the primary operational decision\-maker when challenges arise and ensure issues are resolved quickly and professionally



  





**Warehouse \& Inventory Management** 



* Oversee warehouse operations, inventory accuracy, maintenance processes and quality control standards
* Ensure rental assets are maintained, repaired and presented to the highest standard
* Continuously improve operational workflows, systems and procedures to increase efficiency and scalability
* Work closely with procurement, suppliers and transport partners to ensure reliable operational support



  





**Health, Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure all operations are conducted in accordance with company policies, venue requirements and industry best practices
* Maintain strong standards around health and safety, risk management, security procedures and operational compliance
* Ensure teams are properly briefed and equipped to work safely and professionally at all times
* Maintain awareness of venue regulations, access requirements and event\-specific operational procedures



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with the Sales team to ensure client expectations are translated into successful operational delivery
* Build strong working relationships with clients, venues, contractors and suppliers
* Contribute operational insight and recommendations that improve both customer experience and business performance



  





**About You** 




 You are a confident and approachable operational leader who enjoys working alongside your team and takes pride in delivering outstanding results. You combine strong organisational skills with practical problem\-solving ability and remain calm and decisive in fast\-paced environments.
 



 You will ideally have:
 


* A minimum of 3–5 years' experience in an operational leadership or management role within event rentals, event production, exhibitions, logistics or a related industry
* Proven experience leading, developing and managing operational teams
* Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, logistics planning and project execution
* Practical understanding of event operations, venue requirements, health and safety procedures, security protocols and risk management
* Experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high operational standards
* Excellent organisational, communication and leadership skills

* The ability to build trust and credibility with colleagues, clients and partners
* A collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively within multicultural teams
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the importance of customer satisfaction, efficiency and profitability



  





**Requirements** 



* Based in the UAE
* Valid UAE manual driving licence
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken
* Flexible regarding working hours and event schedules
* Strong Microsoft Office skills
* Event industry experience strongly preferred



  





**Our Culture** 




 At Desert River, we believe exceptional events are created by exceptional people working together. We value teamwork, integrity, initiative, respect and continuous improvement. We support each other, take ownership of our responsibilities and celebrate success as a team.
 



 We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives can thrive.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 We offer the opportunity to play a key role in one of the UAE's leading event rental businesses, working on a diverse range of projects for some of the region's most recognised brands, venues and events.
 



 In addition, we offer:
 


* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Five\-day working week
* UAE employment visa sponsorship
* Annual flight allowance
* Opportunities for professional growth and career development
* A collaborative, creative and supportive working environment

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)

* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

 PXGEO is an innovative marine geophysical service provider combining the strengths of ocean bottom and towed streamer seismic data acquisition techniques to deliver seamless subsurface imaging for a sustainable future.
   

  

****What's the role?****
 The official job title is Head of Sources and Mechanical Handling based in Dubai, UAE.
   

  

 The role is responsible for leading the seismic source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck activities of the Company to support the delivery of best\-in\-class fleet performance. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Mechanical handling, source and NHV technical support
* Manage a department of support staff (mechanical/Instrument and field\-based engineers) to provide first line technical and operational support to vessels and onshore departments as directed
* Maintain source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck specifications and standards for marine acquisition projects
* Develop, maintain, and improve the Company's seismic source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck technology and technique with a focus on environmental, safety, and operational efficiency and excellence
* Keep abreast of changes in source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck technology and proactively make recommendations to Management for enhanced service offerings
* Manage key suppliers of related technical services
* Monitor mechanical and back deck department spending, procurement and prepare budgetary forecasts for new technology
* Monitor mechanical and back deck related downtime across fleet and implement programs to reduce this as far as practical
* Develop and maintain Competency catalogue for the technical department personnel (onshore and offshore)
* Support Human Resources in the selection and development of mechanical and Instrument personnel
* Ensure that the Company management system is implemented, adhered to, measured, and improved by all in the related tech department organization
* Assist in responding to technical queries for tenders
* Assist in marketing in the related technical services to Clients.
* Frequent international travel, sometimes at short notice
* Occasional visits to, and onboard vessels
* Fulfill their assigned responsibilities as part of the Emergency Response team in line with the Emergency Response Plan and duty list as required


****Who are we looking for?****
* Has detailed knowledge of, and extensive experience with, marine seismic survey methods and technologies relating to towing and handling and sources
* At least degree level in an engineering or related discipline or equivalent experience
* As frequent travelers conduct vessel visits: BOSIET or FOET certification is required

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

The selected individual will have the opportunity to develop and articulate a vision and long\-range plan for the department in teaching and in research strategy that embodies the relevant areas that are vital to the department and the region. Special consideration will be given to candidates with a clear vision and achievable goals that are in line with the college’s and university’s strategic plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

data.jd_text:
**Confidential Opportunity – Head of Risk (UAE Regulated Financial Services)** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced Head of Risk to join a growing regulated financial services organization in the UAE.
 



  





 This is a unique opportunity for a risk leader who enjoys building, shaping, and scaling risk functions within a fast\-paced environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall risk management framework of the business while remaining closely involved in the operational execution of risk management activities.
 



 The role is subject to regulatory approval and fit\-and\-proper assessment by the relevant UAE regulatory authority. The successful candidate will serve as the designated Head of Risk and principal risk management officer for the organization
 



  





 Unlike larger financial institutions with extensive risk departments, this position requires a balance of strategic leadership and hands\-on execution. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating at Board and regulator level while also driving the day\-to\-day development and enhancement of the risk function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and continuously enhance the Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERM)
* Develop and maintain risk governance structures, policies, and reporting frameworks
* Establish and monitor risk appetite statements, risk registers, and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)
* Lead enterprise\-wide risk assessments across operational, regulatory, technology, strategic, and emerging risks
* Prepare and present risk reporting to Executive Committees, Risk Committees, and Board\-level forums
* Act as the primary risk management contact for regulatory engagement and supervisory reviews
* Provide effective challenge and risk oversight across business functions
* Build and develop the Risk function in line with the organization's growth trajectory
* Support the development of a strong risk culture across the organization



  





**Required Experience** 



* 8\-15 years of progressive risk management experience within regulated financial services
* Experience leading or owning an Enterprise Risk Management Framework
* Strong understanding of risk governance, risk appetite, risk assessments, and Board reporting
* Experience within fintech, payments, banking, EMI, acquiring, issuing, lending, or other regulated financial services environments
* Demonstrated experience engaging with regulators, executive management, and governance committees
* Ability to operate effectively in a growth\-stage environment where strategic and operational responsibilities coexist



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 You will be a strong match if you have:
 


* Previously held a Head of Risk, Risk Director, Senior Risk Manager, or equivalent position within a regulated financial services environment
* Experience building or enhancing risk frameworks rather than simply maintaining mature structures
* The credibility and capability to satisfy regulatory fit\-and\-proper requirements for a Head of Risk appointment
* A pragmatic and commercial approach to risk management
* The willingness to remain involved in operational delivery while leading the strategic direction of the function


- 


**Please Note** 




 This role is best suited to candidates who enjoy combining strategic leadership with hands\-on execution. Individuals whose experience is limited to highly specialized risk functions within large organizations, or whose background is primarily audit, compliance advisory, assurance, or consulting without direct ownership of enterprise risk management, may find the scope and nature of this position less aligned to their experience.
 



 All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence

data.jd_text:
The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East. This is a key role within the Middle East team. The successful candidate will bring substantial EA experience, gained within an international Law Firm(s) based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9 00am to 6 00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
   

  




  


  

  

 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
   

  

 Please note that, as part of the recruitment process, successful shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete Numeracy, Comprehension and Prioritisation assessments, which will take approximately 60 minutes in total.
   

  




  


**Please apply directly through with your application and kindly only contact our Recruitment team for any further details, legal experiance is essential part of the criteria for this role.**
  

  
   

  




  


 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Executive support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This may include but is not limited to the following
   

  

 •Proactively manage the Head of Middle East’s complex and high‑volume diary, including scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, often involving numerous senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
   

  

 •Act as a gatekeeper for the Head of Middle East, triaging meeting requests, queries, issues and complaints, redirecting appropriately while ensuring matters are dealt with effectively and without unnecessary involvement from the Head.
   

  

 •Prepare agendas, attend meetings where the Head of Middle East is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and proactively follow up with action owners to ensure completion within agreed timeframes.
   

  

 •Attend additional meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head of Middle East where appropriate, independently managing follow‑up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East with strategic and commercial decision‑making by proactively preparing briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to ensure decisions are well‑informed.
   

  

 •Anticipate information requirements and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams to ensure relevant input is available in advance of key meetings or decisions.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation
   

  

 •Arrange end‑to‑end complex travel for the Head of Middle East, including multi‑destination international itineraries, coordination of different modes of transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
   

  

 •Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction‑specific requirements.
   

  

 •Provide strategic input into travel planning, designing trips that maximise effectiveness by combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
   

  

 •Liaise extensively with colleagues across offices and business functions to ensure a joined‑up firm approach and maximise the value of each trip.
   

  

 •Remain flexible and responsive, managing last‑minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently when required.
   

  

 •Prepare detailed post‑trip reports summarising meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities identified and agreed next steps, for circulation to relevant internal stakeholders.
   

  

 •Ensure all follow‑up meetings and actions arising from travel are diarised promptly, tracked and progressed to completion.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Marketing / Business Development Support
   

  

 •Manage speaking engagements and thought‑leadership commitments, including tracking article and submission deadlines, coordinating preparatory research, and drafting briefing materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
   

  

 •Arrange and coordinate preparatory and briefing meetings in advance of panels, speaking slots or publications, ensuring the Head of Middle East is fully prepared.
   

  

 •Liaise with the Knowledge team and other internal stakeholders to obtain research support and background material where required, to ensure contributions are accurate, relevant and high quality.
   

  

 •Register the Head of Middle East for events when instructed and prepare comprehensive pre‑event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives, to maximise the value of attendance.
   

  

 •Working with the Head of Middle East and Business Development teams to maintain up‑to‑date client target lists.
   

  

 •Track and maintain updates on client target status, ensuring actions and deliverables assigned to relationship partners are followed up and progressed.
   

  

 •Provide regular status updates to the Head of Middle East on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against agreed objectives.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Billing, Finance \& Expenses
   

  

 •Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head of Middle East’s matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
   

  

 •Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance as required, and issue final approved invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
   

  

 •Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of expense submissions for the Head of Middle East, including liaising directly with vendors (restaurants and transport providers etc) to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where receipts were not provided or have been misplaced.
   

  

 •Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget holder approval in line with firm policy.
   

  

 •Proactively follow up with clients regarding outstanding invoices and payments, providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East and keeping the Billing and Finance teams fully informed of progress, issues or agreed payment timelines.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Performance \& People Processes
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East throughout the performance review process, ensuring review meetings are scheduled in line with firm‑wide deadlines.
   

  

 •Prepare performance review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
   

  

 •Proactively monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
   

  

 •Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head of Middle East during discussions.
   

  

 •Support completion of post‑meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, ensuring timely and accurate submission.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of outstanding actions arising from performance reviews.
   

  

 •Maintain close and regular communication with HR throughout the performance review cycle, ensuring awareness of progress, confirming deadlines, understanding process or system changes, and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 CRM \& Relationship Management
   

  

 •Maintain and update the Head of Middle East’s contacts and relationship data in InterAction, ensuring activities, meetings and relationship notes are accurately recorded.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in managing and maintaining effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers, supporting collaboration across jurisdictions.
   

  

 •Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring referrals are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in ensuring referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow‑up on agreed actions and opportunities.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Recruitment \& Business Operations Liaison
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of Middle East recruitment activity, liaising with HR and providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Act as a key coordination point with Business Operations functions (HR, Finance, BD, Compliance, IT and Operations), ensuring strong communication, alignment and effective delivery of initiatives impacting the region.
   

  

 •Establish regular Middle East Operations meetings, ensuring all Business Operations functions are kept informed, aligned and engaged on regional matters.
   

  

 •Use these forums to share relevant knowledge or developments that may impact specific functions, agree deliverables, and capture upcoming activities, deadline changes and requirements that should be on the Head of Middle East’s radar.
   

  

 •Ensure key outputs from Middle East Operations meetings are fed into agendas and briefing materials for wider Middle East leadership or team meetings, promoting alignment and proactive planning across the region.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Person Specification
   

  

 •Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal PA or similar role supporting a senior Partner or regional lead, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
   

  

 •Demonstrable experience managing complex diaries and multi‑time‑zone scheduling for senior stakeholders.
   

  

 •Strong experience arranging complex international travel, including multi‑destination itineraries, visas and short‑notice changes.
   

  

 •Experience supporting billing and financial processes, including preparation of draft bills, liaising with Finance and following up on client payments.
   

  

 •Experience supporting people and performance review processes, including scheduling review meetings, preparing documentation and assisting with system requirements.
   

  

 •Experience working closely with HR, Finance, BD, Compliance and other Business Operations teams, with the ability to coordinate and track actions effectively.
   

  

 •Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
   

  

 •Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence drafting correspondence and reports on behalf of a senior leader.
   

  

 •Ability to exercise sound judgement, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive matters.
   

  

 •Proactive, flexible and resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
   

  

 •Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience using practice management, CRM and expense management systems.
   

  

 •Professional, client‑focused approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with senior internal stakeholders and clients.
   

  

 •Fluent written and spoken English.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Benefits include (but are not limited to)
   

  

 •Competitive salary (negotiable depending on experience)
   

  

 •Premium international medical, dental, and optical insurance
   

  

 •30 days of annual leave
   

  

 •Employee Assistance Programme
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Competencies
   

  

 •Working together
   

  

 •Integrity and respect
   

  

 •Inclusive
   

  

 •Personal impact and growth
   

  

 •Driving high standards
   

  

 •Commercial mindset
   

  

 •Client \- centric
   

  

 •Responsible
