**Director of Marketing \& Business Development – Health, Wellness** 




**Relocation to Chiang Mai, Thailand** 




**$100,000 \+ Negotiable based on experience** 




**Seeking candidates with experience of driving medical tourism** 




  





**The Organisation** 




  





 This is a rare opportunity to join one of Asia's most established and respected residential rehabilitation groups — an organisation with a 10 year\+ heritage of transforming lives, treating thousands of clients from more than 20 countries, and building a reputation as the premium destination of choice for individuals seeking discreet, high\-quality addiction and mental health care.
 



  





 The business operates a flagship 30\-bed residential site and has recently expanded into Europe with a specialist 10\-bed programme — reflecting an ambitious international growth agenda under the leadership of a highly experienced CEO with a background in world\-class medical tourism operations.
 



  





 The model is built on medical tourism: clients travel from the UK, Australia, the Middle East, Singapore, the Netherlands, the US, and Canada to access a programme that delivers demonstrably better outcomes at approximately 40% of the cost of comparable UK providers — with private rooms, comprehensive clinical programming, and a destination environment that facilitates genuine recovery.
 



  





 The business is profitable, growing, and entering its most commercially ambitious phase to date. This hire is central to that next chapter.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 The Director of Marketing and Business Development is a senior, commercially critical appointment reporting directly to the CEO. You will own the full growth engine of the business — leading both the Sales (Admissions \& Strategic Partnerships) and Marketing (Digital, Content \& Brand) functions, and driving high\-quality client acquisition across the group's international markets.
 



  





 You will inherit a talented, technically capable four\-person marketing team based in Thailand, supported by a specialist external SEO agency. Your role is to lead, elevate, and execute — bringing strategic rigour, digital expertise, and commercial edge to a business that has earned its reputation through exceptional clinical outcomes and now needs to accelerate its market presence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales \& Revenue Growth** 



* Own and deliver revenue performance across all markets and service lines
* Lead the Admissions function to ensure a seamless, high\-conversion client journey
* Expand the international referral network — outpatient centres, clinicians, concierge providers, and wellness operators
* Develop targeted growth strategies across the UK, Australia, Asia, Middle East, and US
* Represent the organisation at international forums and industry events



  





**Marketing \& Digital Acquisition** 



* Lead the internal marketing team and external agency partners
* Drive performance across online search, AI\-driven discovery platforms, SEO, and digital channels
* Own the content strategy across all pillars: search, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and thought leadership
* Improve visibility on AI discovery platforms where the business is currently underrepresented
* Maintain rigorous oversight of ROI, attribution, and brand integrity



  





**Brand \& Thought Leadership** 



* Elevate the organisation's reputation as a recognised authority in addiction treatment and mental health care
* Lead content creation that reflects the business's evolution toward holistic, nervous system\-informed, mental health\-integrated approaches
* Ensure a consistent, premium brand voice across all touchpoints and markets
* Strengthen trust through PR, media, strategic partnerships, and expert positioning

 Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

**Medical Devices**
 Our medical devices help more than 10,000 people have healthier hearts, improve quality of life for thousands of people living with chronic pain and movement disorders, and liberate more than 500,000 people with diabetes from routine ﬁngersticks.
   

  

**About Diabetes Care**
 We’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life\-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better\-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.
   

  

 Abbott Diabetes Care (ADC) Division is looking for a Market Access Manager\-Gulf region based in UAE

 Primary function\-

* Position will own the responsibility to achieve market access and reimbursement for new ADC products (formulary listening, coding, coverage \& pricing.)
* Position will establish and leverage critical relationships to key market access stakeholders, developing customer intimacy and aiming for mutually beneficially partnership opportunities.
* Position reports to the Country Manager and will interact with the Business Unit Heads in the targeted countries for this position, the relevant team members in those countries and global market access team.


 What you'll do\-
   

  

* Ensures that all activities are performed in compliance with quality system requirements.
* Accelerate hospital enlisting after\-market authorization.

* Building a strong partnership with KO Ls in the field of diabetes across gulf.
* Support public affairs and reimbursement.
* Establish and leverage critical relationships to key market access stakeholders, developing customer intimacy and aiming for mutually beneficial partnership opportunities.

* Work closely with the Market Access Director and the ADC Management team to deliver and support all strategic goals.
* Identify areas where the Mega opportunities for product growth lie.
* Clarifies key stakeholders' product specific value propositions.
* Match pricing target with key stakeholders' value propositions.

* Required : Advanced Degree in Science, Economics or related areas.
* Preferred : Master's Degree in Business Administration, Public Health, Health Economics, or Health policy.


**Background**
* Broad knowledge of the Countries' reimbursement systems.
* Robust understanding of national reimbursement authorities including localized decisions and the ongoing changes that could affect the commercial goals.
* Demonstrable track record in working with KOLs/reimbursement stakeholders in influencing product guidelines, removing barriers to ensure products are used in key centers.
* Market Access experience preferably within Medical Devices/Pharma sector.
* Tender Management experience.
* Demonstrated ability to influence relationships and leverage knowledge internally across a matrix structure to optimize opportunities with customers and achieve shared goals.
* Ability to influence internally at all levels without line management authority.
* Ability to influence external customers at all levels.

* IT literate.

data.jd_text:
Our client is a UAE\-based investment group with a diversified portfolio spanning multiple high\-growth industries. They are seeking an experienced
 **Finance Director/CFO** 
 to lead their global finance function and operational infrastructure. As the organisation continues to expand across multiple jurisdictions, this role will be instrumental in establishing institutional\-grade financial processes, governance frameworks, and reporting standards while supporting strategic growth initiatives.
 



  





**Role Requirement** 




 This is a highly strategic yet hands\-on leadership position that extends beyond traditional finance responsibilities, encompassing operations, compliance, corporate structuring, and executive support. The successful candidate will work closely with the firm's principals and play a key role in shaping the financial and operational framework of the business.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Financial Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Design, implement, and oversee robust financial policies, controls, and reporting frameworks across multiple international entities.
* Lead the firm's overall financial strategy, ensuring scalability, transparency, and operational excellence.
* Develop and maintain sophisticated cash flow forecasts, budgeting processes, and financial planning models.
* Provide strategic financial insights and recommendations to senior leadership to support investment and business decisions.



  





**Accounting \& Financial Reporting** 



* Oversee all accounting operations, including general ledger management, reconciliations, month\-end and year\-end close processes.
* Consolidate financial statements across multiple jurisdictions and corporate structures.
* Ensure timely and accurate statutory and management reporting in accordance with IFRS and relevant accounting standards.
* Monitor and manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations across the group's entities



  





**Investment \& Portfolio Oversight** 



* Prepare detailed reporting for principals covering portfolio performance, consolidated assets, liquidity positions, and investment metrics.
* Review financial models, business plans, and due diligence materials relating to existing and prospective investments.
* Support investment decisions through financial analysis and commercial evaluation.
* Assist portfolio companies with fundraising initiatives, financial modelling, corporate finance structuring, and investor engagement where required.



  





**Compliance, Corporate Structuring \& Governance** 



* Oversee compliance across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring adherence to local and international regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate corporate structuring initiatives, including SPVs, trusts, offshore and onshore entities, and jurisdictional expansions.
* Manage relationships with external auditors, legal advisers, tax consultants, bankers, and other professional service providers.
* Supervise licensing, statutory filings, board reporting, and other corporate governance obligations.
* Review and manage the organisation's insurance programmes and risk mitigation strategies.



  





**Operations \& Administration** 



* Build and oversee efficient internal operational processes across finance and administration.
* Manage corporate expenses and implement cost control initiatives.
* Support broader business operations including contract management, asset administration, HR\-related processes, and internal controls.
* Develop scalable systems that enable institutional\-quality governance across the organisation.



  





**Risk Management** 



* Identify and proactively manage financial, operational, and regulatory risks.
* Ensure effective tax planning and compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
* Stay informed of evolving accounting standards, tax legislation, and regulatory developments impacting the business.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
* MBA or Master's degree is advantageous.
* Professional qualification such as CPA, ACCA, ACA, or CFA is required.
* Minimum of 10 years' experience in finance, accounting, auditing, or corporate finance, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience within private equity, venture capital, family office, or institutional investment environments is essential.
* Strong expertise in multi\-entity consolidations, intercompany accounting, and international financial reporting.
* Deep understanding of IFRS, corporate governance, compliance, and international tax frameworks.
* Experience overseeing operational functions beyond finance, including administration and business processes, is highly desirable.
* Must be based in Dubai or willing to relocate.



  





**Ideal candidate will come from a Family Office / VC / Institutional background. The role will suit a Senior level candidate who is currently working with a Family Office or Private Equity Fund.** 




  





**Desired Attributes** 



* Strategic thinker with the ability to balance high\-level planning and hands\-on execution.
* Exceptional analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting investment decision\-making.
* Proven ability to build processes and elevate organisations to institutional standards.
* High level of integrity, professionalism, and discretion, with confidentiality being essential to the role.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and fast\-paced international environment.
* Proactive problem solver who anticipates challenges and delivers practical solutions.



  





 This is a unique opportunity to join a high\-growth global investment platform and work directly alongside its principals, helping to build world\-class financial and operational infrastructure while supporting a diverse international portfolio. To apply for this role, please forward your CV using the link.
 



  





 For additional information about open vacancies and events we are attending, please feel free to
 **follow our LinkedIn Page** 
 . We are presently working on numerous client roles at BlockDelta.

data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommercewith defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 2\-5 years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

 At Kerzner, we never settle. Through continued innovation, our team of pioneers push until the next level is achieved, and then to keep going. Our philosophy is simple \- we go above and beyond to Blow Away our Guest and Colleagues. Good enough never is. For us, it is all about perfection and innovation. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
   

  

 Our Colleagues are at the heart of who we are and what we do. With an international team of over 10,000 Colleagues and strong strategic growth on the horizon, we offer unrivalled career opportunities around the world. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Following our mission of enriching lives by connecting people, places and meaningful experiences, Kerzner International has created iconic destination resorts, luxury hotels, and private homes. With the continuous expansion of our portfolio, we are looking for Revenue Management professionals who are willing to relocate to Southern Europe/Eastern Europe region for a property\-based role.
   

  

 Cluster Director of Revenue Management across Kerzner International properties will be responsible for executing the implementation of the strategic long\-term Total Revenue Plan into actionable results that directly affect properties’ performance for Rooms, Food and Beverage, Spa, Retail and other Revenue Centers. The role is based on\-site and oversees multiple properties, reporting to the General Manager, with a dotted line to Global Revenue Team in Dubai.
   

  

**Key duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
* Further develop the property distribution platform by identifying best solution for CRS/GDS and ensuring available revenue management technology is fully utilized and understood according to property specific business mix and requirements
* Ensure optimal use, and measure performance on all distribution channels, to ensure that fair market share is achieved if not surpassed
* Assist the Sales \& Marketing Team in devising marketing campaigns, to ensure that the Hotel reaches the right source markets, at the right time, in the right place
* Monitor competitor availability and pricing and subsequently analyze \& report actual performance versus competitive set.
* Implement pricing strategies, yield strategies, selling strategies and revenue management best practices; investigate and communicate new ways to capture optimal revenue potentials.
* Develop \& implement rationally related pricing structures for Direct, Wholesale, Groups \& Corporate with cohesive synergies between the segments.
* Understand the dynamics of the Global, National, Regional \& Local Political and Economic Market, local Competitors and all demand generators for the destination.
* Carry out analysis of Booking Patterns \& Market Trends and ensure that these are recorded to facilitate future decisions.
* Conduct annual revenue management audits for all revenue generating departments.
* Drive Projects related to revenue management.


**We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate the below skills and qualities:**
* at least 5 years in similar position within luxury hospitality, ideally in a relevant 5 star property based capacity
* fluency with revenue management essential systems and online tools (STR Portal, Opera PMS, Infor Vision, Bi\-Tools, Rate Shopping Tools)
* Advanced CRS and channel management systems knowledge
* Bachelor’s in Hospitality/Finance/Revenue Management, or any related field
* full working proficiency in English and ability to effectively communicate with all levels in the organization


 Our company is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open\-hearted, innovative, inclusive, and inspiring in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

data.title: Design Manager
data.raw_snippet:
**About The Role**
 The Design Manager is a central operational and creative role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for ensuring the studio runs efficiently, design output meets the agency's quality standards, and every project is delivered on time and to brief.
data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The Design Manager is a central operational and creative role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for ensuring the studio runs efficiently, design output meets the agency's quality standards, and every project is delivered on time and to brief.
   

  

 Reporting to the Art Director and Senior Client Director, the Design Manager sits at the intersection of creative production and project management. You will own the day\-to\-day traffic of creative requests and deliverables \- coordinating briefs, managing workloads, and ensuring the right resource is on the right job at the right time.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that requires both design capability and operational discipline. You will produce and oversee creative work across the agency's client portfolio while maintaining the systems and processes that keep the studio performing at pace.
   

  

 The Design Manager will be a key figure in the day\-to\-day life of the creative team \- supporting the Art Director, working closely with account and marketing teams, and ensuring that creative delivery across all clients is consistent, organised, and to the standard the agency demands.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Traffic \& Workflow Management**
* Own the studio traffic system \- managing the intake, prioritisation, and scheduling of all creative briefs across the agency.
* Maintain a clear and up\-to\-date overview of all active projects, deadlines, and resource allocation at all times.
* Work with the account and marketing teams to brief in work accurately, ensuring all jobs are scoped correctly before entering the studio.
* Anticipate capacity pressures and flag resource conflicts early, escalating to the Art Director and Senior Client Director when required.
* Manage freelance and supplier relationships to flex studio capacity during peak periods, ensuring quality and consistency are maintained.


**Design Output \& Quality Control**
* Produce design work across a range of formats \- social content, campaign assets, event branding, presentation design, OOH, print and digital, to a high and consistent standard.
* Review and quality\-check all creative output before it leaves the studio, ensuring work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and production\-ready.
* Maintain brand consistency across all client accounts, upholding the visual standards set by the Art Director.
* Manage the preparation and trafficking of final artwork files for print, digital, and environmental use, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification.
* Oversee version control and file management across the studio, keeping asset libraries organised and accessible.


**Project \& Delivery Management**
* Track all jobs from brief through to final delivery, proactively managing timelines and communicating progress to relevant stakeholders.
* Identify and resolve production issues before they impact delivery, problem\-solving under pressure without compromising quality.
* Manage the review and approval process for creative work, coordinating feedback rounds efficiently and keeping projects moving.
* Produce clear status reports and delivery schedules as required by the account and client teams.
* Ensure all project documentation \- briefs, schedules, sign\-off records — is accurate, complete, and properly filed.


**Client \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with the wider team and departments to manage workload, set realistic timelines, and ensure creative capacity is allocated effectively.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with internal teams on project status, flagging risks and changes as they arise.
* Support the Art Director and Senior Client Director in preparing and presenting work where required.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with external suppliers \- print partners, production studios, photographers, and video producers and build a strong database of contacts, suppliers and agency friends we can tap into.


**Creative Team Support**
* Support and coordinate junior members of the creative team, helping to manage their workload and develop their understanding of agency processes.
* Contribute actively to the studio's creative culture \- bringing energy, rigour, and a commitment to standards to everything you do.
* Stay current with design trends, production techniques, and tools relevant to sport, events, and brand marketing.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and play an active role in maintaining the quality of the agency's output across all accounts.


**ABOUT YOU**
**Essential**
* 4\+ years of experience in a design or studio management role, with demonstrable experience across both design production and traffic or workflow coordination.
* Solid design skills with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign. Able to produce and adapt creative work independently to a high standard.
* Proven experience managing studio traffic and creative project delivery in a fast\-paced agency environment.
* Strong organisational skills with a methodical approach to managing multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Experience overseeing artwork preparation and file management for print, digital, and large\-format production.
* Excellent communication skills \- clear, direct, and confident in working across creative, account, and client teams.
* A high standard of personal output combined with a genuine drive to maintain quality standards across the work of others.
* Experience working with or managing freelance designers, external suppliers, and production partners.
* Strong interest in the sports and entertainment industry.
* Experience in a sport, events, or entertainment marketing environment.


**Desirable**
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Monday.com, Asana, or equivalent studio management platforms.
* Motion graphics or video editing capability: After Effects, Premiere Pro.
* Experience working with government entities, rights holders, or major event organisers in the GCC region.
* Understanding of the UAE and wider Middle East market, including cultural sensitivities and regional production requirements.


**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means the creative and design delivery runs without drama. Briefs are clear, deadlines are met, quality is consistent, and the creative team has the space to do their best work because the operational infrastructure around them is solid.
   

  

 You are the person who knows where every job is at any given moment. You are across the detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. You care about the quality of the work as much as the efficiency of the process \- and you understand that one enables the other.
   

  

 You are proactive, not reactive. You spot a capacity issue before it becomes a crisis. You push back on a brief that is not ready. You maintain standards under pressure and bring the team with you when the pace picks up.
   

  

 You work comfortably across creative and operational worlds. You can sit in a briefing with a client director and a production call with a printer on the same day, and add value in both. You bring professionalism, consistency, and craft to everything that carries the agency's name.
   

  

 Built for pace and precision. Committed to quality at every stage. This role is suited to a highly organised, creatively capable Design Manager who wants to play a central role in one of the region's most active sport and entertainment agencies.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\. No recruiters please.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. It defines the way we work and the work we produce. We believe: It’s easier to complicate than simplify. Simple ideas enter the brain quicker and stay there longer. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.
   

  

 ABOUT M\+C SAATCHI GROUP
   

  

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. M\+C Saatchi Group’s work is informed by two core principles \- Brutal Simplicity of Thought and Diversity of Thought. Together they guide how problems are solved and integrated specialist teams are built. Headquartered in London, M\+C Saatchi Group have circa 2,500 employees globally. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 OUR AMBITION
   

  

 At M\+C Saatchi Group, our ambition is to create and curate Cultural Power for our clients. We do this by connecting specialist expertise, powered by creativity, data and technology, to help build famous brands and solve the most complex business and societal challenges.

data.jd_text:
**About us**




  





 Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose**




 To manage and grow large account portfolios and client relationships for assigned portfolio in the Corporate banking segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates’ day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality. High collaboration required internally and externally, with local and international client outreach (includes meetings in different time zones and tight deadline submissions). A highly engaged person who can drive the business and internal processes to ensure approvals are sought in a short time span.
 



  





**Responsibilities**




  





**Client and Market Analysis** 



* Participate in the financial analysis conducted on clients and their respective industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.



  





**Client Relationship Management** 



* Originate new business opportunities with target clients across banking products
* Develop Term Sheet, Information Memorandum, mandate letter….etc.;
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Maintain the credit quality of the client relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the Bank’s management.
* Achieve individual and team’s financial performance targets.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase the cross\-sell ratio with key clients.
* Ensure Account Plans are prepared and maintained for all key clients.
* Ensure all clients’ files /documents are maintained.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio
* Learning \& Development – Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs.
* Ensure that all internal processes for existing portfolio and NTBs are met in line with the Bank’s policies \& procedures.
* Adhere to process KPI’s and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements



  





**Day\-to\-Day Activities** 



* Assist the Executive Director / Line Manager in the day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities such as client calls, payment processing, documentation follow up, account openings, updating pipeline, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and the delivery of effective and high\-quality outputs.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements in order to ensure consistency with the Bank’s KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.



  





**Policies, Systems, Processes, and Procedures** 



* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.



  





**MIS and Reports** 



* Assist in the preparation of timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit’s requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**Qualifications**




  





**Minimum Qualification** 



* 
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Management , Engineering or related discipline.
* Master’s degree in business administration or finance is preferred.



  





**Knowledge, Skills, and Attributes:** 




  




* Knowledge of the banking sector, and FAB’s products and business strategies
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities
* Computer proficiency
* Ability to analyse and research information
* Banking software systems proficiency
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills
* Credit analysis and FOREX skills
* Communication skills



  





**Minimum Experience** 



* 8\-10 years of experience in corporate banking (coverage).

data.jd_text:
talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who We Are?**
 When you think of food delivery in the MENA region, we’d be pretty surprised if talabat didn’t pop into your mind first! Since delivering our first order in Kuwait in 2004, we’ve grown quite a lot over the past 17 years.
   

  

 Today, we deliver hundreds of millions of food orders, grocery items and other products per year, to our customers in nine countries throughout the region with more than 3,000\+ employees! Our food delivery business works with over 27,000 brands and almost 50,000 branches, while our q\-commerce concept, talabat mart, now delivers groceries to customers in Bahrain, Egypt, Jordan, Kuwait, Oman Qatar, and the UAE in 30 minutes or less!
   

  

 Our philosophy is to make sure we do what is right for our ecosystem \- our customers, our partners, our people, our riders, and the communities in which we operate. Our \#techforgood program allows our customers a safe and convenient way to contribute to important causes in their community through donating to local and international charities directly on talabat with a focus on food insecurity in the region. Since its inception in 2020, we have facilitated the donation of well over 1 million meals to those in need, as well as donated over $1\.5 million to charity with the help of our partners and customers. talabat is part of Delivery Hero, the global leader in online food delivery and q\-commerce.
   

  

**Role Summary**
* Owns regional value creation, translating strategic priorities into clear commercial initiatives with measurable impact.
* Leads complex, cross\-market programs, ensuring rigorous project management, senior\-level alignment, and disciplined execution.
* Establishes scalable commercial frameworks, enabling consistent decision\-making while preserving local market flexibility.
* Drives insight\-led decisions through advanced analytics, turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Shapes executive dialogue, influencing stakeholders through structured communication and fact\-based narratives.
* Deploys technology as a performance lever, improving productivity, transparency, and speed to impact.
* Builds durable capabilities, strengthening commercial skill sets across teams and markets.
* Responsible for driving long\-term growth plans, achieving revenue and profitability targets, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure success.


**What's On Your Plate?**
* Applies a strong understanding of industry trends and internal business processes to adapt strategies to changing market conditions.
* Develops frameworks that address regional challenges by combining market insights, competitor analysis, and operational considerations.
* Leads financial and operational performance at the regional level by optimizing pricing, promotions, and product offerings.
* Drives improvements by implementing tools and practices that enhance efficiency and business outcomes.
* Builds and develops a high\-performing regional commercial team, fostering collaboration and accountability.
* Supports succession planning by mentoring senior managers and aligning team skills with business objectives.
* Partners with other functions to deliver cohesive strategies and ensure smooth cross\-departmental coordination.
* Directly influences business growth through initiatives like optimizing commercial processes, improving market penetration, and enhancing customer retention strategies.
* Provides critical support to cross\-functional teams, ensuring alignment between commercial goals and overall company objectives


**What Did We Order?**
* Problem Solving: Resolves complex business challenges by using data\-driven analysis and developing innovative solutions. Handles critical decisions such as market entry strategies, pricing adjustments, and operational improvements with a focus on sustainable results. implements processes that empower teams to identify and address challenges independently.

**About Jumeirah** 




  





 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art\-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
 



  





**About the Job** 




  





 As part of our continued commitment to operational excellence and leadership succession across our portfolio, we are curating a talent pool of high\-potential and experienced hospitality leaders for a
 **Director of Finance** 
 opportunity to join
 **Jumeirah in Dubai** 
 , supporting both current and future needs. The main duties and responsibilities of this role include:
 



  




* Provide strategic financial leadership across the property, driving sustainable profitability, informed decision\-making, and long\-term business performance through effective financial planning, analysis, and forecasting.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, influencing commercial and operational strategies through insightful financial guidance, performance analysis, and risk assessment.

* Lead, develop, and inspire a high\-performing Finance team, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and business partnership while enhancing financial acumen across the wider organisation.

 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

 .

 Reports to:

 PMO Managers, Project Governance Leads, Reporting \& Controls Analysts

**In scope delivery and handover domains, including, but not limited to:**
* City Business Applications
* City Platforms (integration/IoT/data)
* City OT \& Smart Systems technology
* City Physical Security technology
* City ICT infrastructure and data centers including City IT/OT Security


**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and maintain Delivery \& Handover Governance standards for City Technology programs, including:
+ reporting templates and cadence
+ stage\-gate criteria
+ RAID log standards
+ dependency tracking rules
+ baseline control requirements (scope/schedule/cost)

* Identify schedule slippage, scope creep, and delivery risk early and escalate through governance forums
* Stage Gates \& Assurance (Delivery\-to\-Run)
* Govern and enforce delivery stage gates, including:
* Design completion readiness (as required by TDAs)
* Testing and commissioning evidence
* Documentation and as\-built readiness
* Operational readiness evidence for transition into technology support
* Ensure no system progresses through gates without evidence and sign\-offs


**City Business Applications**
**City OT \& Smart Systems**
**City Physical Security Systems**
**City Platforms (Integration / IoT / Data)**
**City ICT Infrastructure and Data Centers including City IT/OT Security**
* Risk, Issues, and Dependency Governance (RAID)

* Ensure RAID logs are complete, current, and actionable
* Run dependency reviews and cross\-tower issue resolution sessions
* Escalate unresolved risks/issues to the appropriate governance level
* Delivery Reporting \& Executive Packs
* Produce standardized delivery reporting packs including:
* Schedule health (RAG)
* Delivery risk exposure
* Dependency hotspots
* Milestone achievement
* Vendor delivery performance indicators
* Readiness risks for transition to technology support
* Ensure reporting is auditable and consistent across towers
* Vendor Delivery \& Handover Governance Support (non\-commercial)
* Ensure vendors comply with City Technology Delivery \& Handover Governance requirements:
+ Reporting cadence
+ Evidence packs
+ Stage\-gate readiness
+ Documentation standards

* Provide delivery performance evidence to:

+ City Technology leadership (for escalation)

+ City Technology governance and architecture standards
+ design authority requirements (IT/OT/physical security/platforms/data)
+ cybersecurity gating requirements

* Director — City Technology Governance \& Architecture
* Tower Directors (Apps / OT / Physical Security / Platforms / Infrastructure / Cybersecurity)
* City ITSM governance and assurance function
* Director — City Technology Operations (City) (for transition readiness alignment only)
* Finance / budgeting governance stakeholders


**External:**
* Systems Integrators
* Delivery contractors
* OEMs providing commissioning and handover support
* Managed service providers supporting transition planning


**Success Measures (KPIs)**
* % of City Technology programs compliant with Delivery \& Handover Governance reporting cadence
* Stage\-gate compliance rate (% passing with complete evidence)
* % of projects with maintained baseline (scope/schedule/cost)
* Delivery risk closure rate (RAID actions completed on time)
* Number of uncontrolled scope changes / late change requests
* Reduction in "handover defects" (missing documentation, missing runbooks, missing monitoring)
* Reduction in incidents caused by poor delivery transition within first 30 days of go\-live


**Operational Readiness \& Handover Governance**

* Validate security hardening and compliance sign\-offs
* Coordinate CAB approvals and go\-live governance

**Portfolio \& Financial Governance**

* Align with Finance for forecasting accuracy
* Monitor cost variance and earned value performance
* Maintain benefits realization tracking framework


**Stakeholder Management**

* Interface with Corporate PMO and Enterprise Architecture
* Present executive updates to Technology Steering Committee
* Coordinate with Procurement and Legal for contract governance alignment


**Requirements**
* 15\+ year\-experience in large\-scale ICT infrastructure, smart city, or complex technology Delivery \& Handover Governance / PMO / program controls roles
* Experience in complex multi\-domain environments, ideally including:
+ IT \+ OT programs
+ infrastructure and data centers
+ physical security technology delivery
+ smart city platforms and integration

* Strong knowledge of:
+ stage\-gate Delivery \& Handover Governance
+ RAID management
+ dependency management
+ reporting and executive governance packs

* Strong stakeholder management and escalation skills
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred)
* Experience managing IT \+ OT delivery environments preferred
* Strong experience in governance\-heavy or giga\-project environments

data.jd_text:
Galderma is the emerging pure\-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science\-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast\-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ \- the skin \- meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.
   

  

 We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.
   

  

 At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute the Business Unit strategy in alignment with corporate objectives, ensuring sustainable growth, profitability, and market leadership.
* Lead sales, marketing, and commercial operations for the Therapeutic Dermatology \& Biologics portfolio across all channels.
* Define and implement annual business plans, commercial policies, and go\-to\-market strategies aligned with market dynamics and business priorities.
* Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and proactively adapt business strategies.
* Drive the overall IDS strategy by aligning business objectives and customer engagement with Galderma’s holistic dermatology approach.
* Lead, coach, and develop high\-performing sales and marketing teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Set sales targets, monitor performance KPIs, and implement corrective actions to esure achievement of business objectives.
* Oversee forecasting accuracy, demand planning, budgeting, and full P\&L accountability for the Business Unit.
* Ensure effective execution of promotional campaigns, customer engagement plans, and field force excellence across territories and customer segments.
* Partner closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Medical, and Commercial Excellence teams to ensure aligned business execution and operational efficiency.
* Ensure effective utilization of CRM systems (e.g., Veeva) to optimize customer engagement and sales execution.
* Lead and manage all tender and institutional business activities with MOH, NUPCO, governmental hospitals, and key public sector stakeholders.
* Develop strong strategic relationships with procurement authorities, tender committees, hospital decision makers, and key influencers.
* Drive tender strategy, pricing approach, and institutional access plans to maximize business opportunities while maintaining profitability.
* Monitor tender pipeline, institutional demand, and competitor activities to proactively identify risks and opportunities.
* Ensure successful execution of tender contracts, product supply continuity, and stakeholder alignment across the institutional sector.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing and Medical teams to ensure alignment of promotional strategies, scientific messaging, and product positioning.
* Lead new product launches and market entry strategies, ensuring strong execution and successful commercialization.
* Shape market demand through scientific engagement, stakeholder education, and disciplined KPI tracking.
* Identify and develop strategic partnerships, business expansion opportunities, and innovative growth initiatives.
* Ensure strong brand visibility and positioning across both private and public sectors.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, including healthcare professionals, hospital procurement teams, pharmacy chains, and distributors.
* Lead strategic negotiations with key accounts regarding pricing, contracts, and commercial agreements.
* Ensure continuous engagement with strategic accounts to support long\-term mutually profitable partnerships.
* Manage distributor and sub\-distributor networks to ensure optimal market coverage and execution excellence.
* Recruit, develop, and retain top talent across the Business Unit.
* Identify training and development needs and implement continuous learning programs to strengthen team capabilities.
* Mentor high\-potential employees and support succession planning initiatives.
* Lead teams effectively through organizational changes while maintaining engagement and performance.
* Ensure full compliance with company policies, legal requirements, ethical standards, and local healthcare regulations in all business activities.
* Manage business risks proactively, including supply shortages, regulatory changes, and market disruptions, to minimize operational impact.


**What We're Looking For**
* Minimum 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical and/or FMCG commercial operations, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role managing sales and business performance.
* Proven track record of consistently delivering and exceeding sales and profitability targets within highly competitive market environments.
* Strong experience in leading and developing diverse sales teams across large territories and multiple business channels.
* Deep understanding of the Saudi pharmaceutical market, customer landscape, healthcare ecosystem, and commercial dynamics.
* Solid expertise in managing Tender, MOH, and institutional business, including NUPCO processes, public sector negotiations, and strategic account management
* Bachelor’s Degree (science/ pharmacy) or equivalent experience/qualification MBA is preferred
* Language: fluent in English especially Business English (written and spoken/presentations etc.). Arabic language fluency is a must.


**Our people make a difference**
 At Galderma, you’ll work with people who are like you. And people that are different. We value what every member of our team brings. Professionalism, collaboration, and a friendly, supportive ethos is the perfect environment for people to thrive and excel in what they do.

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 AtkinsRéalis is looking for a Commercial Director, in Riyadh, KSA. The Commercial Director will lead and oversee the commercial management of AtkinsRéalis' portfolio of projects in Saudi Arabia. This strategic role ensures that projects are delivered in line with contractual obligations, financial targets, and internal governance standards. The position requires a strong blend of commercial acumen, leadership, and deep understanding of engineering and consultancy services.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

* To understand and interpret AtkinsRéalis rights and responsibilities across its portfolio of projects in KSA.
* Overall responsibility for supporting Project Directors in the delivery of projects to the contractual arrangements and the required commercial outcome (including the contracted profit margin) all in accordance with the agreed financial objectives.
* Co\-ordinate commercial appointments for services being provided by all parties, including other Atkins Business Sectors and sub\-consultants.
* Developing and managing the commercial administration, monitoring and change control system requirements to comply with Atkins internal business processes and systems, inclusive of risk and variation registers.
* Developing commercial understanding and competence within the Project Management and Design delivery staff in KSA.
* Support the Project\-based Commercial staff within the Country's live projects.
* Escalation and reporting on claims made against Atkins Professional Indemnity insurance or such circumstances.
* Commercial review and audit of live projects in Country.
* Understanding of and adherence to AtkinsRealis internal Business Management System (BMS) and other processes.
* Monitor compliance of the Service Delivery Process throughout the project delivery phase and respond to queries.
* Review monthly financial reports and review any actions in respect of the Risk Register and project contingency.
* Influence improved risk management to ensure an appropriate approach to risk is considered with an objective of converting contingency to margin for live projects.
* Liaise with finance and project teams on debt management with an aim of converting debt provisions to P\&L profit.
* Provide guidance to project teams to ensure a consistent approach to billing in line with contractual arrangements is maintained to maximise positive cash flow.
* Influence behaviours to provide early warnings of risk to projects financial health.


**About You**
**Technical Knowledge and experience**
* BEng /BSc in an appropriate engineering discipline or Quantity Surveying or equivalent from a recognised western university.
* Professional Membership (MRICS, MCIOB, MCIPS, MCIArb).
* 15\+ years of relevant experience with a global engineering/cost consulting firm.


**Essential**
* Contracts and sub\-contracts\- preparation, review and evaluation.
* Knowledge of the design process in the project lifecycle.
* Knowledge of the site operations process.
* Contract and commercial correspondence.
* Preparation of financial models and pricing proposals.
* Understanding and experience of project planning, programme and delay claim preparation and evaluation.
* Management of variations and claims processes, claims preparation.
* Senior level commercial experience on at least one major design and construct project.


**Negotiation Skills**
* Risk management process and practice.
* Excellent ability to develop successful client relationships.
* Middle East experience.


**The individual**
* Business minded, commercially astute.
* External focus and awareness of market influences.
* Client friendly, relationship building, emotionally intelligent.
* Self\-motivated with a winning attitude.
* Good team leader and team worker.
* Excellent communicator in written and spoken English.


**Strong Influencing Skills**
* Mobile, willing to make regular travel in region.
* Committed and persistent can\-do qualities.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Senior Commercial Director for KSA, Bahrain, and Kuwait is responsible for shaping and executing a long‑term (3–5 year) commercial strategy with a strong focus on accelerating growth in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia—one of Hilton’s most strategically important markets, expected to exceed 100 hotels within five years.
   

  

 This role leads the development of the value proposition and investment cases required to unlock this growth, ensuring the right commercial foundations are established across Sales, Marketing, Distribution, and Revenue functions. The appointee will assess organizational design needs, budget requirements, talent capabilities, and performance enablers needed for sustained market leadership.
   

  

 The Senior Commercial Director is accountable for delivering top‑tier commercial performance across the three markets and driving market share growth. The role includes hiring, developing, and mentoring high‑potential talent, ensuring alignment with Hilton’s strategic priorities while fostering a culture that reflects Hilton’s values.
   

  

 A critical success factor is the ability to build strong, influential partnerships with senior commercial leaders, regional and brand teams, GMs, ownership groups, and cross‑functional stakeholders. The role requires exceptional communication, analytical rigor, and strategic thinking to solve complex business challenges and enable sustained success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What will I be doing?**
**Business Acumen**
* Partner with the VP Commercial Services and Commercial Director MEA to develop long‑term regional strategy, business cases, and stakeholder alignment.
* Serve as the commercial business partner to the VP Operations for KSA, Bahrain, and Kuwait.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Commercial Director, enabling them to own near‑term tactical execution.
* Support new hotel openings from a commercial perspective, leveraging Hilton’s full commercial engine (RMCC, HWS, shared sales offices, Marketing, F\&B, HRCC).
* Translate organizational goals into clear performance standards for the Commercial Services team.


**Setting Strategy**
* Develop medium‑ and long‑term commercial strategies to drive sustained, above‑market revenue performance across all three markets.
* Clearly communicate strategic priorities, progress, and results to internal and external stakeholders.
* Gain senior‑level alignment and sponsorship for key initiatives required to deliver strategic outcomes.
* Lead strategic planning within the Commercial Services team to advance enterprise goals and ensure consistent communication.


**Executing for Results**
* Lead negotiations with third‑party partners and suppliers as required.
* Collaborate cross‑functionally with Revenue, Sales, F\&B, Marketing, eCommerce, and Finance teams, as well as commercial leadership across MEA and EMEA.
* Ensure all commercial initiatives are effectively planned, resourced, and executed.
* Drive integrated commercial action across functions to maximize RevPAR and market share.


**Leading Teams**
* Ensure Commercial Services teams provide strong support to on‑property commercial teams.
* Build and maintain a high‑performing talent pipeline, developing future leaders and succession plans.
* Create a culture of performance, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.


**Building Relationships and Influencing**
* Develop strong relationships across senior leadership to enable alignment and collaboration.
* Strengthen partnerships with MEA and EMEA commercial teams to elevate commercial performance.
* Maintain effective coordination with global commercial functions, including Database Management, HRCC, Distribution, and Channel Management.
* Represent the commercial function at property visits, corporate meetings, owner meetings, and business reviews.


**Qualifications**
**What are we looking for?**
* Demonstrated experience operating at a regional level with responsibility for a portfolio of no fewer than 20 hotels, including oversight of commercial performance, stakeholder engagement, and strategic execution across multiple countries. Proven track record in high‑growth markets, ideally with exposure to environments experiencing 4x\+ growth rates, where rapid scaling, agility, and commercial innovation are essential.
* Strong relationship building skills
* Ability to effectively plan and proactively communicate/manage expectations with stakeholders that may include both internal and external partners (project sponsors/ senior leadership team)
* Experience in working in a matrix organization
* Experience in Revenue Management, Sales \& Marketing
* Presents clear and logical arguments and decision based on factual data.
* Quick and accurate when evaluating complex written and numerical information.
* Develops constructive relationships at all levels within the organization.
* Demonstrates leadership and effectively motivates teams, helps others when needed.
* Maintains effectiveness in situations of disappointment or high pressure.
* Adapts willingly to change.
* Identifies priorities effectively, balancing importance, urgency and resources.
* Manages own personal time efficiently within tight schedules.
* Strategic thinker while translating financial goals into operational plans
* Previous experience in Change management and organisational design.
* Storytelling and ability to create, business cases, presentations to gain stakeholder buy\-in.
* Dynamic, innovative, and creative in finding business solutions
* Works effectively and accurately in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to challenge while maintaining strong relationships
* A high level of emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills with the ability to provide and receive professional, constructive feedback that elevates individual performance and job satisfaction


**About The Team**
**How We’ll Help You Thrive**
**Benefits**
 At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:
   

  

 Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world\-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
   

  

 Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
   

  

 Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
   

  

 Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
   

  

* Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

data.jd_text:
**Responsibilities**
 TikTok LIVE connects creators and communities in real time, enabling interactive experiences and new monetisation opportunities. As part of TikTok’s regional management and support function, the Regional Headquarters is seeking a Regional Agency Strategy, Governance and Enablement Manager to support TikTok group entities across the MENAT region. The role will support the development of regional agency\-management strategy, training, performance analytics, policy implementation and operational governance, with local execution undertaken by the relevant operating entities.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

 1\. Develop, maintain and support implementation of regional agency\-management policies, playbooks, onboarding standards and governance processes for TikTok LIVE across the MENA/MENAT region.
   

 2\. Support local operating entities in identifying, assessing and managing MCNs, agencies and creator organisations in accordance with approved regional standards, without directly contracting on behalf of the RHQ entity.
   

 3\. Design and deliver regional training materials and enablement programmes for internal teams on agency\-management processes, platform policies, compliance requirements and operational best practices.
   

 4\. Analyse regional agency performance data and provide recommendations to local operating entities and regional leadership on agency quality, category development and creator ecosystem trends.
   

 5\. Coordinate with product, policy, legal, compliance and local operations teams to improve regional agency\-management methodology and ensure consistent application of TikTok LIVE standards.
   

 6\. Contribute to regional business planning, operational governance and performance reporting for the LIVE creator agency ecosystem.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Minimum Qualifications:
   

 \- Bachelor's degree or above.
   

 \- Deep passion for TikTok, mobile entertainment, social media, and popular culture.
   

 \- Experience in the live\-streaming industry and understanding of latest live\-streaming trends.
   

 \- Experience in regional strategy, business operations, governance, analytics, partner enablement or cross\-functional programme management within a technology, media, entertainment, social media or creator economy business.
   

  

 This role is based in the Company’s KSA Regional Headquarters and is responsible for providing regional strategy, management, governance, analytics, training and coordination support to Company group entities across the MENAT/MENA region. The role does not involve direct sales to customers, direct contracting with creators, agencies or users on behalf of the RHQ entity, or direct operation of local commercial activities. Execution of local market activities, contracting and revenue\-generating operations remains with the relevant local operating entities.
   

  

**About TikTok**
 TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​
   

  

  

**Why Join Us**
 Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day.​
   

 We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
   

 ​
   

 Diversity \& Inclusion​
   

 TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

From F1\-grade racetracks and theme parks to stadiums and performance venues, we're creating a destination like no other. This is more than a project — it's a national transformation. As construction accelerates, we're hiring ambitious talent to help shape it. If you're driven by scale, impact, and the chance to build something iconic from the ground up — Qiddiya is calling
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the planning and execution of all event operations and site\-wide delivery at Cultural and Heritage program, ensuring safe, efficient, and high\-quality delivery of cultural programming, guest experience, and large\-scale event operations in alignment with asset objectives
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Event Operations Planning \& Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of all event operations across Cultural and Heritage program, including the Festival and year\-round programming
* Translate programming, marketing, and commercial plans into detailed operational delivery models
* Develop and manage event operations plans, schedules, and resource requirements
* Ensure seamless execution of all programming and activities in line with operational plans


**Logistics, Site Readiness \& Overlay**
* Lead planning and execution of logistics, site readiness, and event overlay (temporary infrastructure, structures, utilities, and services)
* Ensure readiness of all operational infrastructure prior to opening and across event cycles
* Oversee site setup, dismantling, and transition between events or programming phases
* Coordinate movement planning including access, transport, parking, and crowd flows


**Health, Safety \& Security (HSE)**
* Establish and enforce HSE and security frameworks across all operations
* Oversee crowd management planning, emergency response, and incident management protocols
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and authority requirements
* Coordinate with security agencies and government entities to ensure safe delivery


**Guest Experience \& On\-Ground Delivery**
* Ensure delivery of a high\-quality, safe, and seamless visitor experience across all touchpoints
* Oversee guest flow, queue management, accessibility, and service standards
* Monitor on\-ground performance and address operational issues in real time


**Vendor \& Operator Management**
* Oversee management of all operational vendors, contractors, and service providers
* Ensure vendor performance meets operational, safety, and service standards
* Coordinate with procurement and contract management functions


**Cross\-Functional Integration \& Feasibility**
* Lead operational feasibility assessment of programming, commercial, and marketing initiatives
* Ensure alignment between programming requirements and operational capabilities
* Work closely with:
+ Programming → feasibility and scheduling
+ Commercial → activation requirements
+ Marketing → campaign\-driven demand


**Asset \& Site Coordination**
* Coordinate closely with Asset \& Site Management on facilities, maintenance, and infrastructure readiness
* Ensure operational alignment with permanent and temporary asset requirements
* Support long\-term planning of site usage and capacity


**Asset Management \& Group Alignment**
* Align operational plans with Asset Management direction and performance expectations
* Coordinate with Qiddiya Group functions and external authorities where required
* Provide operational input into planning, budgeting, and performance reviews


**Performance Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track operational KPIs including service levels, efficiency, and safety
* Monitor performance during events and identify improvement opportunities
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives across operations


**Key Success Metrics**
* Operational delivery against plan
* Visitor experience and satisfaction
* Health, safety, and security performance
* Efficiency of event execution
* Readiness and delivery of major events


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong experience in large\-scale event operations and delivery
* Ability to manage complex logistics and site operations
* Strong knowledge of crowd management and HSE standards
* Ability to operate in high\-pressure, fast\-paced environments
* Cross\-functional coordination and execution capability


**Requirements**
* 12\-15\+ years of experience, with a significant portion in leadership roles overseeing large\-scale operations and event delivery
* Proven experience in:
* Planning and delivering large\-scale events, festivals, or destination operations with high visitor volumes
* Managing complex, multi\-site or multi\-zone environments involving diverse activities and stakeholders
* Leading end\-to\-end event operations, including planning, logistics, site readiness, and live delivery
* Strong experience in:
* Crowd management, HSE, and security operations within large public events
* Operational planning and logistics, including transport, access, and site movement
* Vendor and contractor management across multiple service lines
* Demonstrated ability to:
* Operate in high\-pressure, real\-time environments with critical decision\-making responsibilities
* Manage and coordinate with government authorities, regulatory bodies, and security agencies
* Lead large, cross\-functional operational teams and on\-ground workforce
* Experience in:
* Pre\-opening and activation phases of large\-scale venues, events, or destinations (preferred)
* Transitioning from readiness to live operations and managing ongoing operational cycles

 At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented
 **Senior Project Manager \- Data Center** 
 to join our team! In this role, you will lead the delivery of the initial phase of a data center project focusing on the Strategy and design blueprint of a mission\-critical, data center project, ensuring safe, compliant, and high\-quality execution aligned with program objectives.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Provide strategic leadership and direction across all project phases.
* Manage a multi\-package delivery model involving external stakeholders, design consultants, and specialist contractors.
* Ensure compliance with Uptime Institute Tier III/IV standards and client\-specific technical requirements.
* Oversee project controls, risk management, and governance reporting.
* Lead stakeholder engagement with clients, authorities, utilities, and internal leadership.
* Drive performance across safety, quality, schedule, and cost KPIs.
* Support value engineering, change management, and claims resolution.
* Ensure readiness for commissioning, integrated systems testing (IST), and operational handover.


**What Required Skills You’ll Bring**
* 15\+ years in project and program management, with at least 10 years in mission\-critical or data center environments.
* Proven delivery of large\-scale, complex infrastructure or hyperscale data center projects.
* Strong understanding of MEP systems, utility coordination, commissioning, and Tier certification processes.
* Exceptional team leadership, stakeholder management, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field. PMP, RICS, or equivalent certification is preferred.


**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**
* Experience delivering projects in the Middle East or similar regulatory environments.
* Familiarity with fast\-track delivery models and digital project controls.
* Strong commercial acumen and contract management expertise.


 Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels no matter the race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability or genetic information.
   

  

 We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY!
