data.jd_text:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a highly experienced Senior Director \- Project Director Design to lead the design aspects of our Strategic Development Unit (SDU). This pivotal role requires a visionary leader who can oversee and manage the design process for large\-scale projects, ensuring their successful delivery while maintaining alignment with Qiddiya's overall strategic objectives and brand vision.
   

  

 The Senior Director provides leadership in establishing and maintaining design and consultancy management framework, governance and operating model for QDC HQ team. Ensures the design processes are developed and rolled out to all Business units / sectors, supports delivery in BUs when required. Provides leadership for assigned HQ special projects accountable for meeting quality, time, budget and HSSE requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish/update design and project management framework for all delivery methods (including Self\-Delivery, Delivery partner, CM, traditional etc.)
* Develop / update policies, processes, procedures, manuals and templates for design and consultancy (including PMC) for all projects and delivery methods
* Define governance process including detailed RACI matrix for all projects for Stages
* Support / coordinate with HQ Operations Director and Project Director (Delivery) in establishing governance and operational model for the complete program lifecycle
* Develop Design Strategy requirements and template to be applied for all projects and delivery methods
* Coordinate Technical / Peer review design management process and requirements with the Technical Director
* Develop/Update Health Safety Security and Environmental management requirements for the design phase including Design HSSE Reviews, co\-ordinate with HSE and Security Managers
* Develop/Update Sustainability management requirements for the design phase. co\-ordinate with Sustainability Managers
* Support MMC Director in establishing and overall MMC strategy and design integration process for all delivery models
* Support Procurement Director in establishing design and consultancy requirements and standards for prequalification and RFP processes. Participate when required in consultant selection process
* Support HQ Executive director in presentations and submittal for business line, project and budget approvals
* Accountable for delivery of special/assigned HQ projects including all approvals, reporting, management of internal and external stakeholders, financial closure and handover
* Accountable for compliance of special/assigned HQ projects with all QDC policies, processes, procedures and requirements, ensuring that the project meets HSE, budget, schedule and quality standards and requirements
* Support Business units in project delivery with peer reviews, consultant selection and management (when required), project audits to ensure compliance with established processes, procedures and standards for design and consultancy (including PMC)
* Coordinates input from Business units on the HQ management and governance framework processes and standards, updates documentation as part of the continuous improvement cycle
* Leads/support preparation of training materials required for the implementation of policies, processes and procedures, participates in training or presentations when required
* Participates in QDC Mentoring and Capability Building programs


**Requirements**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in architecture or engineering as minimum
* Master's Degree in related fields is preferred


**Specific Skills Required**
* Significant experience (5\+ years) in KSA within large‑scale developments or giga‑projects
* Thorough knowledge of procurement governance, strategic sourcing, and supply chain management principles
* Proven experience establishing procurement frameworks, policies, and assurance models for complex, multi‑project programs
* Strong understanding of multiple delivery models, including Self‑Delivery, Construction Management, Delivery Partner, and Traditional contracting
* Demonstrated experience in strategic and long‑lead procurement, market engagement, and supplier capacity management
* Proven leadership in providing central functional procurement services to internal Business Units and senior stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management skills across executive leadership, project teams, CPU, consultants, contractors, and suppliers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* High level of professionalism, judgment, and commercial acumen
* Strong problem‑solving and risk management capability
* Excellent time management and ability to operate effectively under pressure


**Experience**
* 20\-25 years' experience, of which at least 5 years have been in a senior leadership role within procurement, commercial, or supply chain functions on major programs or large‑scale developments


 Applications closing on 1st July 2026\.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

data.jd_text:
Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia's flagship destination for entertainment, sports, and culture — a cornerstone of Vision 2030 located just outside Riyadh. Spanning over 360 km², it will feature world\-class attractions including a Formula 1\-grade racetrack, theme parks, major sports venues, and performance spaces. More than a destination, Qiddiya is a catalyst for economic diversification, job creation, and a new way of life. With construction progressing rapidly, we're looking for driven professionals ready to help shape one of the world's most ambitious developments. Every role here has real impact — from planning and design to delivery and operations. If you're motivated by large\-scale challenges and lasting legacy, there's a place for you at Qiddiya.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the planning and delivery of flagship cultural programs and anchor experiences that act as key attractions within Cultural and Heritage program .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Anchor Program Development**
* Develop and manage flagship cultural programs and signature experiences
* Define concepts, themes, and formats for high\-impact programs
* Ensure anchor programs act as key attractions within the overall offering
* Support the procurement of third\-party partners to enable the development and delivery of cultural programming


**Large\-Scale Delivery \& Coordination**
* Oversee execution of major performances and anchor events
* Coordinate across multiple teams to ensure delivery at scale
* Ensure alignment with Operations, Asset, and technical requirements


**High\-Profile Stakeholder \& Talent Management**
* Manage relationships with high\-profile performers, partners, and contributors
* Coordinate contracts, schedules, and delivery requirements
* Ensure premium\-quality experience delivery


**Performance \& Impact Optimization**
* Monitor performance of anchor programs (attendance, engagement, visibility)
* Identify opportunities to enhance impact and reach
* Ensure anchor programs contribute to overall financial performance


**Integration with Overall Programming**
* Ensure anchor programs are integrated within the broader programming calendar
* Align timing and positioning to maximize visitor flow and engagement


**Key Success Metrics**
* Attendance at anchor events
* Visitor engagement and satisfaction
* Contribution to overall programming success


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Experience in high\-profile event or program management
* Strong coordination and delivery capability
* Ability to manage complex, high\-visibility programs


**Requirements**
* 7\-10\+ years of experience, with a strong background in delivering large\-scale, high\-profile cultural programs, performances, or flagship experiences
* Proven experience designing and delivering high\-impact, flagship programs or headline events within festivals, cultural platforms, or entertainment environments
* Experience managing complex, high\-visibility programs that attract large audiences and drive visitation
* Strong understanding of program positioning, audience appeal, and experience design at scale
* Demonstrated experience working with:
* High\-profile performers, artists, or cultural figures
* Strategic partners and production entities
* Ability to manage contracts, expectations, schedules, and delivery requirements for premium participants
* Strong relationship management skills with senior stakeholders and partners
* Experience managing end\-to\-end delivery of large\-scale productions, including technical, operational, and scheduling aspects
* Ability to coordinate across multiple teams (Operations, Technical, Commercial, Marketing) to deliver complex programs
* Experience managing multi\-layered program requirements, including staging, rehearsals, and live delivery
* Ability to deliver programs in fast\-paced, high\-pressure environments with tight timelines
* Demonstrated ability to develop programs that drive attendance, engagement, and commercial outcomes
* Understanding of how anchor programs contribute to:
* Visitor attraction
* Dwell time
* Sponsorship value
* Experience aligning programming with commercial and marketing objectives
* Experience in:
* Major national or international events
* Cultural festivals or entertainment platforms
* Exposure to large\-scale productions or live performances is highly preferred
* Experience in pre\-opening or launch of flagship programs is an advantage

**About Tashteeb** 




 Tashteeb is bringing together a team of experienced construction and fit\-out professionals dedicated to transforming client visions into successful projects.
 



 At Tashteeb, we believe that every project should be delivered with speed, quality, precision, and strong market understanding. Our approach is innovative, dynamic, and collaborative, allowing us to work closely with clients, consultants, designers, suppliers, and project teams to deliver projects that are practical, distinctive, and commercially successful.
 



 We specialize in adding value to every project entrusted to us by ensuring efficient execution, strong coordination, cost awareness, and timely delivery. Our commitment to market knowledge allows us to stay ahead of trends and act quickly in a fast\-changing construction and fit\-out environment.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Tashteeb is seeking a highly experienced
 **Project Manager – Fit\-Out** 
 to join our team in
 **Riyadh, Saudi Arabia** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should have
 **10 to 15 years of proven experience** 
 in managing and delivering
 **F\&B, retail, commercial, and interior fit\-out projects** 
 . This role requires a strong project leader with solid hands\-on experience in site execution, fit\-out coordination, client management, subcontractor management, procurement follow\-up, cost control, quality control, project reporting, and successful project handover.
 



 The successful candidate will be responsible for managing projects from planning and mobilization through execution, handover, and close\-out, while ensuring that all works are delivered on time, within budget, and according to approved quality standards.
 



 Strong experience in
 **F\&B and retail fit\-out projects** 
 is essential.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Manage the full project lifecycle from planning, mobilization, and execution to handover and project close\-out.
 



 • Lead and supervise fit\-out projects, with a strong focus on F\&B, retail, commercial, and interior works.
 



 • Coordinate with clients, consultants, designers, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, procurement, finance, and senior management.
 



 • Review project drawings, specifications, BOQs, schedules, scope of work, and technical requirements.
 



 • Ensure all project activities are aligned with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, authority requirements, and contractual obligations.
 



 • Prepare project execution plans, work schedules, lookahead plans, site progress updates, and project reports.
 



 • Monitor project progress against approved timelines and take corrective action when delays, risks, or coordination issues arise.
 



 • Manage site teams, subcontractors, and suppliers to ensure smooth project execution.
 



 • Oversee procurement coordination, material approvals, delivery schedules, and long\-lead items.
 



 • Monitor project costs, variations, claims, progress payments, and commercial matters in coordination with the commercial and finance teams.
 



 • Conduct regular site inspections to ensure quality, safety, workmanship, and compliance with project standards.
 



 • Attend client meetings, consultant meetings, progress meetings, coordination meetings, and internal project reviews.
 



 • Identify project risks, site issues, design conflicts, and execution challenges, and provide practical solutions.
 



 • Ensure proper documentation of project records, approvals, correspondence, RFIs, MIRs, site instructions, and variation requests.
 



 • Lead the project handover process, including snagging, testing, commissioning, documentation, and final close\-out.
 



 • Represent Tashteeb professionally in meetings with clients, consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders.
 








**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field.
 



 • 10 to 15 years of proven experience in project management within fit\-out, construction, interiors, F\&B, retail, hospitality, or commercial projects.
 



 • Strong and solid experience in
 **F\&B and retail fit\-out projects** 
 is required.
 



 • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, site teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and stakeholders.
 



 • Strong knowledge of fit\-out execution, interior works, MEP coordination, finishing works, joinery, materials, and site operations.
 



 • Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, MEP, interior design, and shop drawings.
 



 • Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, cost control, quality control, safety, procurement, and handover procedures.
 



 • Excellent leadership, communication, coordination, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Ability to work under pressure, manage deadlines, and make decisions in a fast\-paced project environment.
 



 • Strong experience in client\-facing project management and consultant coordination.
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.
 



 • Candidates currently based in Saudi Arabia are preferred.
 



 • Valid and transferable Saudi Iqama is preferred.
 



 • Valid Saudi Council of Engineers membership is required or strongly preferred.
 



 • Immediate joining or short notice availability is preferred.
 



  





**Required Software Skills** 




 • Microsoft Project or Primavera P6
 



 • Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
 



 • AutoCAD
 



 • Revit / BIM knowledge is an advantage
 



 • ERP or project management systems are an advantage
 



 • Power BI or dashboard reporting tools are an advantage
 



  





**Preferred Project Experience** 




 Candidates with strong experience in the following sectors will be highly preferred:
 



 • F\&B outlets
 



 • Restaurants and cafés
 



 • Retail stores
 



 • Shopping mall fit\-out projects
 



 • Hospitality and commercial interiors
 



 • High\-end interior fit\-out projects
 



 • Turnkey fit\-out projects
 



 • Fast\-track fit\-out projects
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 If you are an experienced
 **Project Manager – Fit\-Out** 
 with strong experience in
 **F\&B and retail projects** 
 , we would be delighted to review your application.
 



 Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
 



  





 Please send your CV to:
 



**Hr@tashteeb.sa** 




 Please include the subject line:
 



**Project Manager – Fit\-Out \| Riyadh**

**About Noon**
***Radically Changing the Way People Learn!***
**Noon Academy** 
 is the leading edtech platform in the Middle East, with over 12 million students and teachers using our app to learn, teach, and collaborate. We have recently raised $41 million in Series B funding to expand our reach and impact in the region and beyond. We are on a mission to transform the physical classroom experience by introducing our highly engaging social, group\-based learning and AI to make learning fun and improve learning efficacy. Our ultimate goal is to provide access to the best teachers to every student even if that teacher is only available virtually. We believe we can do this if we blend AI, peer\-to\-peer learning, and a carefully designed physical space.
   

  

 Hear it directly from our CEO and co\-founder:
 **this**
**Learn more about us:** 
**here**
**Now: We’re laser\-focused on reinventing schools in Saudi Arabia. We’re accelerating rapidly, well\-funded, and profitable.
   

  

 Office: Full\-time, Riyadh\-based. We’ve got a sweet office near the Boulevard, and we’d love to have you in it.**
 Role Purpose
   

  

 The purpose of this role is to lead and manage the execution of expansion and engineering projects from early site assessment until final handover.
   

  

 The role will ensure that each project has a clear scope, timeline, contractor ownership, execution plan, quality control process, snagging closure, and proper handover to operations.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager \- Facilities Expansions to lead and deliver large\-scale facilities projects for a growing international education provider. This role offers the chance to manage the end\-to\-end delivery of campus expansions, refurbishment, and fit\-out programmes, ensuring projects are completed on time, on budget, and to a high standard while supporting our mission to create excellent learning environments.
   

  

 The Senior Project Manager will own the project lifecycle from planning and procurement through construction, commissioning and handover. You will work cross\-functionally with academic leaders, operations, design teams, external consultants and contractors, and will be responsible for driving schedules, cost control, risk management and quality assurance in often complex, fast\-moving settings. The role may be based remotely with regular travel to project sites; relocation is not required.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead the delivery of facilities expansion projects including new build, extensions, refurbishments and specialist learning space fit\-outs from feasibility through to handover.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, budgets, risk registers and milestone tracking; ensure robust reporting to senior stakeholders.
* Manage procurement and contract administration for consultants and contractors, ensuring compliance with procurement policies and best practice.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams including architects, engineers, MEP, AV/IT and specialist suppliers to translate educational requirements into built outcomes.
* Drive site\-based project management including programme management, site supervision, quality control, health \& safety compliance and statutory approvals.
* Implement effective quality assurance and commissioning processes to ensure completed works meet functional, technical and safety standards.
* Manage stakeholder engagement with school leaders, operations, finance and external authorities to align project delivery with operational needs and academic calendars.
* Provide mentorship and line management to project team members and contribute to continuous improvement of project delivery frameworks and templates.


**Must\-Have Requirements**
* Proven track record delivering complex facilities projects (new build and refurbishments) valued at £2m\+ or equivalent international projects.
* Chartered or professionally recognised qualification in construction, engineering, project management or related discipline (e.g., MRICS, CEng, PMP, CIOB).
* Minimum 7\+ years’ relevant experience managing design and construction projects with responsibility for budgets, programmes and procurement.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience of contract administration (NEC, JCT, FIDIC or equivalent).
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to present to senior leadership and external authorities.
* Demonstrable experience of site\-based project management, health \& safety compliance and quality assurance processes.
* Able to work full\-time Sunday to Thursday (GMT \+3\) where required for coordination with regional teams and project sites. Some flexibility for site visits outside these hours may be required.
* Right to work in relevant locations and ability to travel regularly to project sites (regional travel may be required).


**Highly Advantageous**
* Experience delivering projects within the education sector or other client\-facing environments where minimising disruption to operations is critical.
* Familiarity with sustainable design principles, BREEAM, LEED or other environmental standards.
* Experience working in the Middle East or with regional statutory authorities and local supply chains.
* Arabic language ability.


**What We’re Really Looking For**
* A pragmatic, solutions\-focused project leader who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys balancing technical delivery with strong stakeholder relationships.
* Someone who can confidently own projects end\-to\-end, make decisive trade\-offs, and maintain high standards of quality and safety.
* A collaborative team player who can mentor others and help mature project delivery processes across the organisation.


**Who This Role Is (and Isn’t) For**
* Ideal for: Experienced senior project managers or construction leads who have managed multi\-million pound projects and want to apply their skills to create outstanding educational facilities.
* Not for: Individuals who prefer purely office\-based or purely design\-only roles without responsibility for on\-site delivery and stakeholder coordination.


**Other details:**
* The is site\-based depending on project needs. Regular travel to sites and occasional overnight stays may be required.
* We are looking for someone who can start at short notice.


**How To Apply**
* If this role aligns with your experience and ambitions and you want to contribute to delivering world\-class learning environments, we would love to hear from you. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted to go through a structured hiring process. Join us and help shape inspiring spaces for students and staff.


 Noon Academy is the leading edtech platform in the Middle East, with over 14 million students and teachers using our app to learn, teach, and collaborate. We have recently raised $41 million in Series B funding to expand our reach and impact in the region and beyond. We are on a mission to transform the physical classroom experience by introducing our highly engaging social, group\-based learning and AI to make learning fun and improve learning efficacy. Our ultimate goal is to provide access to the best teachers to every student even if that teacher is only available virtually. We believe we can do this if we blend AI, peer\-to\-peer learning, and a carefully designed physical space.

 The role will work across Strategy, Development, Finance, Operational Readiness, Commercial, Programming and third\-party operators or service partners to optimise performance, govern delivery and ensure QIC retains appropriate oversight over business planning, programming direction, customer experience, partnerships, brand positioning and long\-term value creation across the QPAC asset.

* Define strategic objectives, commercial frameworks and operating principles across live performance, venue utilisation, ancillary revenue, hospitality and non\-event activation
* Support operating model development, partner strategy and business plan challenge to ensure QIC retains decision\-making authority over key commercial, customer and brand levers
* Relationship Management:
* Build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders, cultural institutions, artists, promoters, operators, advisors, government entities and commercial partners
* Act as the key owner\-side point of contact on operational, commercial and asset performance matters for QPAC

* Financial Oversight:
* Review and challenge business plans, budgets and forecasts to ensure commercial robustness and alignment with owner expectations
* Drive achievement of financial targets, with a focus on sustainable revenue growth, EBITDA delivery and efficient asset utilisation
* Analyse operating data and financial results to identify upside opportunities, performance risks and value enhancement initiatives
* Support reporting and recommendations for executive stakeholders on asset performance, commercial outlook and investment implications
* Customer Experience and Programming:

* Commercial, Marketing and Partnerships:

* Mentor team members and foster a high\-performance, commercially focused asset management culture
* Provide owner\-side leadership on mobilisation, governance and escalation of key risks and decisions

 Revenue growth, EBITDA, attendance, average ticket yield, venue utilisation, ancillary spend per visitor, sponsorship and partnership income, customer satisfaction and long\-term return on investment.

data.jd_text:
**Description:** 
 The WADPM shall develop, revise, and maintain an airfield driving program to ensure the safe operations of vehicles, aircraft, and pedestrian movement on and around the airfield environment IAW DAFI 13\-213,
 *Airfield Driving* 
 . The WADPM shall solicit help from base senior leadership and other various base support agencies to ensure the program is effectively implemented and managed. The WADPM shall provide all initial and recurring airfield drivers’ training for all unit level Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPMs) and all airfield drivers. The WADPM will ensure reporting of Controlled Movement Area Violations and other significant events in Amentum’s MIS system, to appropriate Wing leadership, and as required in DAFMAN 13\-204 and DAFI 13\-213\. The WADPM will conduct spot checks to enforce and monitor compliance with airfield driving procedures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Must have a \*7\-skill level from an approved DoD institution or civilian equivalent.
* Have documented knowledge or experience with ICAO procedures. Have a minimum of 1 year experience implementing airfield safety procedures and generating and facilitating airfield flight line drivers program.
* Ability to coordinate with Wing Safety, Airfield Management, Airfield Operations, and tenant units.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for program documentation, briefings, and incident reporting.
* Familiarity with airfield operations, ATC radio phraseology, airfield risk management, and airfield safety programs.
* Ability to obtain/maintain a US Secret Clearance (Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain/maintain the clearance)


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Serve as the Wing’s designated Airfield Driving Program Manager, responsible for the full lifecycle of the Airfield Driving Program.
* Develop, maintain, and update the Wing Airfield Driving Instruction (ADI), training and testing materials, and local operating procedures.
* Train unit ADPMs and certify them to administer, test and train personnel assigned to their unit.
* Conduct initial, recurring, and remedial airfield driving training, including classroom instruction, practical evaluations and competency assessments.
* Maintain program records, training logs, violation reports, and certification documentation in accordance with DoD and USAF requirements
* Manage the issuance, tracking, and revocation of Airfield Driving Licenses, ensuring compliance with DAFI 13\-213 and local directives.
* Oversee the Runway Incursion Prevention Program, including trend analysis, corrective actions, and coordination with Wing Safety
* Lead investigations for airfield driving violations, runway incursions, and safety incidents; develop corrective action plans and report findings to Airfield Management leadership.
* Conduct program audits of individual unit programs, spot checks, and unit compliance inspections to ensure adherence to airfield driving standards.
* Provide recurring briefings to Wing leadership on program status, compliance issues, and risk mitigation measures.

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you ready to shape the learning architecture of our digitally native airline and its workforce?
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary and commercially astute Director of Talent Development to lead our enterprise\-wide Learning \& Development strategy thereby building a future ready, safety centered and high\-performing organisation.
   

  

 Yours is a role responsible for building a future\-ready workforce that strengthens safety, performance, and long\-term growth. You are expected to oversee high\-impact learning delivery using blended, digital, simulation\-based, and experiential methods tailored to aviation.
   

  

 Partnering closely with senior leaders, you will ensure leadership depth, regulatory compliance, and workforce readiness across all functions.
   

  

 Importantly, your remit includes integrating leadership development, safety/compliance learning, operational training, and digital capability building into a unified enterprise framework. Further, you will design and implement a fully integrated airline learning ecosystem spanning safety, regulatory, operational, leadership, and digital capabilities.
   

  

 Central to your success in this role is the ability to own and manage the Talent Development budget, ensuring strategic ROI. Moreover, you will t rack and report KPIs including bench strength, capability readiness, and program effectiveness.
   

  

 You will also ensure regulatory alignment with key aviation bodies including the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), International Air Transport Association (IATA) and the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), integrating compliance requirements into enterprise learning frameworks and operational governance.
   

  

 If you are passionate about building future\-ready leaders, strengthening safety culture, and shaping capability at scale, we invite you to lead the next chapter of our talent journey.
   

  

**About You**
 Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 10 years of sound leadership experience within an L\&D or Talent Development capacity interpreting strategy and policy in order to set and deliver objectives within the medium to long term.
   

  

 We’d love to hear from you even more if you are a bilingual Saudi national with proven leadership experience.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Project Director – Airport Systems Integration to join our team. The Project Director will serve as the single point of accountability for the delivery of the Master Systems Integrator (MSI) scope across both Terminal and Airfield systems packages within a major international airport development program.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Directs the overall delivery of the MSI scope across Terminal and Airfield systems packages for a major international airport development programme.Provides executive leadership for all programme governance activities related to systems integration, testing \& commissioning, operational readiness, and phased system activation.
* Acts as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders, airport operators, aviation authorities, EPC contractors, IVVQ consultants, and regulatory agencies.
* Leads programme\-wide integration assurance activities to ensure all systems interfaces are coordinated, validated, tested, and operationally compliant.
* Establishes and oversees Systems Assurance processes including requirements traceability, verification and validation, compliance demonstration, integration evidence management, and acceptance readiness reporting.
* Oversees the implementation and integration of airport operational systems including AODB, A\-SMGCS, ALCMS, AOCC, RMS, FIDS, ATMS, CNS Systems, ICT infrastructure, security systems, baggage handling systems, middleware platforms and associated operational technologies.
* Ensures all systems delivery activities comply with applicable aviation regulations, airport operational standards, cybersecurity requirements, and programme governance procedures.
* Establishes programme\-wide interface governance processes including interface identification, ownership assignment, issue resolution, escalation management, and interface closure verification.
* Directs programme\-level testing and commissioning strategies including factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, integrated systems testing, operational validation, and phased go\-live activities.
* Directs integrated testing and validation activities including Systems Integration Testing (SIT), System\-Centric Integration Testins (SCIT), operational validation, stakeholder demonstrations, and readiness assessment across interfacing systems.
* Maintains oversight of integration\-related risks, dependencies, assumptions, constraints, and interface issues that may impact programme delivery, testing activities, and operational readiness.
* Ensures all operational readiness obligations are achieved in alignment with airport activation strategies and stakeholder acceptance requirements.Provides executive oversight of change management processes related to systems scope, interfaces, operational impacts, schedule changes, and technical compliance.
* Establishes and leads integration governance forums, technical working groups, readiness reviews, interface review boards, and executive reporting mechanisms to support programme\-wide decision making.
* Leads multidisciplinary teams including systems managers, integration leads, testing \& commissioning teams, ORAT specialists, and quality personnel.
* Represents Parsons in executive\-level meetings, technical reviews, programme governance forums, and client leadership engagements.


**What Required Skills You'll Bring**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aviation Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications Engineering, or related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PgMP, INCOSE Systems Engineering, ITIL, or equivalent are desirable.
* Minimum 20 years of professional experience in large\-scale infrastructure, aviation, airport systems, or complex technology integration programmes.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in major international airport programmes involving systems integration, operational technologies, or airport\-wide systems delivery.
* Demonstrated experience delivering airport systems programmes through testing, commissioning, operational readiness, and activation phases. Strong experience managing multidisciplinary delivery teams within large\-scale PMC, EPC, MSI, or integrated delivery environments.
* GCC airport programme experience is highly desirable.


**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**
* Strong leadership and programme governance capabilities within complex aviation environments.
* Excellent understanding of programme delivery methodologies, interface management principles, and systems assurance processes.
* Prover ability to manage complex stakeholder environments involving regulators, operators, contractors, specialist consultants, and technology providers
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams across multiple delivery workstreams and operational interfaces.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and executive reporting skills.

data.jd_text:
Qiddiya Investment Company (QIC) is seeking a highly experienced and design\-literate Executive Director \- Transport Hubs to lead the planning, design management, and delivery of all major transport facilities across the Qiddiya development.
   

  

 This role will have overarching responsibility for a portfolio of complex transport\-related projects, including multimodal stations, interchanges, terminals, and supporting infrastructure that form critical components of the city's mobility network and will becomes pivotal places within the public realm and customer experience for visitors to Qiddiya.
   

  

 The Executive Director will operate at both strategic and delivery levels, setting design direction, overseeing engineering integration, and ensuring safe, timely, and coordinated project execution. This includes building team culture, leading project governance, overseeing multidisciplinary teams, and serving as the key interface between architecture, engineering, transport planning, and construction delivery. The role is expected to balance operational requirements with architectural and public space quality, acting as a connector across design and technical domains.
   

  

 Drawing on a background in both architecture and infrastructure delivery, you will oversee the delivery of high\-profile metro, rail, public transport station and associated public domain programs leading the full asset lifecycle. This includes early\-stage planning and feasibility, through procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover.
   

  

 The position plays a key leadership role in shaping the future of Qiddiya's transport system, ensuring that hubs and interchanges are not only technically functional but also embedded in the broader civic and urban contexts supporting a seamless, intuitive, and high\-quality customer experience.
   

  

 Define and lead delivery of station and interchange infrastructure across Qiddiya
   

  

 Coordinate integration of transport components (e.g., metro stations, rail platforms, bus terminals, public domain elements) into the urban masterplan with spatial and functional coherence.
   

  

 Manage multi\-disciplinary teams of architects, engineers, transport planners, and contractors through all project phases.
   

  

 Consider the customer experience in all facets of planning, delivery and operations and embed the customer team in all interchange planning
   

  

 Consider phased delivery over time and the possible need for interim measures to be in place as surrounding precinct assets are progressively opened.
   

  

 Collaborate across all districts of Qiddiya and understand district needs, land use mix, customer access needs, peak and normal visitation flows and the mobility solutions that lead to success.
   

  

 Balance architectural quality, structural performance, accessibility, and passenger flow in design and execution.
   

  

 Establish divisional design standards, procurement strategies, and technical governance.
   

  

 Oversee connectivity across modes—rail, metro, road, autonomous vehicles, cycling, and pedestrian networks.
   

  

 Lead program\-level oversight on cost, risk, schedule, quality, and safety
   

  

 Coordinate with government, regulators, infrastructure partners for approvals and compliance
   

  

 Advise executive leadership on strategic phasing, prioritization, and operational readiness.
   

  

 Engage with government agencies, regulatory bodies, and delivery partners to secure approvals and maintain compliance.
   

  

 Ensure technical performance, spatial quality, accessibility, and user experience are appropriately balanced in all transport\-related assets.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-disciplinary teams and interface between design ambition and technical delivery.
   

  

 Proven experience leading complex projects blending both transport infrastructure with civic\-scaled public domain, place making, activation and customer experience outcomes.
   

  

 Familiarity with project governance, stakeholder engagement, and regulatory coordination.
   

  

 Strong collaborator and proven ability to build quality internal team and external stakeholder relationships.
   

  

 Ability to balance program\-wide oversight with attention to project\-level design, functionality, and constructability.
   

  

 Effective communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 18 years of experience leading complex transport\-related projects, including significant public transport buildings or interchanges.
   

  

 Degree in Architecture (preferred) or Engineering postgraduate qualification preferred.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Competitive salary and attractive benefits package

data.jd_text:
Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting\-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.
   

  





 With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis has long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 The Director of Facilities Management provides strategic, technical, and operational leadership for the full lifecycle management of the organisation’s built and natural assets. This role oversees the planning, mobilisation, operation, and continuous improvement of all Facilities Management (FM) and Landscape Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) services across a complex, multi‑site programme, ensuring world‑class service delivery, promoting best\-practice asset management, and acts as a Senior advisor to the Executive Leadership, Government Agencies, and internal and external stakeholders.
   

  





 The Facilities Management Director is responsible to provide the overall Landscape Operations and Maintenance support to RCRC during the lifecycle of all programme components.
   

  

  

  





**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Governance**



* Develop and implement the organisation’s comprehensive FM and Landscape O\&M strategy aligned with long‑term corporate objectives.
* Establish governance frameworks, performance management systems, SLAs, and KPIs for all FM disciplines (hard, soft, infrastructure, and landscape).
* Lead strategic asset management planning, including lifecycle cost modelling, capital replacement strategies, and sustainability\-focused asset performance improvements.
* Represent the FM function at executive committees, senior leadership briefings, and cross‑government steering groups.



  

  





**2\. Lifecycle \& Operational Management**



* Provide expert guidance throughout the full asset lifecycle: design review, mobilisation, operation, maintenance, optimisation, and decommissioning.
* Ensure that all assets and facilities achieve optimal operational availability, resilience, and compliance.
* Direct the mobilisation of FM and O\&M contracts, establish operational readiness programmes, and oversee contractor onboarding and performance.
* Ensure operations integrate seamlessly with the broader urban, environmental, and community context.



  

  





**3\. Procurement, Contracts \& Commercial Oversight**



* Lead the development of procurement strategies, technical documentation, scopes of work, and high‑quality RFPs for all FM and O\&M services.
* Manage the full tendering process including bid evaluation, technical and commercial assessment, negotiation, and contract award.
* Maintain full budgetary and financial control, ensuring cost forecasting, contract variations, cash\-flow analysis, and risk/opportunity tracking are accurate and timely.
* Drive value engineering, cost optimisation, and commercial innovation across the FM portfolio.



  

  





**4\. Performance, Compliance \& Risk Management**



* Ensure all facilities, operations, and contractors comply with regulatory, statutory, environmental, and HSE requirements.
* Oversee the creation of risk registers, emergency preparedness plans, and business continuity strategies.
* Implement quality assurance frameworks to monitor performance and ensure consistent, high‑quality delivery across all service providers.
* Conduct regular reviews of O\&M delivery, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective measures.



  

  





**5\. Stakeholder \& Client Leadership**



* Serve as the senior point of contact for government entities, municipalities, regulatory bodies, clients, community groups, and internal stakeholders.
* Lead high‑level presentations, executive reporting, workshops, and strategic planning sessions.
* Build strong collaborative relationships with partners, service providers, and cross‑functional teams to ensure organisational alignment.



  

  





**6\. Team Leadership \& Talent Development**



* Lead, mentor, and develop a multi\-disciplinary team of FM, landscape, engineering, and O\&M professionals.
* Cultivate a high‑performance culture emphasising accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Identify capability gaps and drive training, succession planning, and professional development initiatives.
 
**Technical \& Professional Skills**
* Extensive experience (15\+ years) in Facilities \& Asset Management of large, complex, multi\-site environments.
* Deep knowledge of O\&M across hard services, soft services, infrastructure, and large\-scale landscape environments.


**Qualifications**

 Bachelor’s Degree in Facilities Management, bachelor’s degree in urban design, architecture or landscape or Equivalent

 Years of Experience (min) 15

Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 Directly manage and guide specialized technical leads, including the Incident managers, Support \& Operations team, Upgrade \& Deployment Lead, KPI Reporting \& Analytics Lead, Drive Test Lead, and Knowledge Transfer Lead.
   

  

**Job Description**
 A Service Delivery Manager (SDM) provides oversight of the operational health of the customer system, from service delivery through lifecycle support. The SDM ensures and may manage internal \& external resources to deliver services and maintain their compliance with customer contractual commitments.
   

  

 The SDM establishes standard procedures designed to ensure consistently high service performance, monitors employees and evaluates customer feedback to develop quality improvement processes. The SDM is responsible for customer success as defined by success criteria during the transition phase
   

  

 A Service Delivery Manager is assigned to one or more of MSI’s customers depending on the size of the system and its complexity. A SDM is expected to have or develop a detailed knowledge of the customer’s system and their operational staff.
   

  

**Responsibility**
 The main role of the Service Delivery Manager is to facilitate customer success by adhering to global service delivery processes related to the customer. The Service Delivery Manager also acts as the main interface between MSI and the customer.
   

  

 The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing specialized Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) and deployment functions for the STC Nationwide Kodiak MCX network. Operating alongside the Customer Service Manager (CSM), the SDM leads dedicated technical teams to ensure seamless application upgrades, rigorous performance tracking, and effective knowledge transfer to support the mission\-critical environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities

**Role Summary**
 The Manager / Asst Manager, Governance plays a critical enabling role within the Sports Business Unit's Governance \& Stakeholder Management team. Working at the intersection of governance frameworks, data management, and stakeholder reporting, this role is responsible for maintaining the integrity of governance information systems, producing high\-quality reporting outputs, and ensuring that stakeholder engagement activities are underpinned by accurate, timely, and well\-structured data.
   

  

 This is an operational and analytical role suited to a governance professional who thrives on bringing rigour and systems\-thinking to complex, fast\-moving project environments. The successful candidate will support the Director and team leads in driving accountability and transparency across the Sports BU's major assets — including the National Tennis Centre, Athletics Stadium, and Elite Combat Institute — as Qiddiya advances toward the Vision 2030 delivery milestones.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Governance Data \& Reporting**
* Maintain and continuously improve the team's governance data registers, including action logs, decision trackers, approval matrices, and stakeholder engagement records
* Produce regular governance reporting outputs (weekly, monthly, and ad hoc) for internal forums including the Project Control Group (PCG), N\-1 Subcommittee, Stage Gate Review Panel (SGRP), and Development Committee
* Consolidate and quality\-assure data from multiple project streams into coherent reporting packs, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with approved frameworks
* Track and report on delegations of authority (DoA) utilisation, approval pipeline status, and post\-approval implementation against governance milestones


**Stakeholder Engagement Systems \& Reporting**
* Maintain the Sports BU Stakeholder Engagement Management System (SEMS), ensuring all engagement activities, commitments, and outcomes are accurately recorded and up to date
* Produce stakeholder reporting dashboards and summaries that enable the team to track engagement progress against KPIs and commitments, including engagements with federations (FIFA, AFC, IOC) and government partners
* Support the design and continuous improvement of data capture templates, workflows, and reporting tools to facilitate efficient stakeholder engagement tracking across the team
* Coordinate with team members responsible for frontline stakeholder engagement to gather inputs and translate field activities into structured, reportable data


**Tools, Systems \& Process Improvement**
* Administer and develop SharePoint/Power Platform\-based governance tools, including list management, form design, and automated workflows to support team reporting needs
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce manual effort in data collection and reporting, leveraging Microsoft 365 tools (Excel, Power BI, SharePoint, Teams)
* Prepare governance forum packs, presentations, and briefing materials drawing on data from multiple internal sources, ensuring materials are accurate and deadline\-ready
* Maintain version control and document management discipline across governance repositories


**Team Support \& Coordination**
* Support the Director and team leads with the preparation of executive\-level governance deliverables including stage gate submissions, DoA proposals, and committee briefings
* Coordinate cross\-functional inputs required for governance submissions, liaising with project teams, commercial advisors, and delivery partners as required
* Maintain and distribute action and decision registers following governance forum meetings, tracking accountability and escalating overdue items


**Requirements**
**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Management, or a related discipline
* 8\-10 years of experience in a governance, PMO, project controls, or reporting function, preferably within large\-scale infrastructure, real estate, or sports development environments
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, dashboards, complex formulas) and PowerPoint; working knowledge of Power BI or equivalent data visualisation tools
* Experience administering or building SharePoint\-based document management or reporting systems
* Strong attention to detail with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple data streams and produce accurate, deadline\-driven reporting
* Excellent written communication skills in English; ability to distil complex information into clear governance outputs
* Familiarity with delegation of authority frameworks, stage gate processes, or equivalent project approval mechanisms


**Preferred Qualifications \& Skills**
* Experience working within a giga\-project, megaproject, or Vision 2030\-aligned delivery environment in Saudi Arabia
* Knowledge of stakeholder engagement management systems or CRM\-style platforms used in a project governance context
* Experience with Power Automate or Power Apps for workflow automation
* Professional certification in project management (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent)

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 The ITS Director for Fare Collection Systems with a minimum of 12 years senior technical and management experience and a university degree, shall be responsible for the overall management, performance, and integration of the fare collection system of the Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) across the Public Transport Network. This includes AFC (Automatic Fare Collection), CCC (Customer Contact Center) and associated systems and interfaces, including integration with external stakeholders such as the Metro Network. He shall ensure that the interfaces between the ITS Contractors and the other project transport operators are efficient and implemented in sufficient time to allow for the smooth operation of the Bus and metro systems. He shall be responsible for all ITS\-related technical deliverables on behalf of the Employer and shall ensure that no scope or responsibility gaps exist across Contractors or systems. He shall be responsible for system performance, revenue management, Central Clearing House, stakeholder reporting, vendor management and compliance with RCRC/contract obligations. The role ensures that all ITS systems operate efficiently, meet contractual KPIs, and support seamless public transport operations across around 1,000 metro and bus stations.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Oversee the performance, reliability of the Fare collection systems including AFC, CCC as well as all integration with AVM and Journey Planning systems.
* Ensure effective interface management between Bus Contractors, ITS Contractors, and external systems and stakeholders such as Metro.
* Monitor system performance and resolve inconsistencies, faults, and integration issues.
* Ensure robust revenue collection and management processes are implemented between the operators and the Client finance department.
* Ensure contractors meet contractual KPIs and performance targets.
* Oversee maintenance, backup, cybersecurity, and data protection practices for all systems.
* Lead vendor and contractor management related to ITS systems.
* Ensure proper implementation of software management best practices and data security requirements.
* Review and approve all technical deliverables submitted by ITS contractors.
* Identify and close any responsibility gaps related to ITS scope.
* Ensure timely implementation of interfaces to support smooth bus operations.
* Lead stakeholder reporting related to ITS performance and compliance.
* Support operational readiness and continuous improvement initiatives.


 Qualification \& Education Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor degree in Engineering, IT, or related field


**Mandatory Experience**
* Minimum 12 years of experience in ITS and transport systems or related fields
* Proven experience in managing large\-scale ITS systems integrations and management of their operations and maintenance

**Requirements**
 Bachelor's degree in business, finance, real estate, sport management, hospitality, equine management, or a related discipline.
   

  

 Strong experience in equestrian, racecourse, venues, entertainment, leisure, or major event asset management and operations.
   

  

 Experience in pre\-opening, operator mobilisation, business planning, and owner\-side governance of complex destination assets.
   

  

 Relevant professional certifications or memberships in asset management, project management, finance, hospitality, sports management, or equestrian\-related disciplines are preferred.
   

  

 10\+ years of relevant experience in asset management, venue operations, equestrian, sports, entertainment, leisure, or related sectors.

* Develop and maintain hospitality benchmarks, integrating design metrics with cost positions.
* Support the HBU Benchmarking Database with consistent, high‑quality data.
* Feasibility
* Review feasibility inputs, validate assumptions and test multiple development scenarios.
* Market Awareness
* Monitor market trends, escalation, procurement conditions and contractor pricing intelligence.
* Cost Leadership
* Mentor senior managers and promote consistent ways of working within the Cost Planning team.
* Establish KPIs for effectiveness, support professional development and enhance collaboration across BUs.

* Strong Middle East experience delivering villas, townhouses and low‑rise hospitality projects.

This role is crucial in shaping the transportation framework for our groundbreaking entertainment destination, ensuring that all transport systems support the connectivity and accessibility of Qiddiya for both visitors and residents alike.
   

  

 As the Senior Director of Transport Strategy, you will be responsible for developing a comprehensive transport strategy that aligns with Qiddiya's overarching goals, facilitating seamless mobility across the project. You will collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders and lead cross\-functional teams to establish innovative and sustainable transport solutions that enhance visitor experience and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead transport modelling centrally to ensure consistency across Qiddiya and inform development controls
* Lead (at City level) the provision of Transport data to Transport projects to inform system design
* Lead (at City level) the phasing plan and measurement against capacity of networks to inform when roads and transport systems need to be activated to meet development phasing
* Lead (at City level) engagement with key stakeholders to ensure integration with regional mobility
* Lead (at City level) the informing and testing of development controls via Traffic Impact Studies at district, asset or precinct level
* Lead all internal and external governance (including any authority or government agency) interactions including (but not limited to) those required for approvals, stakeholder interaction etc
* Lead all activities required to undertake your responsibilities, including (but not limited to) consultant procurement, management and contract management, committee presentations, gateway approvals etc
* Lead preparations for opening and operational readiness scenarios specific to transport modes
* Lead the preparation of impact assessments as a result of changes or other factors, including the impacts on cost, time and quality
* Lead the support of all other job families as necessary
* Lead the quarterly update of the Qiddiya Strategic Transport Model
* Lead the maintenance, improvement and evolution of the Qiddiya Strategic Transport Model such that it is fit for the purpose of guiding development activities
* Lead the preparation of transport policies across Qiddiya, including (but not limited to) the approach to Operational Logistic delivery times, Congestion/Zero Emission Zone Charging, Autonomous vehicles, Artificial Intelligence, Flexible/Remote working, EV Charging, Airspace, Fare Collection, Construction deliveries, Transport maintenance etc
* Lead the strategy for maximising customer transport experience, and review of all submissions to ensure these are being maximised
* Lead the strategy for operational logistics and review of all submissions to ensure these are being maximised
* Lead the strategy for event planning (Minor and Major) and review of all submissions to ensure these are being maximised
* Lead the strategy for airspace management and review of all submissions to ensure these are being maximised
* Lead the strategy for future mobility and review of all submissions to ensure these are being maximised
* Lead the independent technical review of all transport departures or relaxations, to provide clear recommendations to the business for acceptance or otherwise
* Lead the management of the Mobility City Framework reports, guidelines, codes and standards and plans to ensure consistency of information and betterment as necessary
* Lead internal processes and policy to ensure consistency of design applications
* Lead the management of regional mobility authority stakeholder relationships and ensure integration with regional systems


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Transport Engineering, Urban Planning, Business Administration, or a related field (Master's degree preferred)
* A minimum of 15 years of experience in transport strategy, planning, or a related field, particularly in large\-scale urban projects
* Strong understanding of transportation systems, mobility trends, and best practices in transport planning
* Proven ability to lead complex projects and collaborate with diverse stakeholders and governmental agencies
* Excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills with a focus on problem\-solving
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively present ideas and influence stakeholders
* Experience with sustainable transport principles and innovations in transportation technology
* Proficiency in transport planning software and modeling tools

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Visa Direct is a set of solutions that Visa provides to facilitate money movement across cards, accounts and wallets addressing needs of the markets through variety of the use cases (i.e. P2P, B2B. B2C). The product portfolio includes Visa Direct (Card, Account \& Wallet) and Currency Cloud.
   

  

 The Head of Visa Direct KBO leads the Money Movement sales and commercialization responsibilities across all product suites. Responsibilities cover the complete span \- sizing the opportunity, thinking through and building the money movement strategy in line with the country business objectives, identifying use cases, engaging internal and external stakeholders to deploy money movement solutions. These new solutions must be deployed keeping in mind the evolving market, client, and consumer needs with the objective of driving significant future market growth for Visa in emerging markets. The role holder must possess a unique blend of sales, commercialization and implementation skills as well have an intimate understanding of payments, mobile technology, consumer behavior, and Visa’s business. The role will work cross\-functionally with other functional teams in the markets and coordinate the product roadmap and learnings from the wider regional money movement teams.
   

  

 This is a matrixed, cross\-functional role – requiring critical organizational and interpersonal skills – as we interface with country teams, specialized product groups, financial institution sales, merchant and acquiring sales, client consulting, marketing, corporate communications, legal, and finance to coordinate the end goal of achieving our business growth objectives. Visa is looking for an individual with demonstrated thought leadership, a strategic business growth mindset and a proven record of success in fast\-paced environments with demanding timelines, preferably with experience in enterprise sales for multinational organizations.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Achieve or exceed aggressive sales and revenue targets for the region
+ Achieve annual sales and revenue goals for Money Movement, in partnership with country Account Executive (AE) teams.
+ Take clients through the sales cycle, from prospecting and solutioning through to deal structure and contracting.
+ Develop business and sales strategy for sales acceleration, including determining high potential client targets, use cases, verticals, etc.

* Develop and execute the strategy including determining high potential markets, use cases, and verticals, and how to deploy our resources for optimal growth
+ Leverage market\-sizing study along with regional deep dives to develop the target use cases and clients.
+ Ensure sellers know about and have access to client\-ready, legal\-approved sales materials.
+ Develop strategies and work with stakeholders on new use cases, including the wider Money Movement product/client teams for regional expansion plans.
+ Identify trends in each market where real\-time payments can solve pain points and develop objection handling materials.

* Solution Deployment. Be a thought leader and influencer in developing and deploying the solution in the market. The role holder must manage the full cycle of Money Movement deployment \- articulation of the solution's value proposition for internal and external stakeholders, test the plan with key partners, and institute program management for effective deployment and tracking of the agreed plan.
* Go\-to\-market plans. Success of new solutions/platforms requires seamless execution based on carefully designed market plans. This role leads in defining market plans for Money Movement with specific focus on defined target markets and solutions.
* Drive three key workstreams for Money Movement growth:
+ Work with existing Visa clients and their Account Executives to determine product fit and cross\-sell Money Movement solutions.
+ Lead prospecting for non\-Visa clients to uncover opportunities, build relationships, and sell products.
+ Identify and sell to acquirers, processors, gateways, and Fintechs to have them add Money Movement product suite to their portfolio of client offerings.

* Drive pipeline development and review processes in the region
+ Drive consolidation and roll\-up of all pipelines and progress across multiple sales teams in the region to summary level and report back to Money Movement leadership.
+ Champion multi\-product and/or cross\-regional solutions and pricing through deal review process.
+ Support the regional Money Movement executive in Steering Committee material development.

* Build the Money Movement team and lead them through transformational change
+ Determine how to deploy our Commercialization and Sales Engineering resources, for optimal growth across the wide set of markets, flows, and opportunities.
+ Establish team roles, build job requirements, hire and onboard new team members as necessary.
+ Lead annual team goal planning and execution plans with country AE teams.
+ Work with the team on engagement and professional development.

* Work with cross\-functional partners across the region to ensure we have what we need to be successful with our clients
+ Work with wider stakeholders (Marketing, Finance, Legal, Client Services) to ensure all aspects of client\-facing engagement materials are:
- Aligned to Visa standards.
- Relevant for external audiences through structured messaging/communication.
- Follow deal review structure and approval processes, and
- Handed off from Sales to Implementation stages to ensure well\-run projects.

* Create and implement a procedure to gather client feedback on products and value\-added services and communicate these insights with the Money Movement team and broader Visa teams.
* Work with regional and global Money Movement product teams and operations to understand the state of Issuer readiness, client implementations status, and post\-launch support.
* People leader. Serve as a role model for the team. Be accountable for commitments, promote transparency and healthy debate on key issues, and demonstrate ethical behavior, and act with integrity. Lead talent initiatives including attracting, retaining, and developing high\-performing employees and ensuring the team is staffed and motivated to deliver Money Movement regional and global objectives.


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Creative Self\-starter with a bias toward action and proven track record for successfully commercialising payments technology products that delight customers.
* 10\+ years of Payments\-related and leadership experience, including at least 5 years of experience leading commercialisation teams, product management, strategy development and/or management consulting.
* Visa and/or payment industry knowledge required; Experience with push payments, real\-time payments, FI solutions – strongly preferred.
* Direct exposure to digital payment solutions, emerging payments domain and ideation/go\-to\-market approach, e.g. mobile money, remittances, payment cards, ISO 20022, RTP, API\-based platforms, overlay services such as Alias, etc.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with a strong focus on delivering for clients.
* Excellent listening and communication skills (both verbal and written).
* Executive presence – must be able to interface with senior client executives.
* Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way to drive product adoption.
* Demonstrated thought leadership, aptitude to think creatively and identify new ways to innovate and differentiate products with evidence of tangible business results.
* Passionate about what you do and excited about the opportunity to transform payments working for the industry leader.
* Ability to inspire direct reports and influence those without direct supervisory responsibility.
* Possess high levels of professionalism and leadership skills to build business relationships, trust and respect with new entities / enablers.
* Strong collaborator, self\-motivated and the ability to work independently at coordinating across functional activities, obtain buy\-in and elevate issues at critical junctures appropriately.
* An advanced degree from a top school strongly preferred.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
