data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The overall role for the position is to assist SVP/ VP to drive cultural change around Lean across QNB Group. The incumbent will be responsible for leading and managing the Group’s Lean and Six Sigma agenda under the Innovation department. Responsibility includes owning, leading and managing selected portfolio of Lean projects across QNB Group’s international network with minimal supervision.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial: \- Deliver and execute on the initiation, execution and implementation of operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives under his/ her scope and support divisions within QNB Group \- Assist the VP to develop and deploy Lean/ Six Sigma/ Change Management standards and the process improvement methodology within QNB Group \- Contribute to develop/ create the metrics/ key performance indicators (KPIs), for performance monitoring and quality measurement purposes related to dedicated operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives on a periodic basis \- Implements KPI’s and best practices for Assistant Vice President, Lean Transformation role. \- Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank. \- Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.
* Customer (Internal \& External): \- Ensure relevant training and coaching on the methodology to designated multipliers within the organization \- Drive operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives under his/ her scope, with a focus on customer orientation, service and service quality \- Act as a partner to the concerned business and support divisions and lead process improvement projects together with representatives from one or more business and support divisions and \- Deliver training and coaching of others in applying Lean/ Six Sigma and process reengineering methodology \- Assist in creating awareness within QNB Group for client orientation, quality and efficiency \- Establish and maintain strong working relationships and support units within QNB Group with regards to operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives as well as with regards to Lean/ Six Sigma tools \- Identify new solutions or processes into ongoing operations within QNB Group.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory): \- Interact with SVP/ VP Lean Transformation to obtain new process improvement mandates and participate in project idea generation, selection and scoping \- Support the business and support divisions in successfully managing and leading the implementation of strategic initiatives under his/ her scope \- Identify benefits, quantify targeted results, establish measurement criteria and assist in the prioritization of process improvement initiatives \- Manage or assist the VP to manage multiple projects and/ or assume the role of leading a larger projects under his/ her scope \- Direct and control all work performed within the project framework of the DMAIC phases \- Ensure projects under his/ her scope remain on time, on budget and deliver expected results \- Ensure industry best practices and standards within the execution of process improvement assignments \- Evaluate data and trends to identify improvement opportunities and associated issues and risks and perform statistical process analyses \- Provide advice, input and guidance to process improvement teams regarding change management, process redesign strategies, performance improvement toolsets (especially those of Six Sigma and Lean), and technical expertise, such as statistical process control and data analysis \- Coach internal process improvement teams to further refine and develop Lean/ Six Sigma tools within QNB Group to improve the quality and service \- Participate in the deployment of other performance improvement methodologies.
* Learning \& Knowledge: \- Identify related areas for professional self\-development. Ensure the provision of relevant guidance, direction and training to subordinates to develop and enhance their skills \- Defines further training needs required and is responsible for career development of his subordinates \- Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities. \- Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities: \- Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy). \- Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks. \- Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy. \- Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements. \- Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role. \- Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence. \- Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other: \- Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information. \- Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators. \- Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position. \- All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
 Bachelor Degree from leading academic institution with focus on business administration
   

  

* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in organization and process reengineering, business consulting and project management or equivalent business/ operations experience within the financial services arena (however: no specialization in one area but rather multiskilling and transversal across functions)
* Strong operational and project management experience \- Experience in directing and managing large projects as well as managing change
* Certified Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt with minimum of 5 years’ experience and technical mastery
* Demonstrated track record using Lean Six Sigma Methodology principles and practices
* Minimum of two years’ experience as lead instructor to train Black Belts and/ or Green Belts
* Experience in coaching a minimum of five Lean Six Sigma projects from initiation to closure
* Demonstrated career development, progress, and excellent team leadership skills and potential
* Strong knowledge of financial services from an operational and support perspective


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Highest Education Certificate

data.jd_text:
**Project Director – Data Centres \| Qatar** 




  





 An exciting opportunity has arisen with a leading EPC contractor delivering some of the Middle East's most complex and high\-profile digital infrastructure developments.
 



  





 We are seeking an accomplished
 **Project Director** 
 to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of hyperscale and large\-scale colocation data centre projects across the MENA region. This executive leadership role will be responsible for the overall success of multiple mission\-critical developments, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality and operational performance.
 



  





 The successful candidate will provide strategic direction across all phases of the project lifecycle, from early planning and design management through procurement, construction, commissioning, and final handover, while maintaining strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and key stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Provide executive leadership for the successful delivery of hyperscale and large\-scale colocation data centre projects.
* Oversee all aspects of project execution, including design management, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
* Establish and drive project strategy, governance frameworks, and delivery methodologies aligned with client objectives and organisational standards.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams comprising project managers, design managers, construction managers, commercial professionals, and technical specialists.
* Ensure effective management of programme schedules, project budgets, risk registers, and resource allocation across multiple workstreams.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, senior stakeholders, consultants, utility providers, and supply chain partners.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and maintain strong relationships with hyperscale operators and key project partners.
* Champion health, safety, quality, and environmental excellence across all project activities.
* Oversee commercial performance, including contract administration, change management, claims mitigation, and financial reporting.
* Monitor project performance against key milestones and implement corrective actions to address potential delays or risks.
* Lead project governance meetings and provide regular executive\-level reporting to internal leadership and external stakeholders.
* Support commissioning strategies, operational readiness planning, and the successful transition to client operations teams.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement throughout the project lifecycle.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Degree qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 10 years' experience delivering large\-scale construction projects, with significant exposure to mission\-critical facilities and data centres.
* Proven track record leading hyperscale or major colocation data centre developments from inception through to completion.
* Extensive experience managing multidisciplinary teams within complex EPC, PMC, or client\-side environments.
* Strong understanding of data centre delivery requirements, including critical power, cooling infrastructure, commissioning, and operational resilience.
* Demonstrated expertise in programme management, commercial oversight, contract administration, and stakeholder management.
* Experience working with internationally recognised forms of contract and large, geographically dispersed project teams.
* Middle East experience is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with hyperscale client standards and delivery expectations, including those of AWS, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Oracle, would be advantageous.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, negotiation, and decision\-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively at executive level.



  





 This is a unique opportunity to join a market\-leading organisation at the forefront of the region's rapidly expanding data centre sector and play a pivotal role in delivering next\-generation digital infrastructure that will support the future of the digital economy.

Lead the successful delivery of advanced venue technology solutions across stadiums, sports venues, and large\-scale international sporting events. The role is responsible for managing end\-to\-end technology project delivery, ensuring seamless integration of ICT, AV, and ELV systems while enhancing operational readiness and event\-day experience for stakeholders, organizers, and spectators.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead the overall delivery lifecycle of Venue Technology projects from concept initiation through planning, procurement, implementation, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.
* Manage RFP preparation, tendering activities, vendor evaluations, contract coordination, and post\-award project execution activities.
* Develop and maintain project documentation, governance artefacts, technical specifications, implementation plans, and reporting frameworks for all Venue Technology initiatives.
* Oversee project execution in coordination with vendors, consultants, contractors, and internal project management teams.
* Develop integrated project plans aligned with operational, engineering, and event delivery requirements across stadiums, venues, clubs, and mega\-event environments.
* Define and document functional and technical requirements for venue technology systems and infrastructure.
* Support Venue Technology Operations teams and event organizers in defining project scope, operational expectations, and technical delivery requirements.
* Monitor project performance, risks, issues, timelines, budgets, and quality standards to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, cybersecurity standards, and venue operational guidelines.
* Lead contract performance management activities to ensure vendor compliance, service quality, and client satisfaction throughout project execution and delivery phases.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, integration validation, operational readiness, and transition\-to\-operations activities.



  





**Delivery Resource Planning \& Governance** 




  




* Manage and report on the progress of all Venue Technology projects and delivery programs.
* Provide regular executive\-level updates, dashboards, and status reports to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Lead service coordination meetings with vendors, consultants, operators, and external stakeholders.
* Manage the activities and performance of the Venue Technology Delivery team to ensure alignment with project objectives and operational requirements.
* Ensure all designs and implementations are compatible with venue operational standards, technology lifecycle requirements, scalability, and future expansion needs.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical direction to team members and project resources.
* Support strategic planning initiatives related to venue technology transformation and innovation.
* Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in Information Technology and technology project delivery.
* Minimum 7\+ years of experience in a similar leadership role managing complex technology projects.
* Minimum 4 years of mandatory experience within sports venues, stadiums, or mega sporting event environments.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2 Certification.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 




  




* Proven experience delivering large\-scale ICT, AV, and ELV projects within stadiums, arenas, smart venues, or mega\-event environments.
* Strong expertise in SMART stadium and venue technologies, including integrated venue systems and event technology infrastructure.
* Experience in designing, implementing, and managing venue\-based technology solutions for international sporting events.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, governance frameworks, and delivery best practices.
* Ability to interpret and develop technical drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and infrastructure layouts.
* Strong vendor management, stakeholder engagement, and contract management capabilities.

* Expert understanding of both explicit and implicit dependencies and able to explain these and build into recommendations
* Experience of implementing successful project performance improvement activities and techniques for recovering poor performance
* Knowledge of supplier categorisation and experienced in devising appropriate commercial acquisition strategies
* Understands the needs of information management requirements in the project phases (operation), internal (contractual, statutory) and asset (customer) documentation.

 Wood is a global leader in consulting and engineering, helping to unlock solutions to critical challenges in energy and materials markets. We provide consulting, projects and operations solutions in 45 countries, employing around 25,000 people. www.woodplc.com

The Commercial and Project Management department is an integral part of the Business Solutions Division. Its mandate is to enhance commercial focus and ownership during the proposal management process, ensuring that OQ can compete for more deals and improve the conversion rate with favorable conditions.  • Provide executive\-level guidance to project teams on commercial and contractual matters, instilling best practices across all project phases.
 



 • Oversee a diverse portfolio of projects, ensuring adherence to guidelines, financial milestones, and budgets while implementing corrective actions as needed.
 



 • Establish and implement robust quality assurance processes to uphold delivery standards for both internal OQ products/services and vendor\-managed projects, including regular audits to drive continuous improvement.
 



 • Lead comprehensive project progress reporting, focusing on financial performance and providing high\-level strategic recommendations to enhance overall project outcomes.
 



 • Oversee a diverse portfolio of projects, ensuring adherence to guidelines and targets while implementing corrective actions as needed.
 



 • Direct project progress reporting, focusing on financial milestones and budgets, and provide strategic recommendations.

IT Project Manager – Consultant Job Purpose
   

  

 The IT Project Manager is responsible for managing, coordinating, and monitoring a portfolio of IT projects from initiation through closure, ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards while aligning with organizational objectives and strategic plans.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage assigned IT projects in accordance with established project management methodologies and governance frameworks.
* Ensure successful project delivery by meeting agreed objectives, timelines, budgets, and stakeholder expectations.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with business units, IT teams, vendors, and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure project milestones and deliverables are achieved.
* Manage vendor relationships and ensure compliance with contractual obligations and service commitments.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, including project charters, plans, status reports, risk registers, and closure reports.
* Provide regular project updates and progress reports to management and stakeholders.
* Facilitate project meetings, workshops, and stakeholder discussions to ensure alignment and effective communication.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, resources, and quality throughout the project lifecycle.
* Resolve project\-related challenges and escalate issues where necessary.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, governance requirements, security standards, and audit requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality and safeguard sensitive business and project information.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the enhancement of project management practices.
* Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and project management best practices.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is mandatory.
* MBA or Master's Degree is preferred.


**Experience**

* Proven experience in banking, financial services, or highly regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience managing multiple projects and cross\-functional teams.
* Demonstrated success in vendor management, stakeholder management, and project governance.


**Required Skills**
* Strong project management and leadership skills.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

 Employment Type

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 The Vertical Operations Director is responsible for owning and scaling the operational performance of Snoonu’s key business verticals, including grocery, laundry, ticketing, and any future verticals launched under Snoonu’s ecosystem.
   

  

 This role ensures that each vertical operates with clear ownership, strong execution, high service quality, and profitable growth, while maintaining Snoonu’s customer obsession and operational standards.
   

  

 The Vertical Operations Director is not only responsible for day\-to\-day operations, but also for building scalable operating models, improving unit economics, solving cross\-functional issues, and ensuring that each Non\-food vertical is ready to grow in Qatar and future markets.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
* Grocery Operations


 Own the operational performance of grocery, supermarket, convenience, and quick\-commerce partners.
   

  

* Ensure product availability, stock accuracy, pricing accuracy, and substitution processes are properly managed.
* Reduce missing items, wrong items, out\-of\-stock issues, and delayed grocery orders.
* Improve picking, packing, and handover processes with partners.
* Work with category, merchant, logistics, and product teams to improve the grocery customer journey.
* Build operating standards for grocery partners, including item accuracy, cold\-chain sensitivity, packaging, and delivery readiness.
* Monitor grocery fulfillment time and customer complaint trends.
* Support the development of dark\-store or quick\-commerce models if required.
* Improve grocery basket experience, repeat purchase, and reliability.
* Laundry Operations


 Own the operational performance of laundry partners and end\-to\-end laundry order flow.
   

  

* Manage the full laundry journey from pickup to partner processing to delivery.
* Ensure clear SLAs for pickup, cleaning, ironing, packaging, and return delivery.
* Reduce delays, damaged items, missing items, wrong items, and customer complaints.
* Build quality control standards for laundry partners.
* Ensure proper item tagging, tracking, and handover processes.
* Work with product and logistics teams to improve scheduling, pickup windows, and customer notifications.
* Create escalation processes for high\-value items, lost items, or damaged items.
* Improve customer trust in the laundry vertical through reliability, transparency, and service recovery.
* Ticketing Operations


 Own the operational execution of ticketing services, events, bookings, and related customer experiences.
   

  

* Ensure ticket inventory, availability, pricing, and event details are accurate.
* Coordinate with event organizers, venues, partners, product, finance, and customer support.
* Manage operational readiness before, during, and after major events.
* Reduce customer issues related to ticket access, QR codes, refunds, cancellations, and event changes.
* Create clear SOPs for event\-day support and escalation.
* Ensure smooth settlement and reporting with ticketing partners.
* Support major event launches with risk assessment and operational planning.
* Build scalable ticketing processes for future expansion into entertainment, experiences, sports, and tourism.


**Additional Verticals And Business Areas**
 Based on Snoonu’s business model, the Vertical Operations Director may also oversee or support the following areas:
   

  

* Retail Operations


 For flowers, pharmacies, electronics, beauty, gifts, fashion, and general retail partners.
   

  

* Improving item accuracy, merchant readiness, fulfillment time, packaging, and delivery handover.
* Reducing cancellations, unavailable items, wrong items, and poor packaging complaints.
* Building SOPs for sensitive categories such as pharmacy, flowers, electronics, and gifts.
* Supporting category\-specific service standards.
* Marketplace Operations


 Own the overall marketplace health across multiple verticals.
   

  

* Monitor supply availability across merchants and categories.
* Ensure strong coordination between merchant operations, logistics, product, and customer support.
* Improve operational KPIs across all marketplace verticals.
* Identify marketplace gaps such as low availability, weak fulfillment, poor merchant compliance, or high complaint rates.
* Support new vertical launches with proper operating models and readiness checks.
* New Vertical Launch Operations


 Lead operational readiness for new Snoonu verticals before launch.
   

  

* Define the operating model for each new vertical.
* Build SOPs, SLAs, partner requirements, customer support flows, and escalation rules.
* Run pilot launches before scaling.
* Identify operational risks before public launch.
* Work with product to ensure the customer journey is ready.
* Work with finance to validate pricing, commission, refunds, and settlement processes.
* Ensure logistics capacity and delivery requirements are clear.


**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
* Vertical Strategy and Operating Model ( Define the operating model for each vertical; Set operational priorities, KPIs, and service standards; Translate Snoonu’s business goals into clear execution plans).
* Operational Performance ( Own the day\-to\-day performance of each vertical; Monitor key metrics; Identify operational bottlenecks and solve them with clear owners; Ensure every vertical has weekly performance reviews and action plans).
* Customer Experience ( Ensure every vertical delivers a customer experience aligned with Snoonu’s standards; Work closely with Customer Experience and Customer Support to understand complaints and root causes; Reduce repeated failures that create customer dissatisfaction; Ensure service recovery rules are clear for each vertical; Protect the customer first, then fix the root cause internally) .
* Partner and Merchant Operational Excellence ( Set clear operational requirements for merchants and partners; Hold partners accountable for repeated failures; Work with commercial and account management teams to improve partner performance; Ensure partners understand Snoonu’s standards for preparation, availability, packaging, handover, and customer experience; Recommend corrective actions for underperforming partners).
* Cross\-Functional Leadership ( This role must connect all departments to ensure that vertical issues are solved end\-to\-end).
* SOPs, SLAs, and Governance ( Create and maintain SOPs for each vertical; Define clear SLAs for merchants, operations, logistics, and support teams; Build escalation processes for critical issues; Ensure every team knows who owns each type of problem; Standardize processes across verticals to reduce confusion and improve execution) .
* Data, Reporting, and Business Reviews ( Build dashboards for each vertical; Track daily, weekly, and monthly performance; Identify trends, risks, and repeated failures; Present clear business reviews to leadership; Convert data into action plans, not just reports).
* Profitability and Unit Economics ( Work with finance and commercial teams to improve vertical profitability; Monitor cost\-to\-serve across each vertical; Identify operational inefficiencies that affect margins; Improve delivery batching, fulfillment efficiency, partner terms, and refund leakage; Ensure growth does not come at the cost of poor economics).

Job description:
   

  

  
 
**About Us** 




 With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.  
 



  
 



**Line of Service Overview** 




 At PwC Consulting, we lead with insight and deliver with purpose. You’ll work alongside experts across industries to design and deliver forward\-looking solutions in areas such as strategy and enterprise transformation, operational excellence, digital innovation, cyber resilience, and risk management. Our reimagined operating model brings together sector\-aligned, solution\-led teams empowered to move fast, think boldly, and create real impact. Whether transforming finance, enabling digital change, or shaping national visions, you’ll be part of a collaborative, forward\-thinking community—built to grow with you and the world around us. 
 



  
 



**Business Unit Overview** 




 As part of the Management Consulting team, you’ll shape how organizations operate, perform, and grow. We deliver end\-to\-end consulting solutions across Finance Transformation, Accounting Transformation, Workforce Transformation, Supply Chain \& Efficiency Transformation, Enterprise Solutions and capability building through PwC Academy. It’s where business performance meets human potential, backed by technology, powered by purpose. 
 



**Solution Overview** 




 PwC Academy is the talent and skills development business of PwC Middle East. We build capabilities\-at\-scale so governments and organizations can accelerate the region’s transformation agenda through a future\-fit workforce. We are a tech\-forward, people\-powered community of educators, bringing together the strength of the global PwC network, our deep\-rooted regional insights, and our expert L\&D resources and strategic alliances, to deliver upskilling solutions that create sustained impact. At PwC Academy, we shape the future of learning – driving transformation through talent. Find out more and tell us how we can support your upskilling journey by visiting us at https://www.pwcacademy\-me.com/" 
 



  
 



**How You’ll Contribute** 




 As a Senior Associate – L\&D Project Management at PwC Academy Middle East, you will play a pivotal role in driving large\-scale learning and capability\-building initiatives that enable our clients to achieve their transformation goals. You will manage the end\-to\-end delivery of learning projects — from planning and stakeholder engagement to execution and evaluation — ensuring that every engagement delivers measurable impact and excellence. Working at the intersection of project management and learning design, you will collaborate with subject matter experts, clients, and internal teams to create seamless, high\-quality learning experiences that shape the future of talent development in UAE and across the region. 
 



  
 



**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



1. Planning and organizing


* Acknowledge the receipt of handover from the BD team and ensure that all necessary steps are completed before the delivery of the engagement (e.g.R\&Q completed, engagement letter/contract signed, etc.)


* Initiate the set\-up of client in the PwC internal systems/database (job codes, enrolment to client’s portal.


* Organize and conduct a kick\-off meeting with the relevant stakeholders


* Engagement of internal and external SMEs in the planning phase


* Project planning – scheduling, SME resourcing, initiation of SME’s contracts, logistics for training delivery and for the SME Trainer briefing


* Setting up a communication plan


1. Manage the content development phase


* Communicating the expectations from various stakeholders in terms of content, quality, timeline, etc.



 Manage the delivery phase 
 


* Making sure that the delivery is as per plan – performing quality checks during the delivery of the course.


1. Quality control


* Quality control on material, delivery and other client deliverables


* Analyzing and managing project risks


* Analyzing client and participant feedback for improvements


* Trainer performance analysis and overall trainer management


1. Managing project economics/reporting


* Review and update PTs upon handover from the BD team.


* Monthly updating course manager dashboard


* Updating revenue forecast every week and to keep the internal stakeholders up to date


* Client billing and debtor management


* Third party supplier/contractor’s invoices


* Updating the project hub update


1. Client communications and management


* Client management and obtaining client feedback


* Review and submission of post course reports


* Organizing periodic update meeting with client to discuss overall status of the project


1. Account accelerators


* Maintain and develop strong relationships with client key contact


* Actively develop new relationships to widen network within the same client


* Identify any other training opportunities with the client.


* Assist in training delivery when needed in Project Management.



  
 



**What You’ll Bring** 



* High level of technical proficiency and computer literacy particularly with Excel, Word, MS Project and PowerPoint


* Expertise in management of the full systems approach to training, including, design, development, delivery and evaluation of training.


* Experienced project manager, particularly in the field of learning and  organizational development


* Able to articulate the purpose, aims and outcomes of the PDP and its individual modules to different stakeholders.


* Proactive, emotionally resilient, able to influence and negotiate with executive level stakeholders.


* Sophisticated communication skills, able to interact effectively with a wide range of people.


* Able to take full accountability and ownership for project delivery.


* Highly structured and meticulous in approach with high attention to  details.


* Able to negotiate with executive level workshop suppliers for preferential delivery rates.


* Highly adaptable to changing business requirements


* Professional yet approachable manner


* Flexibility in working hours (evenings, weekends as and when required)



 Education 
 


* Post\-graduate with a business or project management background


* CAPM/ PMP or equivalent Project Management qualification



**Travel Requirement** 



* Not required



**Required Skills** 



* Technical proficiency (Excel, Word, MS Project, PowerPoint)


* Project management in learning and organizational development


* Systems approach to training (design, development, delivery, evaluation)


* Communication and stakeholder management


* Negotiation with executive\-level stakeholders and suppliers


* Accountability and ownership


* Attention to detail


* Adaptability


* Professionalism and approachability


* Flexibility in working hours



  
 



**How You’ll Make a Difference** 




 At PwC Midde East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.  
 



  
 



**Why You’ll Love Working at PwC** 




 At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job \- you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well\-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

**About The Ned Doha:**
 Housed within Doha’s iconic former Ministry of Interior building, The Ned Doha is not just a hotel — it is a refined luxury destination where heritage, elegance, and contemporary sophistication come together to create an exceptional experience.
   

  

 With seven distinctive dining concepts, 90 beautifully designed bedrooms, elegant event spaces, and Ned’s Club—our private members’ club complete with a rooftop terrace, spa, gym, and a breathtaking 30\-metre outdoor pool—The Ned Doha blends heritage, creativity, and modern luxury into one vibrant experience.
   

  

**The Role:**
 We are looking for an experienced and inspiring Director of Banquet Operations to lead our banquet team and oversee the seamless execution of events across our dynamic and luxury environment.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate hospitality professional who thrives in a fast\-paced setting and enjoys leading teams to deliver outstanding guest experiences.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
* Lead and oversee the day\-to\-day banquet operations, ensuring the successful execution of all events and functions
* Work closely with Sales, Events, Culinary, and F\&B teams to ensure seamless coordination and exceptional service delivery
* Drive operational excellence by maintaining high standards of quality, presentation, and guest satisfaction
* Lead, coach, and inspire a diverse team while fostering a positive and high\-performing culture
* Monitor staffing requirements, scheduling, productivity, and labor costs to maximize efficiency
* Ensure all events are executed in line with company standards, guest expectations, and operational procedures
* Maintain strong financial awareness including budgeting, forecasting, and cost control initiatives
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance guest experiences and improve operational processes
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, hygiene, and company policies at all times


**About You:**
* Previous experience in a senior banquet leadership role, ideally within luxury hospitality brands
* Strong knowledge of banquet operations, event management, and Food \& Beverage service standards
* Proven leadership skills with experience managing and developing large teams
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment while maintaining exceptional attention to detail
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Financial and commercial awareness with experience managing budgets and operational targets
* Passion for creating memorable guest experiences and delivering service excellence


**What’s In It for You?**
* Competitive tax\-free annual salary package from up to QAR 290,000
* 21 calendar days annual leave and 11 paid public holidays
* Sick leave benefits as per Qatar Labour Law
* Private Medical Insurance for self
* End of Service benefits
* Complimentary meals at Neddy’s, our team restaurant (breakfast, lunch \& dinner)
* Exclusive hotel and dining rates for you, your family, and friends
* Outstanding learning, development, and career progression opportunities
* Reward and recognition programmes
* The opportunity to work in one of Doha’s most iconic lifestyle destinations


**Our Culture**
 At The Ned Doha, we go beyond celebrating diversity—we continuously challenge ourselves to be better. Inclusion, respect, and opportunity are at the heart of everything we do, and we are committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
   

  

**Ready to lead something extraordinary? Apply today and join us as Director of Banquet Operations!**
 \#DirectorofBanquetOperations \#TheNedDoha

data.jd_text:
**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Plans, directs, supervises, and controls the execution of all business, technical, fiscal, and administrative functions of the assigned program, project, or subtask. Acts as the Company representative with the customer and selected suppliers during the program execution. Negotiates changes to the scope of work with the customer. Assists business development in understanding customer issues and business plans in order to market and secure new/additional work.
* Establishes the program requirements for all areas of the program, and monitors the draft and final deliverables for adherence to these criteria. Assigns responsibility to executing project plans for key subordinates and assesses how to utilize their qualifications and strengths.
* Provides input to performance reviews and development plans for subordinates. Promotes technical excellence as well as the improvement of the Quality Improvement Process. Mobilizes Company resources, through effective liaison with support departments, other offices, or subsidiaries, to create project teams capable of completing effective, quality work. Works with individual lead discipline engineer to develop budgets, schedules and plans for the various elements of a project. Ensures that the project meets or exceeds goals established in these plans.
* Monitors and reports to management on the progress of all project activity within the program, including significant milestones, and any conditions which would affect project cost or schedule. Works with individual lead discipline to devise and execute action plans to rectify potential cost overruns or delays, or to accommodate significant changes to the scope of work. Advises the customer and Company management of any such changes.
* Oversees establishment of Work Plan, Health and Safety Plan, Quality Assurance/Quality Control Plan and other documents for hazardous waste work. May participate in negotiations with regulatory agencies and in public meetings in support of customers. Completes other responsibilities associated with the position as may be appropriate


**HSE Management**
* Work with project manager(s) and other team members to visibly support and comply to the One\-Way program and ensure that HSE requirements are followed by all project participants


**Customer Relationships**
* Establish and maintain good working relationships throughout the project and post completion
* Identify, document and communicate the customer requirements
* Ensure effective management of multiple stakeholders


**Commercial Management**
* Ensure effective management of WorleyParsons/Customer contract, including delivery of the budget gross margin.


**Scope Management**
* Ensure effective handover from Business Development Group
* Ensure a clear definition of scope
* Ensure compliance with requirements of the contract
* Apply an effective change control process
* Manage and monitor project performance on an ongoing basis to identify issues and opportunities early and take pre\-emptive action.
* Effectively manage project interfaces, including use of High Value Engineering centres


**Time Management**
* Manage the planning of all scope elements of the project.
* Develop resource \& financial requirements from the project plan.
* Manage the design, procurement and construction activities to meet the project schedule.
* Monitor the key reports and the development of corrective action plans.
* Ensure timely and effective documentation turnover and project close\-out.


**Cost Control**
* Ensure that all estimates which are prepared for the project are accurate project estimates.
* Ensure that all proper and accurate cost reports are provided for control of the project.
* Monitor and control all cost aspects of the project to forecast costs, obtain approvals, identify trends and take action to avoid cost overruns and take advantage of opportunities.


**Quality Management**
* Ensure the project quality requirements are properly defined and fully implemented.
* Ensure the right systems are in place and that these are applied on the project.
* Ensure compliance with WorleyParsons policies and procedures.
* Implement as part of the project a lessons learned program on the project consistent with WP requirements.


**Team Management**
* Define roles and responsibilities and provide clear and focused leadership for the project team to create a vision for project success and a strategy to fit that vision


**Communications Management**
* Ensure effective communications with the project team.
* Document communication requirements.
* Ensure accurate, timely \& effective progress reporting to the Customer and internally to WorleyParsons management.
* Ensure ongoing monitoring of the communication network between project staff, the customer and third parties and introduction of changes where required.


**Risk Management**
* Identify project risks and opportunities.
* Monitor closure of all identified risks and opportunities.
* Maintain the risk management focus throughout the project duration


**Design Management**
* Set clear objectives for the design team.
* Ensure design team are aware of, and are complying with, customer's Basis of Design and applicable regulations and codes.
* Monitor design activities, inter\-discipline data flow and communications


**Procurement/Subcontracts Management**
* Set clear objectives for the procurement and subcontracts team.
* Assess procurement process throughout the project to ensure goods meet specification and are delivered on time and are within budget.


**Construction Management**
* Set clear objectives for the Construction team.
* Monitor the Construction Management function to ensure safe delivery of the project within cost and schedule objectives


**Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training**
* Full\-Time Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from an accredited university
* Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status or undertaking the same will be an advantage.


**Industry Specific Experience**
* Prior experience must include significant project experience and successful project management.
* Vast relevant experience in a supervisory and/or project management role including technical expertise.
* Mandatory experience in FEED and Detail Design for large Offshore Brownfield Projects.


**HSE Capability**
* Maintain HSE focus with the team to ensure OHSE requirements.
* Demonstrate behaviour and business practices commensurate with a culture of world’s best health, safety and environmental performance.
* Demonstrate a visible and active commitment to:
+ Personal well\-being;
+ Healthy and safe workplaces and activities; and
+ Continuously improve Worley health, safety and environmental performance.
+ Identify and report work hazards and incidents.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 We are currently seeking a Senior Project Manager – Fit Out to lead the fit\-out delivery of high\-rise projects in Qatar.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring proven experience in a Senior Project Manager role, with a strong track record in managing fit\-out delivery, testing and commissioning, snagging, handover, and project close\-out on high\-rise PMC projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage the fit\-out phase of high\-rise projects from planning through to handover
* Oversee fit\-out execution to ensure works are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards
* Manage project scope, programme, cost, and risk while ensuring alignment with client requirements and business objectives
* Coordinate and lead the project team, including contractors, consultants, architects, engineers, and support staff
* Monitor project progress and provide regular updates, financial control, and reporting
* Ensure fit\-out works are properly coordinated with all disciplines and completed in line with project delivery processes
* Review and manage contractor performance, shop drawings, material approvals, mock\-ups, and installation quality
* Lead testing, commissioning, snagging, handover, and close\-out activities related to fit\-out packages
* Support resolution of site issues, commercial matters, claims, and interface challenges during the fit\-out stage
* Ensure robust project plans, look\-aheads, and forecasts are prepared and regularly updated


**Qualifications**
* A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field
* PMP certification or membership of an equivalent professional institution
* 20\+ years of experience in project management/construction management, with strong experience in fit\-out delivery
* Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager leading high\-end fit\-out packages on complex high\-rise or large\-scale building projects
* Strong knowledge of fit\-out coordination, finishing trades, testing and commissioning, snagging, and handover processes
* Experience managing contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams through the fit\-out stage
* Demonstrable understanding of commercial management, claims, and project close\-out requirements
* Experience using modern project delivery and coordination tools, including BIM
* International consultancy experience, with at least 5 years in the Middle East preferred
* Strong ability to manage technical and delivery matters across all disciplines associated with fit\-out projects

We strongly believe in cross\-team collaboration to achieve our mission to develop entrepreneurial leaders who think globally and act responsibly.
 



  





 DEEP \- Institute for Deep Tech Innovation \- is ESMT’s innovation hub dedicated to amplifying our ecosystem’s ability to generate and scale science\-based businesses. We empower scientists to commercialize technologies, support deep tech startups to scale internationally and connect leading research organizations to connect with the startup and innovation ecosystem effectively.
 



  





 DEEP is running targeted and ambitious activities in the fields of Healthcare, Natural Capital, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence and Compute, currently expanding to Qatar
 



  





 Join our DEEP Qatar team on\-site as a
 



  





**Operations Lead DEEP Qatar** 




 (m/f/x, 40 hrs./week, starting in August\-September 2026, on\-site in Doha)
 



  





 and help shape the future by bringing your expertise and passion to ESMT.
 



  





  





**How you’ll make a difference** 




 The Operations Lead is responsible for the operational backbone of DEEP Qatar. They keep the Qatar site running, manage operational tracking of the program budget, and provide operational support across the three flagship programs (DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha).
 



 They bring local knowledge of business practices and cultural nuances in Qatar and the wider GCC to support the team in navigating the local environment effectively. In year one, this means supporting the establishment of an operation from scratch in a new market. In year two and beyond, it means scaling that operation as the programs mature.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 









**Entity, governance, and office operations** 




 Primarily responsible for keeping the Qatar entity operational. Stay on top of day\-to\-day compliance obligations such as accounting, HR, legal, IT, and office operations. Support the relationship with the company secretary and external legal counsel. Support the operational management of banking relationships, including account administration, vendor payments, and expense systems. Manage office leases, vendor contracts, and supplier relationships. Lead the operational logistics for local new\-hire onboarding.
 



**Program budget and operations support** 




 Manage operational tracking of the various program budgets. Track costs, reconcile spend against budget allocations, and report regularly to the Director. Support the Program Manager with project\-level budget management.
 



 Provide operational support across DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha, including support for Academy curriculum refinement and ecosystem day preparation alongside the Director and Program Manager. Coordinate with the Berlin team on operational alignment, shared services, and reporting.
 



**Business systems and processes** 




 Set up and maintain the tools and processes that support the Director and the wider team in business development, partnership management, and operational delivery. This includes CRM, pipeline tracking, internal reporting, and operational workflows.
 



**Local partnership and ecosystem intelligence** 




 Support the Director with institutional knowledge of local business practices and cultural nuances in Qatar and the GCC region. Provide intelligence and brief the team on the regional entrepreneur and innovation ecosystem, including key accelerators, networks, and communities relevant to Pioneers and CDL scouting. Maintain awareness of local vendors relevant to program delivery and share that intelligence with the team.
 



**Equipment and IT** 




 Lead local equipment management, including sourcing, maintenance, and inventory of IT hardware, screens, AV equipment, and connectivity. Resolve day\-to\-day local IT and infrastructure issues so the team can work without disruption.
 



  





**What makes you a great fit.** 




 You are an operator with strong institutional knowledge of how things work in Qatar and the wider GCC. You combine the operational rigour to run an entity, track a budget and build systems with the local instinct to spot what matters and flag it early. You have direct experience of working with or inside Qatari government, or sovereign or quasi\-government institutions, and you bring that experience to bear in helping the team navigate the local environment effectively. You are comfortable being hands\-on across operations, finance and systems in a small, scaling team without a playbook.
 



 Must\-haves
 


* 5 to 8 years of professional experience with meaningful time spent living or working in Qatar or the wider GCC
* Strong working knowledge of local business practices, customs and how decisions get made in the region
* Operational management experience in an international organisation, including budget tracking and financial reporting
* Working Arabic
* Experience in standing up new operations or geographies
* Comfortable operating in a small, scaling team with a limited playbook



 Strong preferences
 


* Institutional experience of the Qatari government, or sovereign or quasi\-government agencies
* Background in startup, accelerator, university or innovation ecosystem
* Experience setting up and managing CRM, pipeline tracking or operational systems
* Experience managing IT, vendor and supplier relationships in a small\-team environment



 Nice to have
 


* Existing relationships with QSTP, Qatar Foundation, QRDI, QIA or the major Qatari universities.



  





**What makes this more than just a job** 




 ESMT offers a collegial and international work environment, with employees representing more than 55 nationalities. We encourage a self\-driven mind\-set and contributions that create meaningful and lasting impact. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a fair and inclusive workplace where individuals of all identities and backgrounds are welcomed and valued. Fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion enriches our employees, students, and broader community.
 



  





**We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about you!** 




 Please submit your application via our online application form, including the following documents:
 


* Motivation letter
* CV with relevant certificates and references
* Salary expectations and possible start date.



  





**Contact:**




 ESMT Berlin
 



 Viktoriya Rodina
 



 Human Resources Coordinator
 



 Schlossplatz 1
 



 10178 Berlin
 



 Tel: 030 21231 0

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 The Digital Office Manager holds a pivotal role in steering the organization's digital evolution. As the strategic leader overseeing digital initiatives, you will be at the forefront of innovation, responsible for driving the entire lifecycle of digital projects, from conception to realization.
   

  

 The Digital Office Manager reporting directly to the Chief Technical Officer (CTO) and collaborate closely with key stakeholders across the business to understand the intricacies of operational challenges. The primary focus will be on identifying emerging technologies and cutting\-edge processes and orchestrating their seamless integration into our business operations.
   

  

 Digital Office Manager will serve as the connection between conceptualizing transformative ideas and executing practical solutions. The mission is not only to keep a vigilant eye on the technological landscape but also to align these advancements with our organizational goals. By leveraging your expertise, the role holder will contribute to the development and implementation of innovative strategies that drive our digital transformation agenda forward.
   

  

 The role demands a visionary mindset and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. The Digital Office Manager will be instrumental in shaping and executing our digital strategy, ensuring that each digital engagement is finely tuned to meet our business objectives. The impact will extend beyond traditional boundaries by guiding the team in harnessing the power of digital technologies to address complex challenges and optimize operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* To ensure interpreting the digital strategy and to identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Drive QAFCO's digital vision and strategy definition, acting as the steward for the digital initiatives' roadmap across the organization.
* Identify and ideate digital business opportunities across the value chain, based on strategic and operational challenges or threats observed within the organization.
* Oversee the development of an integrated digital budget and spend plan across relevant QAFCO functions, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Identify synergies for developing and implementing digital solutions, collaborating with respective owners to ensure cohesive integration.
* Review digital value realization (i.e., ROI) across functions, ensuring that digital investments align with business objectives and deliver tangible outcomes.
* Develop relevant digital expertise through a Center of Excellence model, tailored to meet evolving business needs and technological advancements.
* Oversee the digital use case lifecycle delivery, from design and prototyping to full\-scale roll\-out, ensuring seamless execution and integration into existing processes.
* Lead and oversee the development of sustainable partnerships with local and global innovation ecosystems, fostering collaboration and driving digital innovation within QAFCO.
* Act as the single point of contact and key advisor to relevant QAFCO executives for digital topics and the future of the business, providing strategic guidance and insights.
* Act as the face of QAFCO in local and global digital and innovation events, seminars, and associations, representing the organization and fostering relationships with key stakeholders in the digital ecosystem.
* Interpret the digital strategy and identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Manage and evaluate the portfolio/pipeline of innovative ideas collected from across the company.
* Work closely with relevant business stakeholders to understand operational challenges or threats.
* Lead teams to build and implement digital products, tracking implementation progress and ensuring alignment with business and IT.
* Monitor the implementation of the digital strategy and roadmap, identifying risks, issues, and challenges, and seeking mitigation measures.
* Lead the ideation program to identify digital opportunities, ensuring compliance with relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management procedures and controls.


**Desired Candidate Profile**
* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field.
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in digital implementation, innovation, or a related field, with minimum 5 years in a managerial role, preferably within the Oil \& Gas or Petrochemical Industry.
* Certifications in project management, such as PMP (Project Management Professional) would be added as an advantage.

data.jd_text:
A leading regional bank is seeking a highly accomplished professional to spearhead the management of complex corporate restructuring and recovery mandates.
 



  





 This executive leadership role is responsible for managing and resolving stressed corporate exposures, developing recovery and restructuring strategies, preserving asset value, and maximizing recoveries across a diverse portfolio of corporate and commercial relationships.
 



 The successful candidate will work closely with senior management, business units, legal counsel, and external stakeholders to deliver effective turnaround, restructuring, and recovery solutions while ensuring sound risk management and regulatory compliance.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead the Corporate Recovery \& Restructuring function and oversee the management of stressed and non\-performing corporate credit exposures.
* Develop and implement recovery, restructuring, and turnaround strategies for complex corporate relationships.
* Negotiate restructuring arrangements, settlements, and recovery plans with borrowers and other stakeholders.
* Assess business viability, cash flows, collateral positions, and recovery prospects to formulate optimal resolution strategies.
* Work closely with Corporate Banking, Credit Risk, Legal, and external advisors to manage problem accounts effectively.
* Oversee legal recovery actions, enforcement proceedings, and collateral realization where required.
* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend proactive measures to mitigate potential losses.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
* Provide strategic insights and portfolio updates to Executive Management and relevant committees.
* Lead and develop a team of recovery and restructuring professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Law, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of banking experience, with significant exposure to Corporate Recovery, Restructuring, Special Assets, Credit Risk, or Workout functions.
* Proven track record in managing large and complex corporate restructuring and recovery cases.
* Strong understanding of corporate finance, credit analysis, restructuring frameworks, insolvency processes, and legal recovery mechanisms.
* Experience dealing with large corporate groups, family\-owned businesses, and syndicated lending arrangements.
* Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, analytical, and leadership capabilities.



  





**Key Competencies** 




  




* Strategic Thinking
* Corporate Restructuring \& Turnaround Management
* Credit Risk Management
* Stakeholder Negotiation
* Portfolio Management
* Regulatory \& Governance Compliance
* Leadership \& Team Development

data.jd_text:
Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. The company recently received US IDE approval for its QUADRA\-PE study evaluating the Katana™ Thrombectomy System in acute pulmonary embolism patients. In parallel, Akura Medical is developing NavIQ™, a software platform that transforms CT angiograms into 3D pulmonary vascular models to enhance visualization, procedural planning, and clot assessment towards better safety, efficacy, and ease of use. Akura has recently completed a $53 million first close of its Series C financing, led by the Qatar Investment Authority, supporting the launch of a joint venture and a new R\&D and manufacturing center in Doha, Qatar.
 



  





 ABOUT SHIFAMED
 



 Founded in 2009 by serial entrepreneur Amr Salahieh, Shifamed LLC is a privately held medical device innovation hub focused on the development of novel medical products to address clinical needs in the rapidly evolving fields of cardiology and ophthalmology.
 



  





**Description:** 




  





 The Clinical Affairs Manager (MENA Region) will serve as the primary clinical and operational lead for establishing and managing clinical trials across multiple countries in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region on behalf of Akura Medical. Based in Doha, Qatar, this individual will be responsible for all aspects of clinical study execution in the region from site identification and regulatory submissions through enrollment, data collection, and closeout. The ideal candidate is a highly self\-sufficient, resourceful professional who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment with limited on\-the\-ground infrastructure. A strong preference will be given to candidates with clinical/procedural expertise in interventional cardiology, interventional radiology, or vascular surgery who can provide direct case coverage and physician\-level technical support for interventional procedures alongside treating physicians.
 



  





**Responsibilities, Skills \& Hands\-On Experience:** 




  





 Regional Clinical Trial Setup \& Management
 


* Serve as the primary operational lead for clinical studies in the MENA region for both NavIQ and Akura Medical’s PE thrombectomy device programs.
* Lead the planning, design, and execution of clinical studies (IDE, post\-market, PMCF, registries, and observational studies) in alignment with business and regulatory strategy.
* Ensures the project is planned and conducted in accordance with all applicable regulations, standard operating procedures, and good clinical practices (GCP).
* Develop, review, and manage clinical study documentation, including protocols, informed consent forms, case report forms (CRFs), statistical plans (as applicable), and clinical trial agreements.
* Coordinate site identification, evaluation, selection, initiation, monitoring, and close‑out activities across multiple MENA countries (including Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and others as applicable).
* Drive all site start\-up activities including regulatory and ethics committee (EC/IRB) submissions, budget negotiations, and contract finalization.
* Manage and maintain inspection\-ready Trial Master File (TMF) and related clinical documentation in compliance with applicable regulations.
* Provide oversight of site performance, enrollment, data quality, and protocol compliance.
* Develops detailed project plans, and monitors project milestones against performance indicators.
* Coordinate investigational device shipments, accountability logs, and supply chain logistics within the region.
* Plans, directs, creates, and communicates the study timeline including but not limited to generating reports to provide regular status updates to the US\-based clinical team and senior management.



 Vendor \& Budget Oversight
 


* Manage and oversee clinical research organizations (CROs), laboratories, and other vendors to ensure delivery of contracted services.
* Develop and manage study budgets, forecasts, and resource plans; monitor expenditures against approved budgets.
* Identify and mitigate operational, timeline, and budgetary risks.



 Regulatory \& Compliance
 


* Navigate country\-specific regulatory landscapes across MENA to obtain necessary approvals for investigational device studies.
* Ensure all clinical activities comply with ICH GCP, ISO 14155, local regulatory requirements, and sponsor SOPs.
* Support preparation of regulatory submissions, audits, and inspections.
* Prepare sites for potential regulatory inspections; serve as the primary regional contact for regulatory queries.
* Manage risk assessment and mitigation.



 Clinical \& Physician Support
 


* Provide direct procedural support and case coverage alongside interventional cardiologists, interventional radiologists, and vascular surgeons performing PE thrombectomy procedures using NavIQ and Akura devices (preferred).
* Train physicians, clinical staff, and coordinators on device use, study protocols, and data collection requirements.
* Serve as the primary technical and clinical liaison between study sites and the sponsor.
* Attend cases as needed and provide real\-time guidance and troubleshooting support in the catheterization lab or hybrid OR.



 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 


* Provide guidance, training, and operational oversight to Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) and other study team members, as applicable.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of clinical operations processes, procedures, and best practices.
* Work closely with US\-based clinical affairs, regulatory, R\&D, and quality teams to align regional activities with overall program goals.
* Support planning and execution of investigator meetings, site training sessions, and regional advisory boards.



  





**Education \& Work Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related healthcare field (advanced degree or clinical licensure preferred e.g., MD, RN, RT, PA, or equivalent).
* 5–7 years of experience in clinical research, with minimum of 2 years in the medical device industry.
* Demonstrated experience managing pre\-market and/or post\-market medical device clinical studies.
* Hands\-on experience in interventional cardiology, interventional radiology, or vascular surgery (either as a clinician, clinical specialist, or field clinical engineer).
* Direct experience in the MENA region is highly preferred; ability to provide direct case coverage is a significant advantage.
* Familiarity with PE treatment, VTE management, or catheter\-based thrombectomy procedures is strongly preferred.
* Deep understanding of MENA regulatory environments and experience navigating multi\-country clinical submissions (Saudi Arabia SFDA, UAE MOH/DOH, Qatar MOPH, and others).
* Strong knowledge of good clinical practice (ICH GCP, ISO 14155\), and international regulatory requirements for medical device trials.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with demonstrated experience building relationships with KOLs, physicians, and hospital administration across the MENA region.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language proficiency is a significant plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); experience with EDC systems and electronic TMF platforms.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the MENA region (50–70% travel expected).
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment.
* Demonstrated leadership and problem\-solving capabilities.



  





 Our salary ranges are calculated by role, level, and location. Please note that your position within that range will be determined by your job\-related knowledge, location, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications.
 



  





 NOTICE TO CANDIDATES: Please be aware that Shifamed and its portfolio companies do not conduct interviews or extend offers through mobile web chat applications. Please report any such occurrences to hr@shifamed.com.

We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!
   

  

****Overview / Purpose Of The Position****
 The internal and supplier assurance (ISA) business partners with clients to build trust within their organisations and across their value chains. ISA has undergone tremendous growth, and this strategic role will support this growth across the EMEA region by shaping our approach to delivering client solutions, enabling us to add greater value to our clients and enhance our client centricity, whilst harmonising with global and other regional efforts.
   

  

 The Head of Operations will build the EMEA operational framework for this business line, integrating it seamlessly into the company's established processes while ensuring it operates with commercial discipline, efficiency, and scalability, all whilst ensuring alignment with the global ISA community to drive standardisation.
   

  

 This role requires a leader who can create a tightly integrated delivery engine that ensures quality, efficiency, margin control, and regulatory readiness, without duplicating the company’s infrastructure. The successful candidate will combine strong operational leadership with a solid understanding of professional services, preferably within audit or advisory environments.
   

  

****Responsibilities \& Accountabilities****
* Process: This role will collaborate with relevant stakeholders to define the client journey for ISA throughout EMEA whilst working closely with global teams to ensure alignment.


**This Will Result In a Process That:**
* Is clearer, better understood, and aligned and embedded across the globe.
* Is more efficient and effective in servicing both EMEA and global client contracts.
* Is considerate and aligned to the future direction and growth of the ISA business.
* incorporates governance and transparency at its core.
* Effectively leverages existing best practices
* Operational delivery: This role will be responsible for working with direct reports and other regional leaders to mobilise our teams to deploy a client\-centric solution across our clients. They will maintain within the region the competencies and roles required to support the operational delivery of the ISA programs, and collaborate with the respective regions to develop these competencies more widely to support EMEA programs.


**This Will Result In:**
* A clear framework of the competencies required when delivering an ISA program.
* Greater understanding of and alignment with the competencies adopted across the regions.
* Increased capacity and capability to support the ISA programs.
* Improved program performance and impact on the client organisation
* The sales teams feel more supported when engaging with or building client proposals, and confident in our ability and expertise to deliver the solution.
* Global Hub: This role will be responsible for aligning EMEA operations with the global Hub


 This will result in greater clarity in the roles and responsibilities of the hub
   

  

* Governance: This role will work collaboratively with the respective compliance teams to ensure ISA controls and processes are appropriate, proportionate to the risk, embedded and effective.


**This Will Result In:**
* Risk mitigation to a reasonable level
* The forming and maintaining of strong external relationships with internal compliance teams
* The forming and maintaining of strong external relationships with associations and regulators, keeping abreast of changes, and ensuring they are translated into our ways of working
* Performance:
* This role will be responsible for delivering ISA revenue and growth across EMEA, whilst working with the global team to drive global growth and revenue. This will result in
* Deeper understanding of ISA performance at a client and program level
* An established cadence of performance monitoring
* Greater focus and emphasis on improving business performance.
* More insights to feed into business forecast and strategic resource planning.

 EMEA travel as required to support business and client activity.

 **Vaccination Consultant**

**Vaccination Program Development**

**Advisory and Compliance** 



* Provide expert advice on vaccination policies, guidelines, and best practices.
* Ensure compliance with applicable health regulations, government requirements, and international vaccination standards.
* Support project teams in interpreting and implementing immunization\-related regulations.



**Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Collaborate with healthcare providers, public health agencies, government authorities, and project stakeholders.

* Analyze immunization data and prepare reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

data.raw_snippet:
