 We’re looking for a talented leader to help open WHOO
data.jd_text:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers its members to perform at a higher level by providing a deep understanding of the interactions between their unique physiology and chosen behaviors.
   

  

 We’re looking for a talented leader to help open WHOOP Labs Doha, our first international product research facility. The Doha lab will partner with the WHOOP Labs Boston team to conduct mixed\-methods research to support physiology, user experience, and consumer studies. To serve the company’s diverse testing and validation needs, WHOOP Labs completes tens of thousands of data collections a year and creates best in class experience for our participants. WHOOP Labs Doha will set the bar for product innovation research in the GCC, setting strategy for participant experience and contributing to advancing WHOOP technology.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone with a proven track record collaborating internationally and leading a cross\-functional team, who is excited to work with our members and isn’t afraid to roll up their sleeves and get sweaty. This position is in\-person in Doha, Qatar with potential travel to Boston, MA 1\-2 times per year.
   

  

**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and execution of the WHOOP Labs Doha opening strategy, including team hiring, participant compensation structure, and setting operating hours
* Champion research integrity, including ensuring that data collection tools and team practices align with local regulations for ethical human subjects research
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of program initiatives and track progress towards goals
* Ensure clear communication between the Boston and Doha labs, developing ways of working that support multi\-facility research execution
* Represent Doha culture and unique participant experience factors in broader strategic conversations with the rest of the WHOOP human subjects research team
* Build the WHOOP Labs Doha brand and represent WHOOP in the GCC region
* Reports to the Director of Human Subjects Research


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a field related to human subjects research such as psychology, neuroscience, exercise physiology, or consumer science
* 5\+ years of full\-time professional experience in a related area
* 2\+ years of success leading a diversely skilled team
* Experience working on a distributed international team preferred
* Deep knowledge of local culture and ability to thoughtfully communicate localization considerations for research at WHOOP Labs Doha
* Understanding of best practices regarding human subjects research, including how to obtain IRB approval for new research projects; research ethics, data privacy, and consent
* Track record of successful project management, including resource allocation, timeline management, and risk mitigation
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, ability to plan ahead while still being flexible and able to work around challenges
* Strong networking and collaboration skills, with experience in building partnerships and engaging with external stakeholders
* Ability to present findings to stakeholders and effectively communicate with company leaders
* Excitement to work in a high\-energy, fast\-paced startup environment
* Understanding of branding and marketing as it applies to research in industry spaces
* Fluency in verbal and written English, WHOOP’s working language


**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
 Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.
   

  

 WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

data.jd_text:
Description synthétique du poste
   

  

 Sous l'autorité de la Conseillère de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC), directrice de l'Institut français du Qatar, \- vous assurerez la direction déléguée de l'Institut Français du Qatar ; \- vous piloterez la politique de coopération éducative et linguistique avec pour finalité la promotion de la langue française et de la Francophonie.
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 Sous l'autorité de la Conseillère de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC), directrice de l'Institut français du Qatar, vous devrez : En tant que Directeur délégué : \- Assurer la direction déléguée de l'Institut français du Qatar à Doha ; \- Participer à la définition et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de l'établissement dans le respect des priorités d'action du poste dans les domaines culturels, de coopération ou du développement ; \- Participer à l'élaboration du budget, à la gestion du personnel et à la mise en place d'outils d'analyse, de suivi et d'évaluation en liaison avec la COCAC et le secrétaire général ; \- Animer les équipes ; \- Organiser des événements et des manifestations. En tant qu’Attaché de coopération pour le français \- Accompagner le développement des filières bilingues francophones (Label FrancEducation) et plus généralement renforcer la place du français dans les écoles privées ; \- Suivre les projets de développement du français dans les lycées qatariens à option français, en relation avec le ministère qatarien de l’Éducation ; \- Positionner l’Institut Français du Qatar (IFQ) comme centre pédagogique de référence pour les professeurs de FLE et FLsco ; \- Développer et diversifier l’offre de ses cours et son activité comme centre d'examens (FEI/CCIP/AF), en collaboration étroite avec la coordinatrice pédagogique et la chargée de mission examens de l’Institut ; \- Accompagner le développement du français en université avec la promotion de la Mineure de français au Qatar et des études supérieures en France, en collaboration avec la responsable Campus France ; \- En liaison avec la COCAC, suivre l’activité des établissements d’enseignement français (lycée Bonaparte – conventionné AEFE et lycée franco\-qatarien Voltaire, homologué) ; \- Favoriser la mise en réseau des établissements d’enseignement français et autres établissements enseignant le /en français par la mise en œuvre de projets transversaux et de formations communes, l’organisation d'un congrès annuel et l'appui à l'association des professeurs de français du Qatar ; \- Organiser la participation scolaire et universitaire aux manifestations de la Francophonie et aux activités culturelles du Poste, en lien avec les services concernés.
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

* Master 2 ou niveau équivalent \- Expérience avérée de direction d’un établissement public ou privé à l’étranger ou en France, dans des institutions culturelles ou des collectivités territoriales \- Très bonne connaissance des réseaux dans les domaines universitaire, éducatif et culturel ; \- Expertise en Ingénierie pédagogique / didactique des langues \- spécialisation FLE ou équivalent. \- La connaissance ou la maîtrise d’une langue locale, constituerait un atout. La connaissance de la région également.

data.jd_text:
Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. The company recently received US IDE approval for its QUADRA\-PE study evaluating the Katana™ Thrombectomy System in acute pulmonary embolism patients. In parallel, Akura Medical is developing NavIQ™, a software platform that transforms CT angiograms into 3D pulmonary vascular models to enhance visualization, procedural planning, and clot assessment towards better safety, efficacy, and ease of use. Akura has recently completed a $53 million first close of its Series C financing, led by the Qatar Investment Authority, supporting the launch of a joint venture and a new R\&D and manufacturing center in Doha, Qatar.
   

  

**About Shifamed**
 Founded in 2009 by serial entrepreneur Amr Salahieh, Shifamed LLC is a privately held medical device innovation hub focused on the development of novel medical products to address clinical needs in the rapidly evolving fields of cardiology and ophthalmology.
   

  

 Description:
   

  

 This Manager / Sr. Manager, Regulatory Affairs will serve as a key member of the cross\-functional team, partnering closely with Clinical, Quality, R\&D, and Executive Leadership to support U.S. regulatory activities and lead global clinical studies and international market expansion. The ideal candidate brings strong FDA medical device experience combined with hands\-on knowledge of international regulatory pathways, agency interactions, and clinical study support across Europe, the Middle East, and other global markets. This is a unique opportunity to help shape regulatory strategy for a clinical\-stage medical device company as it expands global clinical activities, and prepares for international commercialization.
   

  

 Responsibilities, Skills \& Hands\-On Experience:
   

  

 Regulatory Strategy \& Product Development:
   

  

* Develop and execute global regulatory strategies for Akura Medical's thrombectomy and catheter\-based cardiovascular technologies.
* Serve as regulatory lead on cross\-functional product development teams from concept through commercialization.
* Provide regulatory guidance on design controls, risk management, verification and validation activities, labeling, and product changes.
* Partner with Quality and R\&D teams to ensure compliance with FDA, MDR, ISO 13485, and applicable international requirements.


 FDA Regulatory Affairs
   

  

* Lead preparation, review, and submission of U.S. regulatory filings, including IDE's, 510(k)'s, supplements, and other regulatory submissions as applicable.
* Monitor evolving FDA requirements and assess impact on development and commercialization plans.


 International Regulatory Expansion
   

  

* Develop regulatory strategies and market access plans for Europe, the Middle East, and other international markets.
* Support CE Mark and MDR\-related activities in partnership with Notified Bodies and external regulatory consultants.
* Lead country\-specific registration activities and regulatory submissions across key international markets including Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and other MENA countries.
* Establish and maintain relationships with regulatory authorities, notified bodies, and international regulatory partners.


 Clinical \& Regulatory Operations
   

  

* Partner closely with Clinical Affairs to support global clinical studies, including IDE, PMCF, registries, and post\-market studies.
* Provide regulatory guidance on protocol development, clinical study design, and regulatory approval pathways.
* Support regulatory submissions associated with clinical trial approvals across multiple countries and regions.
* Participate in investigator meetings, regulatory inspections, audits, and agency interactions.


 Agency Interactions \& Compliance
   

  

* Represent the company during interactions with FDA, Notified Bodies, Ministries of Health, and other regulatory authorities.
* Support preparation for regulatory inspections and audits.
* Maintain awareness of evolving global regulatory requirements and communicate potential impacts to leadership.
* Contribute to regulatory intelligence activities and long\-term market expansion planning.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Collaborate with Clinical, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and R\&D teams to ensure regulatory requirements are incorporated throughout the product lifecycle.
* Provide regulatory leadership for change assessments, design modifications, and lifecycle management activities.
* Support Executive Leadership with regulatory risk assessments, timelines, and strategic planning.


 Qualifications \& Experience:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, or related field.
* 10\+ years of Regulatory Affairs experience within the medical device industry; cardiovascular, endovascular, or interventional products strongly preferred.
* Direct experience with FDA medical device submissions, including IDE's, PMA's, 510(k)'s, or PMA supplements.
* Experience supporting clinical\-stage medical device programs and global clinical studies.
* Working knowledge of EU MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, and international regulatory frameworks.
* Experience interacting directly with regulatory agencies, notified bodies, and international health authorities.
* Familiarity with MENA regulatory pathways (Saudi SFDA, UAE MOHAP/DOH, Qatar MOPH, etc.) is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of design controls, risk management, clinical evidence requirements, and regulatory strategy development.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment and work effectively across global teams.


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience with thrombectomy, vascular intervention, pulmonary embolism, structural heart, or electrophysiology technologies.
* Prior experience supporting regulatory expansion into Europe, the Middle East, and emerging international markets.
* Experience participating in FDA meetings, regulatory inspections, and Notified Body audits.


 Our salary ranges are calculated by role, level, and location. Please note that your position within that range will be determined by your job\-related knowledge, location, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications.
   

  

 NOTICE TO CANDIDATES: Please be aware that Shifamed and its portfolio companies do not conduct interviews or extend offers through mobile web chat applications. Please report any such occurrences to hr@shifamed.com.

data.jd_text:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Meet our Professional Services Team!**
 Successful implementation and value from the Sprinklr platform starts with us. As customers advance their strategies and invest more in social media as a business driver, we’re looking for experienced project managers to help realise those ambitions. As a member of our team, you’ll support our customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Sprinklr is looking for a Global Program Manager to lead one strategic enterprise program for a public\-sector client in Doha. You will be responsible and accountable for the end\-to\-end delivery of the program, working with a retained team dedicated to the client.
   

  

 This is an on\-site role based in Doha, Qatar, supporting a public\-sector client. The successful candidate will be expected to work from the client site on a full\-time basis.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Own and manage one strategic enterprise program for a public\-sector client, coordinating the retained team and controlling program scope, change control processes, risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Partner with consulting teams, leaders and other internal departments or regional teams to coordinate and drive delivery.
* Ensure that overall program is effective, whilst running individual projects according to schedule and keeping within budget.
* Develop relationships and ensure the appropriate participation of key client \& internal stakeholders and executives.
* Develop, build, and maintain durable and trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Develop knowledge of the Sprinklr platform components and module\-synergies \- so as to be able to develop realistic and meaningful project plans and high\-level solutions.
* Ensure that each project is reported and forecasted accurately to all external and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that all project/program risks, issues and change requests are managed effectively.
* Manage client service expectations and briefs and drive successful, measurable outcomes for the client.
* Set the tone for the team and strive for quality and excellence in all aspects of delivery.
* Provide weekly project status and burn reports to the relevant project stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of the current industry environment that shapes opportunities for client solutions.


**Experience:**
* Experience managing enterprise SaaS programs for government, public\-sector, or highly regulated clients.
* Ability to operate directly from the client site, manage daily executive interactions, and build trusted relationships with senior public\-sector stakeholders.
* Extensive client management experience, including close collaboration with business owners and executive\-level clients.
* Experienced managing projects in IT, SaaS, Social, or Software environment.
* Experienced working with multi\-geo, multicultural delivery teams.
* Prior experience delivering programs in Qatar or the wider GCC region is a strong advantage.
* Experienced working on large scale project management in leading multi\-organizational initiatives, and driving team accountability to achieve goals.
* Ability to identify and resolve issues, manage risk, develop detailed work plans and specifications, perform resource allocations and run team meetings.
* Demonstrated ability to assume a leadership role in managing project, departmental and enterprise risks related to projects, systems and business analysis.

* Ability to motivate and focus people resources where there is no direct reporting relationship.

* Strong knowledge of software development life cycles, web technologies, web development processes.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

**We focus on our mission**

Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**Why Join Us?** 




 At Rosewood Doha, we create an environment where passion meets purpose – and where careers have meaning.
 



 Guided by our philosophy of Relationship Hospitality and our culture of Make the Place, we believe in enriching lives, starting with yours. We empower you to bring your true self, grow with confidence, curate the extraordinary and leave your legacy.
 



 You’ll be part of a diverse, inclusive and supportive community that invests in your development, celebrates achievements and inspires you to Discover Your Calling.
 



 Together, we push boundaries, explore the uncharted and shape the future of luxury lifestyle experiences.
 



**About Rosewood Doha:** 




 Rosewood Doha is a landmark destination inspired by Qatar’s coral reefs, bringing together ultra\-luxury hospitality, residential living, culinary experiences, holistic wellness, differentiated retail and events within one integrated ecosystem. The property includes a 155\-key hotel, 162 serviced apartments and 276 private residences, alongside a diverse collection of restaurants and lounges, expansive event spaces and curated lifestyle experiences. Our destination also houses Asaya, Qatar’s first members\-only social wellness club, complemented by Rosewood’s signature Manor Club for Club Room and Suite guests.
 



 Since opening in July of 2025, Rosewood Doha has been recognized with multiple international and regional accolades, including distinctions from the Michelin Guide, Forbes Travel Guide and Qatar Tourism \- reflecting the scale, ambition and standards of excellence behind the destination. As part of the global Rosewood Hotels \& Resorts portfolio, the property represents a new generation of luxury that goes beyond traditional hospitality into lifestyle, community and experience\-driven destinations.
 



**Our Associate Experience:** 




 We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional care. At Rosewood Doha, we offer a thoughtfully designed associate experience that supports your wellbeing, growth and life beyond work. This includes:
 



 \-
 
     
 
 A competitive salary and benefits package
 



 \-
 
     
 
 High\-quality associate accommodation in prime locations in the heart of Lusail and the Pearl
 



 \-
 
     
 
 A birthday day off (because your milestones matter!)
 



 \-
 
     
 
 Personalized development plans and continuous learning opportunities to support your career journey
 



 These benefits reflect our commitment to creating an environment where you thrive – professionally and personally – while building a meaningful career with us.
 



**Your Role:** 




 Guest Satisfaction:
 


* Ensures that all associates deliver the brand promise and provide exceptional guest service at all times.
* Ensures that associates also provide excellent service to internal customers in other divisions as appropriate.
* Spends time in public areas observing associate\-guest interaction and talking with guests, works through Department Heads to coach associates in guest service skills as necessary.
* Ensures that all guest and internal customer complaints are resolved in a quick and efficient manner.
* Maintains positive guest and colleague interactions with good working relationships.



 Finance / Administration:
 


* Maximizes associate productivity using multi\-skilling, multi\-tasking and flexible scheduling to meet the financial goals of the business as well as the expectations of the guests.
* Ensures that each profit center (e.g. Outlet, Bar, Events) is operated in line with maximizing profit while delivering on the brand promise.
* Ensures that each cost center operates with the lowest possible cost structure while also delivering on the brand promise to the guest.
* Assists in the preparation of the Annual Business Plan for Food and Beverage.
* Assists in the monthly reforecast, involves the respective Department Heads as appropriate.
* Manages costs proactively based on key performance indicators, works with the respective Department Heads as appropriate.
* Ensures that all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to financial record keeping, money handling and licensing are adhered to.
* Assists in the inventory management and ongoing maintenance of hotel operating equipment and other assets. In particular, high use assets such as chinaware, glassware and flatware.
* Participates in weekly yield and revenue management meetings actively, oversees the appropriate pricing structures to maximize yield and overall profits in Restaurants and Events.
* Responsible for control of beverage program including recipes, inventory, and progressive menu development.
* Reviews uniform replacement schedule as well as coordinating upgrade reviews with Director of Food and Beverage.
* Oversees the preparation, reviews and updates individual Departmental Operations Manuals.
* Conducts annual performance development discussions with key Food and Beverage associates and supports them in their professional development goals. Ensures that they in turn conduct annual performance development discussions with their associates.
* Assists in the development of departmental training through ongoing feedback and monthly feedback and meetings.
* Ensures that each department head plans and implements effective training programs for their associates in coordination with the Training Manager and their Departmental Trainers
* Conducts regular divisional communications meetings and ensures that departmental briefings and meetings are effective and conducted as necessary.
* Ensures the smooth operation of the Food \& Beverage division in the absence of the Director of F\&B.
* Collaborates with the culinary division as necessary, ensuring operational requirements are met and providing reasons as needed.



 Marketing:
 


* Assists in the preparation, utilization, and update of the Annual Marketing Plan, broken down as necessary by department.
* Evaluates local, national, and international market trends, vendors and other hotel/restaurant operations constantly to make sure that the hotel’s operations remain competitive and cutting edge.
* Encourages Department Heads to look for Marketing and Public Relations opportunities to increase awareness and ultimately business.
* Ensures that the Food and Beverage activities are aligned with the respective Corporate Strategy, and that the Hotel actions have been implemented where appropriate.



 Operations:
 


* Ensures that all company minimum brand standards have been implemented, and that optional brand standards have been implemented where appropriate.
* Monitors all operations, especially during peak business periods, working through the respective Department Head to adjust where necessary.
* Ensures that all Food and Beverage Fundamentals are introduced, implemented, and consistently maintained.
* Ensures that the Food and Beverage Division responds to the results of the Consumer Audit and to ensure that the relevant changes are implemented.
* Works closely with other Executive Committee members in a supportive and flexible manner, focusing on the overall success of the hotel and the satisfaction of hotel guests.
* Ensures that Food and Beverage associates work in a supportive and flexible manner with other departments, in the spirit of “We work through Teams”.
* Ensures that all associates are up to date with the availability of seasonal and new products on the market.
* Tastes and monitors the food and beverage products served throughout the operation, provides feedback where appropriate.
* Oversees the punctuality and appearance of all Food and Beverage associates, making sure that they wear the correct uniform and maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene, according to the hotel and department’s grooming standards.
* Maintains and assists in outlets during the absence of respective managers.

The role ensures optimal balance between debt and equity, drives cost\-efficient financing solutions, and oversees
data.jd_text:
The Funding and Capital Structure Director is a strategic leadership role responsible for managing the Group’s capital structure and executing complex funding and treasury initiatives. The role ensures optimal balance between debt and equity, drives cost\-efficient financing solutions, and oversees capital transactions across projects, acquisitions, and corporate initiatives.
 



 The position requires strong leadership, deep expertise in structured finance, and the ability to manage high\-value funding transactions in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external financial institutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Capital Structure \& Strategy** 



* Lead the development and execution of the Group’s capital structure strategy, ensuring an optimal balance between debt and equity.
* Contribute to initiatives aimed at reducing cost of capital and strengthening financial stability.
* Assess and recommend strategic financing options for Group investments, projects, and acquisitions.



**Funding \& Transactions** 



* Lead end\-to\-end funding processes including debt and equity financing transactions.
* Prepare and review key financing documents such as teasers, term sheets, and financial models.
* Oversee execution of debt issuances, refinancing, restructuring, and equity raising activities.
* Ensure timely completion of all conditions precedent (CPs) and closing requirements for financing deals.



**Debt Portfolio Management** 



* Manage and optimize the Group’s debt portfolio, including refinancing, reprofiling, and restructuring opportunities.
* Identify efficiencies to improve funding terms and overall cost of debt.



**Treasury Projects \& Execution** 



* Lead treasury\-related capital projects ensuring delivery within timelines and budget.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to track progress, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure successful execution of funding initiatives.



**Financial Analysis \& Risk** 



* Develop advanced financial models to evaluate funding structures and scenarios.
* Conduct risk assessments for financing options and capital allocation decisions.



**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead and develop a high\-performing team responsible for capital transactions and treasury execution.
* Engage with banks, investors, and advisors to secure optimal financing arrangements.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across finance, legal, strategy, and project teams.



  





**Job Knowledge \& Skills** 



* Strong expertise in debt and equity financing structures.
* Proven experience in debt restructuring, reprofiling, and capital optimization.
* Advanced financial modelling and valuation capabilities.
* Strong understanding of transaction execution and closing processes.
* Proficiency in financial systems and tools (SAP preferred).
* Strong risk management and cost optimization capabilities.
* AI and digital finance fluency is an advantage.



  





**Experience Requirements** 




  




* Minimum
 **20 years of professional experience** 
 in finance or treasury functions.
* At least
 **15 years in leadership or senior management roles** 
 .
* Minimum
 **5 years GCC experience preferred** 
 .



  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
* Professional certification preferred (e.g., ACCA or equivalent).



  





**Core Competencies** 




  




* Leadership \& team development
* Financial control \& risk management
* Strategic thinking \& agility
* Cost optimization
* Process and systems improvement
* Execution speed \& delivery focus
* Business valuation expertise
* Resilience under pressure

* Proven track record managing multi\-stakeholder projects with measurable outcomes.
* Strong analytical and research capabilities with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and visual storytelling skills, including development of executive\-level materials.

* Experience leveraging CRM systems, portfolio management tools, event platforms, and AI\-enabled research tools to drive operational effectiveness.


  


**Key Information:**

 **Doha, Qatar (applicant MUST currently live in Qatar or willing to relocate)**

data.jd_text:
The Training Manager should be able to provide effective leadership for the delivery and management of all Continuing Airworthiness training activities from the TTF. The post holder should be able to lead and manage a skilled and knowledgeable workforce, for the purpose of deploying “fit for purpose” training solutions, whilst maximising operational efficiency and minimising costs. They may also be required to carry out additional or alternative tasks from time to time, subject to holding the appropriate level of competency.
   

  

  

**Core Activity:**
* Ensuring delivery to contracted milestones in line with CDRL B02\.
* Identify training business opportunities and requirements for Training activities, including the development of outline solutions or bid proposals compliant with Part 145 and EASA,EMARS as appropriate.
* Undertake training situation analysis and produce consolidated reports/outline syllabus’ ensuring they meet the requirements of the business.
* Manage the delivery of training interventions which may include courseware, examinations, devices and facilities.
* Ensure training is delivered via a variety of media (classroom, virtual, practical, OJT etc.) and facilitate the management of assessments as required (written/practical), marking and feedback.
* Manage and lead training activities including bids, data management, facilities, trainers, examinations, training records and course scheduling.
* Manage the evaluation of training design and delivery ensuring all continuous improvements are embedded.
* Manage and lead the BAE Systems and BSL Mandated Training schedule, training records and course scheduling.


**Key Accountabilities:**
* Ensure effective leadership of Aircraft Maintenance \& Support Training activities by setting delivery targets, monitoring progress and developing performance improvement programmes
* Ensure all Training activities are appropriately documented and the appropriate airworthiness records are maintained on relevant systems (IT / paper based)
* Lead training compliance with the Training Management Plan \& its associated procedures and standards, and any other company procedures and standards, as applicable
* Manage the application of Human Factors, Error Management, Risk Management and Safety Assurance within Training, together with the proactive analysis, mitigation and management of Hazards
* Ensure all Training activities are compliant with the Governance and Assurance framework. Ensure process confirmations and independent assurance audits are supported by Training personnel
* Manage audit findings in a timely and appropriate manner and provide updates into the relevant reviews
* Ensure all Training activities are compliant with the Governance and Assurance framework. Ensure process confirmations and independent assurance audits are supported by Training personnel
* Generate, deliver and implement effective improvements to overcome any non\-compliance and monitor effectiveness inline with the appropriate QEAF procedures
* Able to demonstrate a detailed understanding and application of the relevant Continuing Airworthiness Regulatory framework and ensure any Regulatory\-driven changes are implemented. Lead training’s compliance with all other requirements, e.g. ITAR, EaPW, ISO, etc.
* Lead compliance with all applicable contractual requirements, e.g. through support to contract reviews, and ensure any changes are implemented into training activities, as appropriate


 Requirements
   

  

**Qualifications/Functional Knowledge:**
* High level of Regulatory Framework understanding and the ability to drive this framework structure into the Training processes and activities.
* Able to design, implement and foster a continuous improvement culture, underpinned by appropriate management reporting systems.
* Able to take the lead in developing an efficient and cost effective training strategy.
* Able to manage the competency of the training department.
* Works with senior management to generate, drive and implement long\-term improvements in order to enhance performance or overcome non\-compliance across departments / functions.
* Through coordination with other departments, ensures integration of the training activity within the business, including planning, scheduling, controlling and reporting activities for cross\-functional, high level of complexity/impact activities.
* A role for an experienced manager, the primary focus is outward looking, across departments and functions.
* Recent extensive experience as a Leader in Training or a related discipline.
* Degree Level Qualification, or suitable equivalent.

**Description**
 At Qatar Airways, we craft cutting\- edge inflight products, enhance passenger comfort, and drive innovation in aviation design. From concept to launch, our Product Development and Design (PDD) Team collaborates with industry leaders to create products that set new standards in travel.
   

  

 If you are passionate about innovation and design, this is your chance to make a lasting impact in the aviation industry.
   

  

 Join our Product Development and Design Team that transforms ideas into reality and shape the future of airline experiences!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Senior Manager, Research and Strategy, you will be the analytical and strategic core of the Research and Strategy function within Qatar Airways' Product Development and Design division, reporting to the VP, Strategy and Planning. You will lead the delivery of research, insight, and strategic analysis that underpins the division's ability to make informed, commercially sound decisions across its full product portfolio.
   

  

 You will manage a team of researchers and analysts, building their capability and ensuring the function delivers rigorous, actionable intelligence that directly supports product investment decisions, roadmap planning, and divisional performance. You will be the person who turns ambiguous strategic questions into structured analytical frameworks, and raw data into compelling, decision\-ready recommendations.
   

  

 Working in close partnership with the Manager, Project Strategy and Planning, you will ensure that strategic insight and PMO execution are tightly connected. You will provide the research and analytical foundation that governs how initiatives are prioritised, sequenced, and measured. Your influence on governance and planning will be through the quality and clarity of the strategic input you provide, not through direct ownership of PMO processes.
   

  

 This role requires someone who is equally strong in analytical rigour and people leadership. You will need to manage the detail without losing sight of the bigger picture, and thrive in a complex, fast\-moving environment where the quality of insight directly shapes the quality of the product experience for millions of passengers.
   

  

 As part of your role, your responsibilities will be inclusive of, but not limited to the following:
   

  

**Research, Insight and Analysis**
* Lead the delivery of passenger research, market intelligence, and competitive benchmarking programmes that provide the division with a current, accurate, and actionable picture of the external landscape.
* Synthesise complex, multi\-source data into clear strategic narratives and decision\-ready recommendations for senior leadership
* Develop and maintain research frameworks and insight methodologies that ensure consistency, rigour, and relevance across all analytical outputs
* Commission and manage external research agencies and insight partners, ensuring quality, timeliness, and value for money


 Strategic Planning and Support
   

  

* Support the VP in the development and ongoing evolution of the divisional strategy, translating strategic direction into structured workplans, analytical frameworks, and clearly defined priorities for the team
* Develop and maintain product and experience strategy documents, ensuring they are current, evidence\-based, and aligned with group strategy
* Prepare high\-quality strategic materials, briefing papers, and executive presentations that enable the VP and divisional leadership to engage confidently at board and C\-suite level
* Support the evaluation and prioritisation of product initiatives, developing business cases and ROI analyses that inform investment decisions


 PMO Alignment and Strategic Influence
   

  

* Partner closely with the Manager, Project Strategy and Planning to ensure strategic priorities are accurately translated into project governance, roadmap sequencing, and performance frameworks
* Provide the analytical and strategic input that enables the PMO function to prioritise initiatives with confidence and commercial clarity
* Preview and challenge roadmap progress from a strategic perspective, escalating where initiatives are drifting from their original strategic intent or where emerging insight suggests reprioritisation is warranted
* Ensure that research and insight outputs are structured and communicated in a way that is directly usable by the PMO function, bridging the gap between strategic analysis and operational planning


 Organisational Development Support
   

  

* Support the VP in shaping ways of working improvements and operating model evolution across the division, contributing a research and insight perspective to how the division structures and sequences its work
* Help build a culture of evidence\-based decision\-making across the division by promoting best practice use of data, research, and strategic frameworks at team level
* Collaborate with the Manager, Project Strategy and Planning on the people and process dimensions of organisational change, providing strategic context and insight to support effective adoption


 Team Leadership
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of researchers and analysts, setting clear expectations, managing performance, and creating a working environment where talent grows and thrives
* Build team capability in research methodology, strategic analysis, and structured communication, raising the quality and impact of the function's outputs over time
* Foster a team culture defined by intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to delivering insight that makes a difference


 Be part of an extraordinary story
   

  

 Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
   

  

 Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

**About You**
 To be successful in this role, you should have:
   

  

 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent with a minimum of 10 years of experience in research, strategy, insight, or planning. A postgraduate qualification in business, strategy, or a related discipline is advantageous.
   

  

**Essential**
* Proven experience managing a research, strategy, or insight function with a track record of delivering high\-quality analytical outputs that have directly informed senior decision\-making
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to structure complex problems, synthesise multi\-source data, and produce clear, evidence\-based recommendations
* Experience managing and developing teams with the ability to set direction, build capability, and maintain high standards of delivery in a demanding environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex analysis into compelling, accessible narratives for senior and executive audiences
* Experience supporting senior leaders with strategic planning, business case development, and executive\-level presentations
* Solid commercial fluency, including familiarity with financial modelling, business case development, and ROI analysis, even without direct P\&L ownership
* Strong project management awareness with the ability to engage credibly with PMO functions, understand governance frameworks, and influence planning priorities through strategic input rather than direct management
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills with the ability to work as an equal peer with planning, PMO, and operational functions, influencing through the quality of insight rather than positional authority
* Candidates from management consultancy, consumer insights, research agencies, premium brand environments, or innovation\-led organisations are strongly encouraged to apply. Aviation experience is not a prerequisite.


**Preferred**
* Experience working within or alongside a product design, UX, or creative development environment
* Familiarity with PMO frameworks and governance models, sufficient to engage credibly and influence prioritisation without owning the function directly
* Experience in high\-expectation product or experience environments where insight directly shapes investment decisions and product quality
* Experience commissioning and managing external research agencies or strategic consultancies
* Exposure to organisational design or ways of working improvement programmes in a support or advisory capacity


**About Qatar Airways Group**
 Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow.  So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. **JOB SUMMARY** 




 Reporting to the Executive Chair \- Medicine the Division Chief provides clinical, education, research and executive management leadership for the division. The Division Chief is a clinical and managerial leader working with the Sidra executive team to develop and deliver strategy and business plans and is accountable for resources and performance in the designated division. S/he integrates research and education priorities into a program of excellent clinical service delivery. It is anticipated that the Division Chief will be able to continue with personal clinical educational and research activities.
 



  





**KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES** 



* Identifies and articulates the vision, strategic direction, and growth of the Division and develops implementation strategies to achieve them.
* Recommends clinical privileges, appointment, reappointment and corrective action for each member of the Division as well as promoting mentorship and academic career development for these staff members.
* Accountable for the financial performance and management of all budgets within the division.
* Accountable for the Division performance, Customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance of the Division.
* Leads clinical service planning, service development and capacity planning for the Division.
* Promotes leadership and direction for the development of strategies to promote the recruitment, retention, and direct mission of excellence for the medical staff, and collaborates with the Department Chairs and other Division Chiefs to execute the strategies.
* Responsible for all administrative related activities of the Division unless otherwise provided by the hospital, and serves on all requested committees, including medical executive committee, and appointing such committees as necessary to conduct the operations of the department.
* Develops and implements policies and procedures that guide \& support the provision of divisional services.
* Continues surveillance of the professional performance of all individuals in the Division who have delineated clinical privileges, including performance, and ongoing and focused professional practice evaluations (OPPE and FPPE).
* Ensures that the staff of the Division provide services that are in compliance with all applicable standards and requirements of the Joint Commission International, Qatar Supreme Council of Health, and all other applicable regulatory bodies.
* Implements the clinical service strategies and business plan for the Division.
* Makes recommendations for the purchase of capital and other equipment and participates in the evaluation of products for use by different members of the Division to ensure their safety and efficacy.
* Sets and achieves targets to drive continuous assessment and improvement of the quality of care and services provided and initiates actions for necessary improvements according to Sidra Board initiatives.
* Works with the Department Chair to establish and update the work week standards for all physicians on staff and assures that there is appropriate clinical coverage for all patients requiring medical care from the Division.
* Ensures all members of the Division optimize the use of electronic medical records.
* Sets and achieves targets for programs and procedures for confidentiality of all patient information in accordance with hospital policy and the privacy laws of the State of Qatar.
* In conjunction with the Department Chair, ensures the implementation of robust clinical governance structures and processes to ensure patient safety.
* In conjunction with the Chief Research Officer and other Division heads of research, ensures a program of clinical and translational research is developed, promoted and delivered within the Division.
* In conjunction with the undergraduate Medical Schools, ensures there is an active and continuous program of undergraduate teaching within the Division specialty to ensure an effective learning environment for students, residents, and medical staff.
* Is actively involved in research, graduate teaching, and publication in higher impact refereed journals, advising of students and participation in academic services.
* Ensures effective communication and involvement of all staff within the Division in regards to key decisions and initiatives
* Works collaboratively with other Department Chairs, Chief Officers, and Executive Directors to achieve broad Sidra objectives.
* Conducts other duties as may be directed by the Chief Medical Officer and/or Chief Executive Officer.
* Initiates, implements and oversees programs designed to foster positive relations between physicians and the hospital operations and administration.
* Assists with marketing strategies to inform physicians and their staff of Sidra’s clinical diagnostic procedures, services and resources.
* Promotes and evaluates physician community outreach programs as appropriate.
* Develops, manages and supports physician and community relationships, coordinating and disseminating information to all stakeholders to solicit ongoing support from the State of Qatar.
* Identifies and coordinates resolution of problems to improve physician utilization and patient satisfaction.
* Develops and maintains appropriate systems of communication between Sidra and other providers of primary and advanced patient care in Qatar for the purpose of individual patient care and systemic safety and quality improvement.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




**Education** 



* MD, MBBS or equivalent degree
* Residency training and board certification in Pediatrics
* Subspecialty Fellowship in Pediatric Hematology, Oncology and Hemopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation



  





**Experience** 




 10\+ years of post\-board certification clinical experience in Pediatric Hematology, Oncology and Hemopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation including 5\+ years in Academic leadership.

data.jd_text:
ESMT Berlin is a leading global business school with its campus in the heart of Berlin. Founded by 25 global companies, ESMT offers master, MBA, and PhD programs, as well as executive education on its campus in Berlin, in locations around the world, online, and in online blended format. We strongly believe in cross\-team collaboration to achieve our mission to develop entrepreneurial leaders who think globally and act responsibly.
 



  





 DEEP \- Institute for Deep Tech Innovation \- is ESMT’s innovation hub dedicated to amplifying our ecosystem’s ability to generate and scale science\-based businesses. We empower scientists to commercialize technologies, support deep tech startups to scale internationally and connect leading research organizations to connect with the startup and innovation ecosystem effectively.
 



  





 DEEP is running targeted and ambitious activities in the fields of Healthcare, Natural Capital, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence and Compute, currently expanding to Qatar
 



  





 Join our DEEP Qatar team on\-site as a
 



  





**Program Manager, DEEP Qatar** 




 (m/f/x, 40 hrs./week, starting in August\-September 2026, on\-site in Doha)
 



  





 and help shape the future by bringing your expertise and passion to ESMT.
 



  





**How you'll make a difference** 




 The Program Manager is central to executing DEEP Qatar's local initiatives and supporting the delivery of the three flagship programs: DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha. They make sure every cohort week, venture session, and mentor gathering runs flawlessly on the ground in Doha, and help establish DEEP Qatar's brand presence locally through digital channels and a physical presence at ecosystem events.
 



 They work closely with the Program Operations team in Berlin to maintain consistency with global CDL standards, and with the Doha\-based Venture Managers on local delivery and venture intake. In year one, this is a build\-as\-you\-go role, requiring the entrepreneurialism to figure things out in a new market without a local playbook.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





**Program delivery** 




 Own end\-to\-end local build and delivery for cohort sessions across DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha. Manage scheduling, logistics, venues, catering, and travel for participants, mentors, and faculty. Manage faculty, speakers, and practitioners across the programs, including onboarding, attendance, briefings, and on\-site coordination. Serve as the first point of contact for participants during cohort weeks. Ensure programs run to CDL global standards while adapting to the local context. Own project\-level budget management across programs, tracking spend and reporting into the overall Qatar program budget managed by the Operations Lead. Manage inbound inquiries.
 



**Berlin coordination** 




 Work closely with the Program Operations team in Berlin (led by the Head of Operations) and the Berlin\-based Program Managers to ensure alignment across the DEEP network. Provide local execution support for Berlin\-led activities that involve Qatar and draw on Berlin's support for Qatar\-led cohorts, particularly during the first year of the programs.
 



**Venture Manager support** 




 Provide local logistical support to Venture Managers across the program verticals, including coordinating venture visits, founder sessions, and ecosystem touchpoints in Qatar. Support Venture Managers with the application process and onboarding of candidates and ventures into the programs.
 



**Ecosystem days and gatherings** 




 Lead the operational delivery of DEEP Qatar's ecosystem days, including gatherings that connect CDL ventures and mentors with the local startup, innovation, investment, and corporate community in Qatar. Manage logistics, venues, speakers, attendee management, and on\-the\-day execution alongside the Director, Operations Lead, and Venture Managers.
 



**Brand and local presence** 




 Support the establishment and growth of DEEP Qatar's brand presence in the local ecosystem through social media channels (such as LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and others) and produce content that feeds into Berlin's central channels. Coordinate with the Berlin team on brand consistency and execution. Represent DEEP Qatar at relevant ecosystem events, demo days, and gatherings alongside the Director.
 



**Vendor and supplier management** 




 Manage local vendors and suppliers required for program delivery, including venues, catering, AV, travel, and accommodation. Build a reliable Doha supplier network from a standing start.
 



**Participant data and reporting** 




 Track participant data, attendance, feedback, and core program KPIs. Provide regular delivery reports to the Director and Berlin counterparts.
 



  





**What makes you a great fit** 




 You are a program operator who takes pride in flawless delivery. You have run multiple concurrent programs or events to a high standard, ideally in an accelerator, university executive education, professional services, or events context. You are the calm center during intense cohort weeks. You are entrepreneurial enough to figure things out in a new market with no local playbook, and disciplined enough to run programs to a global standard. You are comfortable working across cultures and flexible when working across time zones.
 



 You enjoy being the person who makes things work. You are comfortable being hands\-on with logistics one moment and engaging with a senior researcher or venture founder the next.
 



**Must\-haves** 



* 4–6 years of program delivery experience
* Track record of running multiple concurrent programs or events to a high standard
* Experience in an accelerator, university executive education, professional services, or events environment
* Currently based in Qatar or the wider GCC, or open to relocating to Doha
* High attention to detail and strong organizational discipline

data.jd_text:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and continuous improvement of all engineering functions within the hotel. This role oversees the maintenance and reliability of the property's physical assets, including building infrastructure, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) systems, HVAC, fire and life safety systems, energy management systems, and all back\-of\-house facilities.
 



  





 The incumbent ensures that all engineering operations support the delivery of exceptional guest experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety, regulatory compliance, sustainability, and financial performance. The Director of Engineering develops long\-term asset management strategies, leads capital improvement initiatives, and drives preventive and predictive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and lifecycle value.
 



  





 As a member of the Executive Committee, the Director of Engineering collaborates closely with hotel leadership to align engineering objectives with overall business goals and serves as the lead coordinator for emergency preparedness and response activities related to facility operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Engineering Operations \& Technical Leadership** 




  




* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all engineering and maintenance operations across the property.
* Direct the operation, maintenance, and optimization of HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, boilers, refrigeration systems, electrical distribution networks, generators, UPS systems, plumbing infrastructure, water treatment systems, swimming pool systems, kitchen and laundry equipment, elevators, and Building Management Systems (BMS).
* Establish and implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs to ensure optimal equipment reliability and minimize operational disruptions.
* Monitor engineering performance indicators, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement corrective actions to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure all engineering activities comply with established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manufacturer recommendations.



  





**Asset Management \& Capital Planning** 




  




* Develop and execute long\-term engineering strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives and brand standards.
* Lead the development and execution of the annual Engineering Business Plan and departmental objectives.
* Prepare, justify, and manage the annual engineering operating budget and capital expenditure plans.
* Develop and maintain a 5 to 10\-year asset replacement strategy for major plant and equipment.
* Manage renovation projects, equipment upgrades, and capital improvement initiatives from planning through commissioning.
* Supervise contractors, consultants, and project teams to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to required specifications.



  





**Financial Management** 




  




* Monitor departmental expenditures and maintain effective control over engineering operating costs.
* Analyze financial reports, payroll summaries, utility consumption trends, and P\&L statements to identify areas for optimization.
* Implement cost\-saving initiatives related to energy consumption, maintenance practices, procurement strategies, and service agreements.
* Ensure effective inventory management and control of engineering tools, spare parts, and consumables.
* Contribute to the annual budgeting and forecasting process.



  





**Energy \& Sustainability Management** 




  




* Lead energy conservation initiatives aimed at reducing utility consumption while maintaining guest comfort and operational efficiency.
* Monitor and optimize electricity, water, gas, and fuel usage through data\-driven analysis and system enhancements.
* Promote sustainable engineering practices and support environmental initiatives aligned with corporate sustainability objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance operational performance and reduce environmental impact.



  





**Fire, Life Safety \& Regulatory Compliance** 




  




* Ensure full compliance with all applicable local regulations, Qatar Civil Defence requirements, health and safety standards, environmental regulations, and hotel brand standards.
* Maintain the operational readiness of all fire detection, fire suppression, emergency lighting, evacuation, and life safety systems.
* Oversee the testing, inspection, certification, and maintenance of all statutory systems and equipment.
* Ensure all permits, licenses, certifications, and maintenance records remain current and readily available for audit purposes.
* Serve as the Chairperson of the Emergency Response Team and lead preparedness planning for facility\-related emergencies.



  





**Team Leadership \& Talent Development** 




  




* Lead, mentor, and develop the engineering management team and technical staff to foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance evaluations.
* Identify training needs and facilitate technical and leadership development initiatives.
* Promote a safe working environment through effective implementation of health and safety practices.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, labor regulations, and disciplinary procedures.
* Encourage employee engagement through open communication, recognition programs, and succession planning initiatives.



  





**Guest Experience \& Service Excellence** 




  




* Support hotel operations by ensuring all guest\-facing facilities remain in excellent working condition.
* Respond proactively to engineering\-related guest concerns and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with operational departments to minimize disruption during maintenance activities.
* Drive initiatives that enhance comfort, reliability, and overall guest satisfaction through engineering excellence.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, facilities management, energy management, or project management will be considered an advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive engineering experience within luxury hospitality environments, including at least 3–5 years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale hotel engineering operations, preferably within internationally recognized five\-star hotels or resorts.
* Demonstrated expertise in preventive maintenance programs, asset lifecycle management, and capital project execution.
* Experience managing engineering budgets, utility optimization programs, and vendor relationships.



  





**Technical Competencies** 




  




* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration plants, electrical distribution systems, plumbing systems, water treatment processes, fire and life safety systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and Energy Management Systems (EMS).
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
* Thorough understanding of Qatar Civil Defence regulations, local statutory requirements, and international hospitality engineering standards.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical manuals, and financial reports.



  





**Leadership Competencies** 




  




* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
* Commitment to service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational integrity

data.jd_text:
**About Bureau Veritas**
 Bureau Veritas is a world leader in testing, inspection and certification (TIC) services, operating across 140\+ countries. Our MCA Sustainability Services team helps organisations across the Middle East, Caspian \& Africa measure, verify and improve their environmental and social performance. The CER (Certification) product line is BV's fastest\-growing sustainability stream in the region, covering GHG verification, carbon accounting, ESG assurance, sustainability advisory, social audits and supply chain due diligence.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Sustainability Specialist is a country\-based technical and commercial delivery role focused exclusively on Bureau Veritas’ Certification (CER) sustainability service line. Two positions are open: one in Egypt (Cairo) and one in Qatar (Doha), each embedded within their respective market.
   

  

 Reporting to the local head of CER product line and functionally to the MCA Director of Sustainability, the Specialist will be the primary CER sustainability presence in\-country: delivering client advisory mandates, leading proposal development, building the local CER pipeline and supporting BV’s brand in sustainability circles. This position is client\-facing and carries direct delivery responsibility across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance and related CER services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Advisory**
* Lead and deliver sustainability advisory mandates in\-country across core CER focus areas:


* 
+ Carbon accounting, GHG baseline assessments and Scope 1/2/3 inventories (ISO 14064 / GHG Protocol)
+ Organisational and product carbon footprint calculations and decarbonisation roadmaps
+ ESG strategy development, materiality assessments and CDP/SBTi alignment
+ Sustainability report assurance under ISAE 3000 / ISSA 5000
+ CBAM exposure assessments and supply chain ESG due diligence
+ IFRS S2 readiness assessments and climate\-related financial disclosure support
+ EcoVadis score improvement programmes and ESG rating advisory
+ Conduct GHG verification audits and CER certification assessments in accordance with BV methodology and applicable international standards
+ Prepare high\-quality technical deliverables: verification reports, advisory frameworks, gap analyses, decarbonisation plans and client presentations
+ Coordinate with the MCA regional team and Egypt Technical Hub for peer review, QA/QC and technical sign\-off on complex mandates
+ Stay current with regulatory developments relevant to in\-country clients: local ESG disclosure requirements, CBAM updates, ISSB/IFRS S2 implementation timelines

**Business Development \& Proposals**+ Lead or co\-lead the preparation of CER sustainability proposals, RFP responses and commercial offers for clients in Egypt / Qatar
+ Identify and qualify new CER business opportunities in\-country, building a local pipeline across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance, social audits and supply chain services
+ Support regional BD campaigns including CBAM advisory, sustainability assurance, IFRS S2 readiness and GHG verification drives
+ Prepare and deliver tailored client presentations, pitches and capability documents for local market audiences
+ Participate in bid/no\-bid decisions with the regional Director and maintain accurate, real\-time pipeline records in Salesforce
+ Develop in\-country relationships with potential referral sources: law firms, financial advisors, sustainability consultancies and industry associations

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**+ Serve as the primary BV point of contact for CER sustainability clients in\-country — managing the full relationship from proposal through delivery, reporting and invoicing
+ Liaise with local regulatory bodies, stock exchanges, accreditation authorities and relevant government entities on CER matters
+ Represent Bureau Veritas at local sustainability events, ESG forums, carbon market conferences and industry roundtables
+ Manage repeat business opportunities, client satisfaction and contract renewals within the CER portfolio

**Operational \& Reporting**+ Maintain accurate Salesforce records for all in\-country CER opportunities: pipeline values, stages, submission dates and win/loss outcomes
+ Prepare monthly country performance reports and pipeline inputs for MCA Director and area leadership
+ Ensure all CER mandates comply with BV quality standards, methodology requirements and relevant accreditation obligations
+ Contribute country\-specific content to the MCA proposal library: case studies, client references, CVs and service descriptions
+ Participate in monthly MCA thematic training sessions and contribute to the quarterly regional sustainability newsletter

**Requirements**
**Essential**+ 4–6 years of experience in sustainability consulting, ESG advisory, GHG verification or CER\-related services in Egypt, Qatar or the broader MENA region
+ Solid technical command of core CER sustainability disciplines:


* 
+ GHG accounting and verification: ISO 14064, GHG Protocol, Scope 1/2/3 inventories
+ Carbon footprint methodologies and net\-zero/decarbonisation advisory
+ ESG reporting frameworks: GRI, ISSB/IFRS S2, ESRS, CDP, TCFD
+ Sustainability assurance standards: ISAE 3000, ISSA 5000
+ CBAM and cross\-border carbon due diligence
+ Supply chain ESG mapping and third\-party risk (C97\)
+ Excellent written English — ability to produce clear, professional technical reports, advisory deliverables and commercial proposals independently
+ Client\-facing experience: ability to manage relationships, lead discovery meetings and present findings to senior stakeholders
+ Bachelor’s degree in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, business or a related field

**Preferred**+ Professional certification: GHG Verifier, ISO 14064 Lead Auditor, GRI Certified Practitioner, CDP\-accredited advisor, or equivalent
+ Knowledge of local market regulatory context:


- 

* Egypt: FRA sustainability disclosure requirements, Egyptian Exchange ESG guidelines, national GHG registry developments
* Qatar: QSE ESG reporting requirements, National Vision 2030 sustainability pillars, QFC regulatory environment
* Arabic language proficiency — strongly preferred for both roles given client and regulatory engagement
* Experience with Salesforce or equivalent CRM tools for pipeline management
* Familiarity with EcoVadis, MSCI ESG, S\&P Global, or other ESG ratings platforms
* Knowledge of social auditing principles (SMETA, SA8000\) as an additional CER service area


**What We Offer**
* Country\-embedded, client\-facing role with real delivery responsibility and direct market impact
* High visibility to MCA Sustainability Director and regional leadership from day one
* Exposure to sustainability mandates and clients across 35\+ countries within the MCA region
* Competitive salary benchmarked to local market (Egypt — Cairo / Qatar — Doha)
* Access to BV’s global CER methodology, tools, accreditations and technical expertise network
* Clear career pathway into senior specialist, area lead or technical expert roles within BV MCA Sustainability
* Professional development through BV’s internal training programmes and external sustainability certification support

**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 We are looking for an Engineering Lead to own and drive Snoonu's Conversational AI and Driver Automation platform — a portfolio spanning IVR systems, multi\-channel chatbots, and a production\-grade multi\-agent Agentic AI framework built on AWS Bedrock. You will lead a focused team of AI Engineers and Python Backend Engineers, turning operational SOPs into autonomous, reliable workflows that serve drivers in real time across Qatar.
   

  

 In this role you will set the technical direction, establish engineering standards, and own delivery end\-to\-end — from architecture decisions and code reviews to observability and cost governance. You will work directly with the R\&D Director and Product to shape what gets built next, then lead your team to ship it with excellence.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
 Team Leadership \& Delivery:
   

  

* 
+ Lead, mentor, and grow a cross\-functional team of AI Engineers and Python Backend Engineers — driving technical quality, delivery velocity, and engineering culture.
+ Own sprint planning, technical scope definition, and delivery commitments for the conversational AI and driver automation domain.
+ Conduct design reviews, define coding standards, and maintain engineering quality across IVR, chatbot, and agentic system codebases.
+ Act as the primary technical interface between Engineering, Product, and Operations for all driver\-facing automation initiatives.
+ Partner with the R\&D Director to shape the team's technical roadmap, evaluate emerging AI capabilities, and surface the next high\-leverage bets.


**IVR \& Voice Automation**
* 
+ Own the architecture and continuous improvement of Snoonu's IVR system, ensuring reliability, low latency, and clean escalation paths for driver calls.
+ Drive design decisions for call flow logic, intent/slot management, DTMF routing, and voice\-to\-action fulfillment.
+ Define and monitor SLAs for IVR uptime, misroute rate, and escalation\-to\-human ratios.


**Conversational AI \& Chatbots**
* 
+ Lead the design and delivery of Snoonu's multi\-agent AI chatbot service for driver support across real\-time chat channels.
+ Own the four\-agent architecture — Coordinator, Data Collector, Rules Agent, and Action Executor — running on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar architecture.
+ Ensure chatbot flows handle driver intents reliably: order removal, vehicle mismatch, ETA extensions, merchant disputes, and escalations.
+ Drive LLM evaluation cycles, prompt strategy, and Bedrock Guardrail design to ensure responses are consistent, safe, and operationally correct.


 Integrate chatbot services with order management, CRM (Salesforce), Slack operations channels, and driver\-facing apps via secure, event\-driven patterns.
   

  

**Agentic AI \& SOP Automation**
* 
+ Lead the buildout and operation of the SOPs\-as\-Code framework — encoding operational SOPs as machine\-readable policies executed by the multi\-agent system.
+ Own the Config File architecture and Config Reader Agent pipeline that converts PDFbased SOPs into deployable agent configurations on AWS Bedrock.
