data.jd_text:
We are partnering with an established Saudi food manufacturer with its own brand in the market to recruit a
 ****National Sales Manager****
 .
   

  

 The business produces and markets branded food products, including meat and frozen food lines, selling across general trade, modern trade, and food service channels throughout the Kingdom and the wider GCC. It goes to market through sponsored companies, agency representatives, distributors, and a direct sales team.
   

  

 This opportunity is designed for a national sales leader who will own field sales delivery across the Kingdom, lead regional and channel teams and distributor partners, and drive national sales targets. The role reports to the Sales \& Marketing Director.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The National Sales Manager is responsible for the overall management and performance of the company's sales operation across Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets, including sales delivered through sponsored companies, agency representatives, distributors, and the direct sales team. Reporting to the Sales \& Marketing Director, the role ensures the implementation of commercially viable sales plans and marketing strategies that maximise returns and deliver customer service excellence. The single most important measure of success in this role is the consistent, profitable achievement of national sales targets.
   

  

 The National Sales Manager leads regional and channel sales teams, manages relationships with distributors, agencies, and key accounts, and works in close coordination with Marketing, Operations, Production, supply chain, and Finance to align sales plans with stock availability, order fulfilment, and collections.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
****National sales leadership****
* Supervise, direct, and control sales activities across general trade, modern trade, and food service in Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets, delivered through sponsored companies, agency representatives, distributors, and the direct sales team, ensuring attainment of planned sales targets
* Translate the commercial strategy set by the Sales \& Marketing Director into national, regional, and channel sales plans, targets, and route\-to\-market coverage
* Approve sales plans across product lines and monitor implementation and overall national sales performance
* Drive numeric and weighted distribution, product availability, and visibility across regions and channels
* Continuously track sales results against target, analyse variances, and take timely corrective action


****Planning, policies, and budgets****
* Develop sales work policies, procedures, plans, business budgets, and performance standards in cooperation with distributors, agency representatives, and the Marketing function, for approval by the Director
* Set and communicate KPIs for regional and channel teams, aligned to the national sales plan
* Review and assess the outcomes of market research and promotional campaigns to build effective sales plans and targets inside and outside the Kingdom


****Distributor, agency, and key\-account management****
* Build and manage relationships with sponsored companies, agency representatives, and distributors to ensure coverage, availability, and market penetration
* Negotiate trading terms, targets, and joint business plans with distributors and key retail accounts
* Maintain strong relationships with high\-end and modern\-trade retailers, category managers, and store managers
* Conduct regular market visits to assess product performance and competitor activity at point of sale


****Coordination and operations****
* Liaise on confirmed sales orders, shipping of sold products, stock availability, purchase orders, customer service, and billing
* Coordinate with Finance on collection of payments, billing of key customer accounts, credit control, and the opening of letters of credit to suppliers as required
* Liaise with suppliers, manufacturers, and government agencies on relevant matters and escalate important issues in good time
* Coordinate with supply chain and warehouses to ensure timely, accurate order fulfilment and avoid out\-of\-stock situations


****Reporting and analysis****
* Present periodic sales progress reports to the Sales \& Marketing Director with detailed analysis and recommendations for improvement
* Provide insight on market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and new business opportunities to support decision\-making


****Team leadership****
* Recruit, train, appraise, and motivate a competent national sales team
* Set priorities, assign territories and tasks, and uphold company standards and good conduct
* Build a culture of teamwork, accountability, and customer focus
* Conduct work\-related special assignments as required by the Director


****Authority and Decision\-Making****
* Operates within the company Authority Matrix
* Approves sales plans and monitors sales performance across product lines and regions
* Recommends trading terms and pricing within delegated limits, and credit decisions in line with policy
* Sets priorities and assigns territories and tasks across the sales team
* Conducts performance appraisals and leads recruitment, training, and development of sales staff


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Marketing, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage
* Eight or more years of experience in FMCG sales, including several years in a national or multi\-region sales management role; experience in meat processing or frozen food is strongly preferred
* Proven track record of managing distributors, agencies, and key accounts, and delivering national sales targets across general and modern trade
* Demonstrable track record in sales, business development, or account management with high\-end and modern\-trade retailers
* Professional certifications such as CBDM, PCM, or CSCP are an advantage
* Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and core tools for sales operations
* Fluency in written and spoken Arabic and English
* Strong leadership, decision\-making, multitasking, and team\-building skills, with a self\-motivated, disciplined, well\-organised, and adaptable personality and the ability to build rapport at all levels
* Willingness to travel across the Kingdom and the wider GCC as required

**Job Title: Business Operations and IT Administrator**
* Pay Band – Pay Band 4
* Closing Date (Time) – 23rd June 2026
* Location – Bahrain
* Salary – BHD 540 Monthly Gross Salary


**Purpose Of Job**
 This role is responsible for delivering ICT technical support and managing IT services, systems, and infrastructure in Bahrain, ensuring all technology operations meet business needs, corporate standards, and service level agreements. Based in the Manama office, the position reports to the Business Operations Manager and oversees the effective delivery of IT services across the country.
   

  

 In addition, the role supports the Business Operations Team in maintaining the smooth and efficient functioning of British Council resources and services. Key responsibilities include premises management, ensuring compliance with health and safety, environmental, and local legislative requirements, and maintaining corporate standards to promote a positive experience for customers, clients, and staff. The role also provides support for ministerial visits and driving services for Heads of Departments as required.
   

  

**Main opportunities/challenges for this role**
**Accountabilities, Responsibilities And Main Duties**

* Assist in the investigation and resolution of problems relating to business applications

**Role specific knowledge and experience**

You will be the conduit between our clients and the delivery team, collaborating closely with project management and your core internal team to ensure project delivery and client satisfaction. You have a deep understanding of pharmaceutical marketing, exceptional organizational skills, and a relentless commitment to client satisfaction. You will report to the
 **Director of Client Services or another senior account person.**

**Responsibilities:**
 Client Relationship Management:
   

  

* Build and cultivate strong, long\-lasting client relationships.
* Support the senior account team in managing client communication \- understanding their needs, objectives, and ever\-changing challenges.
* Proactively work to identify areas of opportunity to add value to your accounts.

Dean – School of Engineering \& Computing
   

  

 Note:
 *The position accepts unaccompanied candidates only.*
 Classification: Executive / Academic Leadership
   

  

 Reports To: Vice President for Academic Affairs (VPAA)
   

  

**About The American International University**
 American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs based on the American model of higher education. AIU provides degrees in Engineering, Architecture and Design, and Business Administration, with English as the language of instruction. The University is committed to fostering intellectual, cultural, and personal growth, preparing graduates for leadership roles in a global society.
   

  

 For more information, visit: www.aiu.edu.kw
   

  

 School of Engineering Profile
   

  

 The School of Engineering and \& Computing at the American International University in Kuwait comprises the departments of Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering. The School offers Bachelor of Science (BSc) degrees in Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.
   

  

 Scope of Work
   

  

 The Dean of the School of Engineering \& Computing provides strategic, academic, and administrative leadership to advance AIU’s engineering programs. The Dean oversees academic quality, faculty development, accreditation, research and innovation, and operational effectiveness, fostering excellence, continuous improvement, and sustainable growth.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide overall leadership and management for the School of Engineering and Computing, including faculty, academic programs, and operations.
* Oversee all engineering and computing programs, ensuring academic excellence and market relevance.
* Lead curriculum development, scheduling, program assessment, and continuous improvement.
* Manage budgeting, resource allocation, and strategic planning.
* Oversee faculty recruitment, development, and performance management.
* Promote research and scholarly activity across the School.
* Maintain and engage the Industry Advisory Committee to align programs with industry needs.
* Lead accreditation and quality assurance processes, including ABET and related frameworks.
* Ensure accurate external communications, including the School’s website and public information.
* Strengthen industry partnerships, internships, and experiential learning opportunities.
* Support laboratory infrastructure and academic resources development.
* Represent the School in university leadership and institutional strategic initiatives.
* Promote student success, retention, progression, and employability through data\-informed leadership.


 Reporting Departments (If Applicable)
   

  

* Faculty in the School of Engineering
* Administrative and program support staff


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

 The ideal candidate shall demonstrate experience in professional and academic positions, a strong record in teaching, and outstanding international academic achievements. The candidate is expected to demonstrate ongoing contributions through published research in recognized international journals, as well as participation in exhibitions, conferences, and symposiums, in addition to the following qualifications and experience:
   

  

* Ph.D. or equivalent from a recognized university.
* Professor rank in one of the School’s disciplines.
* Strong record of excellence in teaching and research appropriate to the rank of professor.
* Leadership qualities and proven research background.
* Clear vision for higher education and School development.
* Familiarity with credit hour and semester systems.
* Senior managerial experience in higher education, preferably at dean level.
* Experience with program accreditation standards.
* Knowledge of HR, administrative, and financial policies and procedures.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience with academic and industry institutions.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Arabic is a plus.
* Experience in American or internationally accredited higher education systems is preferred.


**Additional Qualifications**
 Priority will be given to applicants with the following qualifications:
   

  

* Managerial experience and the skills necessary to launch pioneering projects.
* Multi\-cultural skills.
* Active participation in reputable organizations.
* Knowledge of the methods of evaluation and related matters.
* Documentation demonstrating support for the achievements of teachers and students.
* Understanding of the latest teaching methods, including the use of technology in the teaching process.
* Demonstration of a commitment to enriching the educational experience of students.


 How to Apply
   

  

 Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on our website and submit a resume and cover letter via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs
   

  

 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. The successful candidate is expected to commence employment on August 30, 2026\.

 The Business Partner is the key and strategic interface between IT and the Business. data.jd_text:
**Description:** 
 The WADPM shall develop, revise, and maintain an airfield driving program to ensure the safe operations of vehicles, aircraft, and pedestrian movement on and around the airfield environment IAW DAFI 13\-213,
 *Airfield Driving* 
 . The WADPM shall solicit help from base senior leadership and other various base support agencies to ensure the program is effectively implemented and managed. The WADPM shall provide all initial and recurring airfield drivers’ training for all unit level Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPMs) and all airfield drivers. The WADPM will ensure reporting of Controlled Movement Area Violations and other significant events in Amentum’s MIS system, to appropriate Wing leadership, and as required in DAFMAN 13\-204 and DAFI 13\-213\. The WADPM will conduct spot checks to enforce and monitor compliance with airfield driving procedures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Must have a \*7\-skill level from an approved DoD institution or civilian equivalent.
* Have documented knowledge or experience with ICAO procedures. Have a minimum of 1 year experience implementing airfield safety procedures and generating and facilitating airfield flight line drivers program.
* Ability to coordinate with Wing Safety, Airfield Management, Airfield Operations, and tenant units.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for program documentation, briefings, and incident reporting.
* Familiarity with airfield operations, ATC radio phraseology, airfield risk management, and airfield safety programs.
* Ability to obtain/maintain a US Secret Clearance (Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain/maintain the clearance)


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Serve as the Wing’s designated Airfield Driving Program Manager, responsible for the full lifecycle of the Airfield Driving Program.
* Develop, maintain, and update the Wing Airfield Driving Instruction (ADI), training and testing materials, and local operating procedures.
* Train unit ADPMs and certify them to administer, test and train personnel assigned to their unit.
* Conduct initial, recurring, and remedial airfield driving training, including classroom instruction, practical evaluations and competency assessments.
* Maintain program records, training logs, violation reports, and certification documentation in accordance with DoD and USAF requirements
* Manage the issuance, tracking, and revocation of Airfield Driving Licenses, ensuring compliance with DAFI 13\-213 and local directives.
* Oversee the Runway Incursion Prevention Program, including trend analysis, corrective actions, and coordination with Wing Safety
* Lead investigations for airfield driving violations, runway incursions, and safety incidents; develop corrective action plans and report findings to Airfield Management leadership.
* Conduct program audits of individual unit programs, spot checks, and unit compliance inspections to ensure adherence to airfield driving standards.
* Provide recurring briefings to Wing leadership on program status, compliance issues, and risk mitigation measures.

data.jd_text:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Join EY’s Business Development team to drive growth, client satisfaction, and strategic pursuits across key accounts in MENA and Growth Markets. This role is client\-centric, market\-facing, and requires the ability to leverage EY’s global network to deliver solutions that meet complex client needs. You will work closely with service line leaders, Regional Managing Partners, and BD teams to execute go\-to\-market strategies, manage account pipelines, and lead high\-value pursuits.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Leadership \& Relationship Management: Establish trusted, long\-term relationships with clients, particularly at the "C" level; act as a consultative advisor, identifying client needs and proposing solutions that add measurable value.
* Business Development \& Growth: Drive revenue, sales, and pipeline growth through account planning, opportunity management, and strategic market initiatives. Participate in complex pursuits and lead presentations, negotiations, and proposals.
* Strategy \& Market Input: Collaborate with service line leaders to develop and deploy service line growth strategies, strategic campaigns, and pursuit coverage strategies. Provide insights into market trends, competitive intelligence, and emerging opportunities.
* Operational Excellence: Implement account management excellence using EY’s frameworks, monitor pipeline and trends, and participate in revenue planning processes.
* Talent Leadership: Coach and mentor junior BD staff and client\-serving professionals to build high\-performing teams.


**Skills \& Attributes For Success**
* Proven ability to sell complex solutions and services at the "C" level, preferably across large conglomerate companies, Health care, Logistics, Automotive, Telco, Aviation, Consumer retail or in a family business segment.
* Strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and the ability to influence and collaborate across a matrixed organization.
* Expertise in account management, pipeline development, and opportunity creation.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and client\-facing presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, thrive in fast\-paced, multi\-cultural environments, and adapt to changing priorities.
* Familiarity with formal tendering processes, proposals, and pursuit methodologies.
* Transforms available data into strategic insights to drive impactful business development decisions.


**Ideally, you’ll also have:**
* Graduate or higher degree in business or related field.
* 10–15\+ years of business development experience in professional services or solution\-selling environments.
* Proven track record of driving growth, managing multiple accounts, and delivering measurable results.
* Experience in multi\-country environments is preferred.
* Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English.
* Flexibility to travel within the region.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**EY** 
 \| Building a better working world
   

  

 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

data.jd_text:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION** 



* A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

data.jd_text:
NATS is the UK’s leading air navigation service provider, handling over 2 million flights each year. It provides air traffic control services, as well as a wide range of commercial solutions to over 30 countries internationally. Our people are at the heart of our purpose to advance aviation and keep the skies safe.
 



  





  





**Role Purpose** 




  





 This role is accountable for the day\-to\-day operational oversight, training and implementation of ANS solutions across the contract. The role is responsible for providing advice and support within the operations directorate, ensuring independent oversight that delivers assurance that operational and training responsibilities, as well as quality standards, are being met, maintained, and continually improved in relation to the contract’s operational service delivery in Kuwait.
 



  





  





**Key Accountabilities** 




  




* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, acting as the point of contact for all operational and training matters.
* Understand client needs, challenges, and objectives to deliver the contract and drive customer satisfaction.
* Provide oversight on all operational activities to meet or outperform all operational and safety KPIs.
* Work closely with the regulator to ensure all policies, procedures and training programmes comply with regulatory requirements and company policies.
* Manage operational and training budgets and forecasts, tracking performance against targets and implementing corrective actions when necessary.
* Provide regular updates to clients on operational KPIs, training status, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring transparency and alignment on expectations.
* Work closely with the Delivery Director to ensure that up to date account reviews and performance reports are in place for internal stakeholders and senior management.
* Analyse day\-to\-day operations and processes and identify areas for process enhancement.
* Develop an implementation plan to introduce a Search and Rescue cell responsible for all Search and Rescue activities required in the Kuwait FIR.



  





  





**Qualifications, Skills and Personal Attributes** 




  




* Minimum of 10 years of experience in ATC Supervisory or Management roles, with a detailed understanding of the operational environment and the critical role that people and processes play in achieving operational KPIs and meeting training objectives.
* Excellent leadership skills, with steadfast resolve and personal integrity.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build rapport and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Preferably possess experience in Search and Rescue (SAR) operations, including familiarity with SAR procedures, coordination protocols, emergency response frameworks and collaboration with multi‑agency teams.
* A University Degree is strongly preferred for this role.
* Fluent in English



  





  





**Additional Vacancy Information** 




  




* Required to work flexibly across different time zones and working weeks.
* International travel as required.



  





  





 We are proud to offer a fantastic total reward package to help you thrive both personally and professionally. In addition to a competitive salary that's regularly reviewed, as a member of our international team, you'll also benefit from private healthcare and dental cover, a generous leave entitlement with the option to purchase additional leave, wellness support and a comprehensive learning and development offering. For more information, please visit International \- NATS
 



  





  





 If you share our passion to advance aviation and keep the skies safe – we would like to hear from you whatever your age, sex, race, faith, visible or invisible disability. Individuals that bring different perspectives, skills, life experiences and backgrounds help us be at the forefront of our industry.

**Location:** 
 Single branch (Salam or Shuhada or Salwa)
   

  

**About BeCurious**
 BeCurious is a premium Finnish\-method preschool operating across three branches in Kuwait — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa. Built on the belief that curiosity drives learning, BeCurious combines a strong curriculum with a structured operating system.
   

  

 Each branch must operate at the same standard — every day, in every classroom. The Branch Manager is the person who makes that real on the ground.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Branch Manager owns the day\-to\-day operation of one BeCurious branch.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is not administrative oversight. The Branch Manager ensures that every session, every teacher, and every family experience meets the BeCurious standard — consistently, without exception.
   

  

 You are responsible for execution. What is designed at system level must work in your branch — through people, discipline, and attention to detail.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Daily Operations — One Branch, Full Standard:
   

  

* Own the daily running of the branch from opening to closing.
* Ensure all sessions run on time and to standard.
* Execute all SOPs exactly as designed in the BeCurious OS.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and fully prepared environment at all times.
* Ensure readiness for inspections at any time.


**Team Management**
* Manage all teachers and support staff within the branch.
* Lead daily briefings and ensure team alignment.
* Hold staff accountable to performance standards.
* Support teacher development through coaching and feedback.
* Ensure no teacher leads a session without required training completion.


**Teaching \& Classroom Quality**
* Monitor classroom delivery daily.
* Conduct regular classroom observations.
* Ensure lesson plans and weekly planning are completed and followed.
* Ensure child observation records are completed properly.
* Maintain visible application of the Curiosity Lens Framework.


**Parent Experience**
* Ensure a high\-quality, consistent parent experience.
* Handle parent concerns professionally and promptly.
* Ensure proper communication standards are followed.
* Support tours and convert interest into enrollment in coordination with Admissions.


**Admissions Support**
* Support branch\-level enrollment targets.
* Ensure tour readiness and professional delivery.
* Follow up with prospective families when required.
* Maintain accurate information flow to the admissions system.


**Inventory \& Supplies**
* Monitor branch\-level inventory and usage.
* Coordinate with Purchasing Manager for supply needs.
* Ensure materials are available and organized for all sessions.
* Reporting \& Compliance.
* Report daily and weekly updates to Director of Operations.
* Maintain accurate records (attendance, incidents, staff data)
* Ensure incident reports are completed within required timelines.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements.


**What This Role Is Not**
* The Branch Manager does not operate without structure — SOPs are followed, not reinvented.
* This is not a passive supervisory role — you are actively managing every day.
* The Branch Manager does not avoid accountability conversations.
* This role is not about being liked — it is about maintaining standards.


**You Are The Right Person If**
 You will thrive in this role if you:
   

  

* Are highly organized and present on the floor.
* Can manage people with clarity and firmness.
* Pay attention to detail others miss.
* Take full ownership of outcomes, not excuses.
* Can maintain energy and consistency every day.


**This Role Is Not Right For You If You**
* Prefer planning over execution.
* Avoid difficult conversations with staff or parents.
* Struggle with structure and process discipline.
* Need constant direction instead of taking ownership.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Minimum 3–5 years experience in education, preschool, or operations.
* Experience managing a team.
* Strong organizational and leadership skills.
* Arabic and English proficiency.
* Based in Kuwait or able to relocate immediately.


**Preferred**
* Experience in early childhood education.
* Experience in a structured, multi\-branch environment.
* Familiarity with school systems (Odoo, Brightwheel, etc.).


**What BeCurious Offers**
* A clear operating system — you execute with clarity, not guesswork.
* A real leadership role at branch level.
* Direct impact on children, families, and team quality.
* Growth as the organization expands.
* Compensation.
* Competitive, based on experience. Discussed at offer stage.


**How To Apply**
* Send your CV and a short note answering:
* “What does a high\-performing branch look like in a preschool, and how have you contributed to it?”
* Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
* BeCurious

* 2026
* Curiosity builds everything.


**About Emerge General Contracting Company**
 BeCurious is a Finnish\-inspired, play\-based preschool in Kuwait where children learn by doing, imagining, and exploring. We create joyful, inclusive classrooms and partner closely with families to help every child feel seen and thrive. As a team member, you’ll design hands\-on learning experiences, nurture curiosity and character, and work within a warm, supportive culture that celebrates each child’s uniqueness. If you’re caring, creative, and collaborative, you’ll feel right at home with us.

data.jd_text:
**About the Role:** 




 BÖWE is an award\-winning architecture and design firm seeking a highly experienced Quantity Surveyor with strong expertise in quantity surveying, cost estimation, cost control, tendering, procurement support, contract administration, and commercial management.

**Quantity Surveying \& Commercial Skills:** 




 • Strong experience in quantity surveying, cost estimation, BOQ preparation, tendering, and contract administration.
 



 • Proven ability to manage project costs across pre\-contract and post\-contract stages.
 



 • Advanced experience in preparing quantity take\-offs from drawings, specifications, BIM models, and tender documents.
 



 • Strong knowledge of construction materials, finishes, fit\-out works, MEP coordination, and architectural packages.
 



 • Ability to prepare detailed cost estimates, budgets, cost plans, and commercial reports.
 



 • Experience in reviewing contractor quotations, tender submissions, payment applications, claims, and variations.
 



 • Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender comparison sheets, and commercial evaluation.
 



 • Ability to review drawings, specifications, scope documents, and technical details to identify cost implications.
 



 • Strong knowledge of contract terms, project documentation, change management, and commercial risk control.

**Key Responsibilities:**

 • Assist in procurement coordination by preparing comparison sheets, commercial summaries, and recommendation reports.
 



 • Monitor project budgets, cost performance, and commercial risks throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 • Review interim payment applications, progress claims, invoices, and supporting documents.
 



 • Assess, negotiate, and validate variations, change orders, claims, and additional work requests.
 



 • Coordinate with design, project management, procurement, finance, contractors, consultants, and clients regarding cost and contract matters.

 • Support contract administration, including reviewing contract documents, scope gaps, commercial terms, and project requirements.
 



 • Identify cost\-saving opportunities and provide practical commercial recommendations to management.
 



 • Participate in project meetings, tender meetings, negotiation sessions, and commercial coordination discussions.
 



 • Maintain accurate commercial records, project cost files, tender documents, and contract\-related correspondence.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills:** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field.

 • Strong experience in BOQ preparation, cost estimation, tendering, procurement support, variation assessment, and payment review.

 • AutoCAD
 



 • Revit / BIM
 



 • Cost estimation and quantity take\-off tools
 



 • Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
 



 • Microsoft Project or Primavera P6 is an advantage
 



 • ERP or project cost management systems are an advantage
 



 • BIM\-based quantity take\-off tools are an advantage
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 If you are a detail\-oriented Quantity Surveyor with 6 to 10 years of proven experience in quantity surveying, cost estimation, tendering, and commercial management, we would be delighted to review your application.
 



 Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 📧 mz@bowe.me

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for leading the Country Audit team, and managing the provision of internal audit and related advisory services for the Branch’s activities. In this regard, the incumbent will develop the annual internal audit plan for the Branch for review by Group Internal Audit Division and subsequently ensure the timely implementation/ execution of the plan in line with applicable best practices, including but not limited to the Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (SPPIA).
   

  

 The responsibility includes also the follow\-up of issues raised by Group Internal Audit Division and preparation of status reports, review of Policies and Procedures and conduct investigations/special assignments as and when requested. The role will also extend to the secondary responsibilities assigned to the incumbent in terms of specific audit activities/ functions/ departments and special projects, as assigned by his superiors, in addition to his primary responsibility. The position requires sufficient expertise and knowledge to focus/ monitor a wide range of risks in their countries business.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Ensure effectiveness of adopted policies/ procedures adherence to regulatory and statutory requirements, and safeguarding of the Branch’s assets.
* Add value to the functions/ activities performed by the Branch by identifying instances/ risks that could result in financial losses or regulatory non\-compliance, monetary penalties/ reputation damage through the audit and risk review process.
* Identify potential cost saving opportunities by highlighting process inefficiencies through the above processes.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for the internal audit function and its roles.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated by the GIAD to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Ensure adequate coverage of the Branch’s activities in the annual audit plan to provide assurance to the relevant executive management on the adequacy and effectiveness of the internal controls in place within the respective department/ function and add value to improve the functioning of the various activities performed by the referenced department/ function, as and where applicable.
* Act as primary Internal Audit subject matter expert in country, in order to ensure adherence to the full range of regulatory requirements (both local and Qatar regulators) including QNB Country Compliance manual; Group Compliance Policies and Procedures Financial Crime Risk, ESG, Fraud Risk Management, Regulatory reporting and Information Security etc.
* Provide timely feedback/ information to the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity on queries, reports and other correspondence received by Branch Management either directly from the external auditors or the applicable regulators in the respective jurisdictions, to enable the latter to respond to the same in a timely and efficient manner, that pertain to the incumbent’s area of responsibility.
* Execute and/or support in completion of any requirement, tasks or requests from local regulator or GIAD’s office specifically related to Internal Audit, including reviews of regulatory returns, and periodic certifications.
* Liaise with the relevant officials from Country Regulators as and when required and provide clarifications/ responses to queries/ reports/ other correspondence received.
* Liaise with the external auditors of the branch to ensure that they complement the efforts of the Internal Audit and avoid duplication of effort. This will involve meetings with the external auditors to discuss the planned audit work, the exchange of working papers, audit reports and management letters, and to ensure common understanding of audit techniques, methods and terminology.
* Manage the relationships with the Branch’s executive management and obtain their inputs/ concerns on the various functions/ activities pertaining to the Branch including significant developments therein, which could have an impact on the annual audit plan for the Branch.
* Support Internal Audit teams of other QNB international entities, as and where requested by GIAD.
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Conduct a risk assessment for branch individual functions/ processes/ products and related procedures on at least annual basis as an input to annual audit planning exercise.
* Prepare an annual audit for submission to the VP – International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity for review/comments and approval, based on the risk assessment conducted for the Branch and in line with its overall strategy.
* Ensure timely implementation and execution of the approved annual audit plan. Also responsible for submitting periodic status reports on the progress to VP – International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity and explaining the reasons for the delay in completion of individual assignments, if applicable.
* Ensure the continued adherence to internal auditing best practices including but not limited to the Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (SPPIA) recommendations/guidelines. Ensure that the audit planning, fieldwork and reporting stages are conducted in consonance with the procedures/ guidelines contained in the internal audit manual. Also, make recommendations to the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity on any improvements to the approved internal audit manual, in line with best practices.
* Escalate promptly (on interim basis if required) any major issues/ significant concerns emerging from the areas/ functions audited, to the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity for review/ action to enable timely rectification/ resolution of the highlighted issues.
* Utilize appropriate audit management application software procured by GIAD
* Ensure effective audit follow\-up process in order to monitor and report on status of issues raised in reports issued by Internal Audit, External auditors and regulators.
* Submit performance appraisals to the VP \-International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity on timely basis in accordance with the laid down policy in this regard.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external auditors, regulators and the Compliance function as and when required.
* Continuous Improvement:
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognise the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Identify related areas for professional development based on discussions with the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity and ensure they are part of their development plan.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank and attain/maintain the required levels of competence.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance and the team’s overall performance on a regular basis.
* Identify development opportunities and activities for staff and facilitate/coach them to improve their effectives and prepare them to assume greater responsibilities.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members.
* Legal, Regulatory and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, the QNB Country Compliance manual; Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (Anti Money Laundering \& Counter Terrorist Financing, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify, measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Carry out all other ad hoc tasks, duties and/or activities that GIAD may request from time to time.
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* University graduate (Bachelor’s degree) preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics, Accounting (or related field of study), Masters preferred
* Minimum of 12 years’ experience in a major bank or leading audit firm out of which 5 years in a managerial role with a major bank.
* Professional Audit qualifications such as CIA / CMA / CPA / CA/ ACCA / CISA or equivalent is required.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of your Passport
* Copy of Education Certificate

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that Country’s Corporate Bank Business is optimally managed with the appropriate levels of co\-ordination between the constituent parts of the unit. This includes ensuring that, revenue potential is realized in a cost effective, low risk manner. The target client portfolio is developed in line with QNB’s stated strategic intent and, maximum revenue potential of relationship officers is realized via effective coaching, training and communication.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective departmental/ unit heads and monitor exercise of the same
* Implement the bank’s approved strategy / plan to facilitate achievement of related short and long term business goals in the most effective and efficient manner.
* Oversee the development and subsequent implementation of annual plans by the individual departments / functions comprising Corporate Banking to ensure achievement of pre\-set targets / objectives, including but not limited to business growth and expansion.
* Approve / amend Key Performance Indicators for the purpose of performance monitoring and quality measurement of the Corporate Banking Division and systematic monitoring of their achievements in terms of assets and liabilities.
* Manage the development and subsequent implementation of market best practices across all activities / operations comprising the Corporate and Institution Banking Department to promote efficiencies in work processes, ultimately resulting in increased customer satisfaction.
* Review / analyse the Corporate and Institution Banking Department management accounts (comprising the balance sheet, income statement along with the budgeted figures) on a monthly basis and positively address adverse variances noted with the respective departmental / function heads.
* Observes and promotes cost consciousness and efficiency, and enhance productivity, to minimize costs, avoid wastes, and optimize benefits for the bank
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Ensure the provision of value added corporate products and services to existing / potential corporate banking customers who seek banking relationships with the bank.
* Endeavour to enhance, maintain and deepen relationships with existing corporate customer base, as well as building new relationships. Ensure, by monitoring the performance of the country FI / GSF / GTB resource, that the FI customer base is developed in accordance with approved country/regional strategy for FI’s / GTB and GSF.
* Oversee the implementation and constant enhancement of the overall customer service culture within Corporate Banking team.
* Approve Service Level Agreements with other branch divisions/ departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time, which will also help increase external customer satisfaction.
* Maintain and enhance relationships with Central Bank / other regulators and professional firms as appropriate. Ensure the promotion of QNB’s footprint and product and service offering through professional and other relevant forums.
* Support the local development of GAM accounts where appropriate.
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk Functions as and when required.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Responsible for establishing and maintaining sound internal control environments across Corporate Banking team.
* Ensure that the approved strategy, business plans, budgets along with the approved policies / procedures and subsequent amendments thereto are timely communicated to the respective departmental heads to the extent these relate to their areas of responsibility, to enable them to be guided by / pursue or comply with the same.
* Strive to maintain continuous compliance of the policies / procedures with prevailing practices / regulations pertaining to Corporate Banking promulgated by the respective regulators (viz. Central Bank as well as other regulators in jurisdiction).
* Resolve / address resource issues (includes labor and systems) faced by the respective departments / functions either directly or through timely coordination with other Group divisions / departments to enable them to meet their assigned targets.
* Oversee the rollout of innovative corporate banking products by the respective heads of departments / functions and monitor their performance.
* Manage, control, monitor and assume responsibility for the Corporate Banking risk profile and portfolio quality in line with the expectations of Credit Committee / Executive Committee.
* Monitor / review the Corporate Banking portfolio by segment on overall basis and by product, corporate profile, country, industry and other parameters on periodic basis to evaluate the quality and performance of the same. Ensure customer revenues accord with business and return criteria.
* Lead the development of ‘early warning systems’ that highlight possible risk deterioration in the corporate credit portfolio, in order to allow for timely corrective action. Also, monitor critical portfolio caps at required intervals and take prompt action in coordination with Credit Risk when required to uphold the quality of the portfolio.
* Responsible for overseeing the overall action plans for addressing control weaknesses or compliance issues noted by Internal Audit Department, external auditors or the Compliance function.
* Coordinate Corporate Banking marketing initiatives with other line department /groups to maximize cross\-selling and advisory services opportunities for the benefit of the client and the Group as a whole.
* Continuous Improvement:
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognize the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance as well as the function’s overall performance on a regular basis.
* Manage all administrative operational aspects of division personnel (e.g. leave schedule, training, appraisal, remuneration etc.) in accordance with established HR policies and procedures.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved staff grievances or conflicts within the team.
* Possess a superior knowledge of the corporate banking business, its products and related risks together with a good knowledge of operations and control.
* Identify areas for professional development of self and other staff.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Anti\-Bribery and Corruption, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
* All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.
* All other ad hoc duties and/or activities related to QNB that management may request of the employee from time to time


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* University graduate preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics or Business Administration (related field of study), Masters preferred
* At least 15 years of relevant banking experience, preferably with at least 5 years at a senior managerial position in corporate banking within a highly rated international bank.
* Well\-informed of the market competitive structure, industry practices and regulations for the corporate banking segment preferably with at least 5 years’ experience in the local/ regional environment and preferably 3 years international banking experience.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of your Passport
* Copy of Education Certificate

**Strategic \& Operational Support**
* Partner with leadership on long\-range planning, capital investments, and business strategy

* Maintain and strengthen banking and lender relationships

* Strong proficiency in financial systems, accounting software, and data analysis tools
* Excellent understanding of internal controls, risk management, and financial governance frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop accounting teams while fostering a culture of accountability and accuracy
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively present financial information to senior leadership and ownership


 \*\*Preferred Qualifications\*\*
   

  

* Experience in the hospitality, theme park, or water park industry
* Background in managing capital projects, construction budgeting, and ROI analysis
* Experience with cash flow management and banking relationship development
* Knowledge of property management systems and integrated financial reporting platforms
* Prior experience supporting strategic planning and long\-range financial forecasting initiatives

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Establish and operate the project's document control system across all engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning phases of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman. Maintain the integrity, accessibility and traceability of all project documents exchanged between the owner's team, the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, lenders, regulatory authorities and other counterparties.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Establish, configure and operate the project's electronic document management system, covering all engineering, contractual, commercial, regulatory and HSE documentation.
* Define and enforce document numbering, revision control, status coding and approval workflows across the owner's team and external counterparties.
* Receive, log, distribute and track all incoming and outgoing project documents, including transmittals to and from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, lenders' independent technical advisors and Omani authorities.
* Maintain the project's master document register and ensure all document holders are working from current revisions.
* Manage the document approval cycle, ensuring timely turnaround between submission, review, comment and approval status across all disciplines.
* Support the preparation of document packages for major project milestones, including Final Investment Decision, lender due diligence, regulatory submissions and project financial close.
* Maintain the project's electronic and physical archive in line with the company's records retention policy and lender requirements.
* Support the discipline lead engineers and the Project Director with document retrieval, status reporting and audit trail evidence as required.
* Establish handover procedures for as\-built documentation from construction into operations.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 8 years' experience as a Document Controller on large heavy industrial capital projects, with at least one project of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Demonstrated experience operating an electronic document management system across multi\-party project environments involving owner, EPC contractors and technology licensors.
* Familiarity with industry\-standard document numbering and classification systems used in oil and gas, petrochemicals, steel or power projects.
* Experience supporting project finance lender due diligence and audit processes is preferred.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational discipline and ability to maintain document integrity under high transaction volumes.
* Effective communication skills with engineering, commercial and external stakeholders.
* Ability to work within a small owner's team where each individual carries direct responsibility for their function.
* This position is open to Omani nationals only.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Management, Business Administration or related discipline (required).
* Certification in document control, records management or project information management (e.g., AIIM, IRMS) (preferred).
* Proficiency in industry\-standard document management platforms (e.g. Aconex, ProjectWise, SharePoint, EDMS).


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic \- Nice to have

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Develop, integrate and maintain the project's master schedule across all phases from pre\-FID through commissioning of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman. Provide the Project Director, the company executive and the project's lenders with the integrated schedule view that supports decision\-making, risk management and financial close.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain the project's master schedule, integrating inputs from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, utility providers, port authorities and Omani regulatory counterparties.
* Consume and integrate the technology licensor's pre\-engineering Level 2 schedule and the integrated delivery partner's FEED and execution schedules into a single owner's master schedule.
* Manage interface dates and critical path dependencies across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, utility connections, port readiness and regulatory approvals.
* Maintain the project schedule baseline and track progress against baseline through earned value or equivalent reporting methods.
* Lead schedule risk analysis, including critical path analysis, float consumption tracking, and schedule contingency assessment.
* Prepare schedule reports for internal review, lender reporting and external stakeholder engagement, including the Project Director, the company executive, the lender consortium, and equity investors.
* Support the project's cost estimate development by providing schedule\-driven inputs into resource and cost loading.
* Support the project's risk management process by identifying schedule risks and supporting mitigation planning.
* Provide planning support to the discipline lead engineers in their interactions with the integrated delivery partner and equipment vendors.
* Maintain alignment between the project schedule and the project's regulatory, permitting and contractual milestones.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 12 years' experience in project planning and scheduling on large heavy industrial capital projects, with at least one project of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Direct experience on greenfield projects in steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, oil and gas, fertilizer or power.
* Demonstrated experience integrating multi\-party schedules across owner, technology licensor, EPC contractors and equipment vendors.
* Strong understanding of critical path methodology, schedule risk analysis and earned value management.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard scheduling software (Primavera P6 required; MS Project an advantage).
* Experience supporting project finance lender due diligence on schedule deliverables is strongly preferred.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to communicate schedule status and risk to senior executive and lender audiences.
* Ability to work within a small owner's team where each individual carries direct responsibility for their function.
* This position is open to Omani nationals only.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management or related discipline (required).
* Master's degree in Project Management, Construction Management or related field (preferred).
* Project Management Professional (PMP), AACE Planning \& Scheduling Professional (PSP), or equivalent professional certification (preferred).
* Primavera P6 certification (preferred).


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Develop, validate and maintain the project's capital cost estimate across the pre\-FID and FEED phases of the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman, to a level of accuracy sufficient to support Final Investment Decision and lender due diligence. Provide independent owner\-side cost estimating, quantity surveying and commercial assurance across the technology package, the integrated delivery partner's scope, and the broader project capex.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain the project's capital cost estimate, integrating inputs from the technology licensor, the integrated delivery partner, equipment vendors, port and utility infrastructure providers, and the owner's team.
* Triangulate, challenge and validate cost estimates produced by the technology licensor and the integrated delivery partner, providing independent owner\-side commercial assurance.
* Develop and maintain the project's bill of quantities for civil, structural, mechanical, piping and electrical scopes within the owner's review responsibility. Lead cost estimating accuracy improvement from order\-of\-magnitude through Class 3 to Class 2 estimates aligned with AACE International recommended practice and lender expectations.
* Support the project's procurement strategy by developing should\-cost analyses, market price benchmarks and cost\-driver analyses for major equipment and construction packages.
* Maintain the project's cost contingency framework, including identification of cost risks, quantification of contingency requirements and reporting against contingency drawdown.
* Support the project's value engineering process by quantifying cost impacts of design alternatives and providing commercial input into engineering trade\-off decisions.
* Support project finance lender due diligence by preparing cost estimate documentation packages and engaging directly with independent cost consultants engaged by the lender consortium.
* Provide cost reporting to the Project Director, the company executive and external stakeholders including lenders and equity investors.
* Support post\-FID cost control and change management by establishing the cost baseline, change control framework and earned value reporting structure.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 12 years' experience in quantity surveying, cost estimating or cost engineering on large heavy industrial capital projects, with at least one project of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Direct experience developing FID\-grade and lender\-grade cost estimates aligned with AACE International recommended practice (Class 3 or better).
* Direct experience on greenfield projects in steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, oil and gas, fertilizer or power.
* Demonstrated experience providing independent owner\-side cost validation against contractor or licensor cost estimates.
* Familiarity with FIDIC\-based contracting, lump\-sum cost build\-ups, and reimbursable cost frameworks.
* Experience supporting project finance lender due diligence on cost estimate deliverables is strongly preferred.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to communicate cost status and risk to senior executive and lender audiences.
* Ability to work within a small owner's team where each individual carries direct responsibility for their function.
* This position is open to Omani nationals only.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Cost Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering or related discipline (required).
* Master's degree in Cost Engineering, Project Management or related field (preferred).
* Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (MRICS) or AACE International Certified Cost Professional (CCP) (preferred).
* AACE Planning and Scheduling Professional (PSP) or Estimating Professional (EVP) certification (preferred).


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic \- Nice to have

SUMMARY OF ROLE:
   





 The Unit Head \- Transaction Banking is responsible for leading the strategy, growth, and end\-to\-end delivery of transaction banking services, including cash management, payments, and trade finance. The role focuses on driving revenue growth, enhancing client experience, ensuring regulatory compliance, and delivering innovative, technology\-driven solutions to corporate and institutional clients. The role holder will also lead cross\-functional collaboration to position the Bank as a leading provider of transaction banking solutions in the market.
   





  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
   





 Responsibilities
   





 Strategy Development \& Execution
   





 • Define and implement the Transaction Banking strategy aligned with the Bank’s overall Corporate Banking and growth objectives.
   





 • Identify market opportunities, industry trends, and competitive positioning to enhance the Bank’s transaction banking offerings.
   





 • Develop and execute business plans to expand product penetration and increase market share.
   





  




 Revenue Growth \& Financial Performance
   


 • Drive revenue generation through effective pricing strategies, product optimization, and cross\-selling initiatives.
   





 • Achieve assigned financial targets including fee income, CASA growth, and transaction volumes.
   





 • Monitor profitability of transaction banking products and optimize cost\-to\-income ratios.
   





  




 Product Management \& Innovation
   


 • Oversee the development, enhancement, and lifecycle management of transaction banking products including cash management, payments, and trade finance.
   





 • Ensure products remain competitive, customer\-centric, and aligned with market needs.
   





 • Lead the introduction of innovative and digital solutions to enhance product capabilities and client experience.
   





  




 Client Relationship Management
   


 • Build and maintain strong relationships with key corporate and institutional clients.
   





 • Ensure high levels of client satisfaction through efficient service delivery and tailored solutions.
   





 • Support relationship managers in structuring transaction banking solutions to meet client requirements
   





  




 Sales \& Business Development
   


 • Lead and support sales initiatives to acquire new clients and expand existing client portfolios.
   





 • Work closely with Corporate Banking teams to drive product penetration and cross\-selling opportunities.
   





 • Participate in client meetings, pitches, and strategic discussions to position the Bank’s offerings effectively.
   





  




 Digital Transformation \& Process Optimization
   


 • Champion digital banking initiatives, automation, and process improvements within transaction banking.
   





 • Collaborate with IT and Digital teams to implement innovative solutions and enhance operational efficiency.
   





 • Drive straight\-through processing (STP) and reduce manual interventions across processes.
   

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  


 • Omani Nationals Only
   





 • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Banking, Business Administration, or related field.
   





 • Minimum 7 years of banking experience, with at least 5 years in Transaction Banking or Corporate Banking roles.
